With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. lists.content:
• Design and develop structural components and assemblies for Shield AI’s next-generation UAV platform, supporting both primary and secondary aircraft structures.
  • Execute all stages of the design lifecycle including conceptual development, initial CAD modeling, detailed design, and drawing release.
  • Perform hand calculations for stress or strain with limited basic FEA analysis, with guidance from senior engineers as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with aerodynamics, propulsion, avionics, payload, and manufacturing teams to support system integration across airframe interfaces.
  • Support structural validation efforts including coupon testing, subcomponent testing, and system-level verification.
  • Generate high-quality design documentation, drawings, interface definitions, and analysis reports in compliance with aerospace standards.
  • Partner with manufacturing and flight test teams to resolve build issues and support hardware through test and deployment.
  • Participate in design reviews and technical discussions, presenting work clearly and incorporating feedback effectively.
  • Continuously improve personal technical depth in structural layout, joints, fasteners, tolerancing, and structural optimization.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 2+ years of experience in aircraft structural design or closely related aerospace structures.
  • Experience designing and releasing structural components in development or production environments.
  • Working knowledge of composite and metallic structures, including fasteners, bonded joints, and load paths.
  • Proficiency in CAD tools (NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, or similar).
  • Understanding of GD&T, tolerance stackups, and DFMA principles.
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in fast-paced, high-ownership engineering environments
  • Ability to get a S//SAR level security clearance desired

• M.S. degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Experience supporting UAV, DoD, or aerospace vehicle programs.
  • Familiarity with aerospace standards (MIL-STD, ASME Y14.5, FAA).
  • Experience supporting hardware through test, failure analysis, and design iteration.
  • Exposure to composite design and manufacturing methods.
  • Experience using FEA tools (ANSYS, Abaqus, NASTRAN, or similar) for linear structural analysis

jobs.description: Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. Our Applications Engineers are highly technical, customer-facing problem solvers who play a critical role in deploying Shield AI’s Hivemind software in real-world environments. This role is travel-intensive, with frequent trips, often international, and sometimes lasting multiple weeks, to work directly alongside customers on-site. This is primarily a Senior-level role, and we’re typically looking for candidates with several years of relevant industry experience. That said, we will consider exceptional mid-level engineers who demonstrate strong technical fundamentals, a hands-on mindset, and a track record of taking initiative in dynamic, customer-driven environments In this role, you will work closely with customers to understand their requirements, provide technical expertise during deployment, and ensure successful integration of our AI and autonomy products. You’ll also collaborate internally with engineering teams, with opportunities to grow into technical leadership over time. You Should Apply If: You’re excited about a travel-heavy role and enjoy being on-site with customers, including international and multi-week engagements You’re a strong technical contributor (or early in your career and eager to grow) who takes initiative and figures things out You enjoy problem solving, building relationships, and working at the intersection of engineering and real-world deployment You’re passionate about autonomy, robotics, or aerospace You Should Not Apply If: You prefer minimal travel or want to work primarily from a single location You want to do 100% R&D and don’t enjoy customer interactions You’ve never programmed in C, C++, or Rust

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


Job Description:
We are seeking a motivated Associate Manufacturing Engineer to support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes for next-generation aerospace systems. In this role, you will partner with Design Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain to transition products from design into production while supporting prototype builds, new product introduction (NPI), and production ramp-up. 
This position may support one or more aircraft systems, including airframe structures, electrical systems, propulsion, mechanical systems, avionics, final integration, or ground support equipment. The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver who enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and contributing to the production of advanced aerospace products.

Job Description:

We are seeking a motivated Associate Manufacturing Engineer to support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes for next-generation aerospace systems. In this role, you will partner with Design Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain to transition products from design into production while supporting prototype builds, new product introduction (NPI), and production ramp-up. 

This position may support one or more aircraft systems, including airframe structures, electrical systems, propulsion, mechanical systems, avionics, final integration, or ground support equipment. The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver who enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and contributing to the production of advanced aerospace products.

lists.content:
• Develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes for assigned products or aircraft systems.  

  • Design and improve assembly tools, fixtures, jigs, and manufacturing aids to support safe, repeatable, and efficient production.  

  • Create and maintain work instructions, manufacturing process documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process flows.  

  • Partner with Design Engineering to improve manufacturability, assembly efficiency, quality, and cost through Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA).  

  • Support prototype builds, engineering builds, production readiness activities, and new product introductions.  

  • Troubleshoot manufacturing issues using root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).  

  • Collaborate with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and Industrial Engineering to improve safety, quality, throughput, and productivity.  

  • Support tooling validation, first article inspections, process qualification, and production validation activities.  

  • Utilize CAD software to develop tooling concepts, manufacturing layouts, and production support equipment.  

  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing waste, improving quality, and increasing manufacturing efficiency.  

  • Ensure manufacturing processes comply with engineering requirements, quality standards, and company procedures.

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.  

  • 0–3 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, process engineering, or a related field (internship and co-op experience considered).  

  • Understanding of manufacturing processes, assembly methods, and production operations.  

  • Familiarity with CAD software such as CATIA, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Creo, or equivalent.  

  • Basic understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, and manufacturing documentation.  

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.  

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative manufacturing environment.  

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Internship or professional experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing.  

  • Experience supporting prototype builds, NPI, or production environments.  

  • Familiarity with machining, composites, electrical assemblies, mechanical assemblies, or final system integration.  

  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.  

  • Experience with ERP, MES, or PLM systems.  

  • Familiarity with AS9100 or other regulated manufacturing environments.

Job Description:

The Front Desk / Facilities Coordinator serves as the first point of contact for visitors, clients, and employees, creating a professional and welcoming experience. This role is responsible for managing front desk operations, coordinating office activities, supporting day-to-day administrative and facilities needs, and ensuring the smooth operation of the Kyiv office.

lists.content:
• Greet and assist visitors, ensuring a positive and professional first impression.
  • Manage emails and general inquiries, routing them as appropriate.
  • Coordinate visitor access, badging, and check-in processes.
  • Maintain front desk organization, cleanliness, and readiness at all times.
  • Schedule meetings and manage conference room bookings.
  • Support office operations, including mail distribution, deliveries, and office supply inventory. 
  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers as needed.
  • Manage relationships with office service providers, including cleaning, maintenance, internet, utilities, and other workplace services.
  • Assist with planning and execution of office events, meetings, executive visits, and team activities.
  • Partner with Facilities, IT, Security, and Workplace teams to support daily office operations. 
  • Maintain accurate records and handle sensitive information with discretion.
  • Ensure office equipment, including printers, scanners, conference room equipment, and other office devices, is properly maintained and fully operational.
  • Coordinate maintenance and repairs of office equipment with vendors when required. 
  • Oversee office cleaning services and ensure the workplace is maintained to the highest standards.
  • Procure office supplies, kitchen supplies, consumables, furniture, and other materials required for daily office operations.
  • Maintain inventory and accountability of office equipment, company assets, and workplace supplies. 
  • Support onboarding and offboarding activities by coordinating workspace readiness, badges, equipment, and office access.
  • Provide administrative and logistical support for corporate events, executive visits, customer meetings, and company activities.

• High school diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred).
  • 1–3 years of experience in a front desk, receptionist, administrative, office coordination, facilities, or customer-facing role.
  • Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher English proficiency (written and spoken).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and/or Google Workspace. 
  • Experience managing phones, calendars, and visitor coordination.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Professional demeanor with a customer-service mindset. 
  • Reliable, punctual, and able to handle sensitive and confidential information. 
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and proactively solve day-to-day office issues.

• Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  • Experience in a corporate or high-growth blended manufacturing/office environment.
  • Experience supporting facilities, office operations, or workplace services.
  • Basic knowledge of access control systems and office security protocols. 
  • Proficiency with scheduling tools (e.g., Outlook calendars and conference room booking systems). 
  • Experience coordinating vendors, deliveries, and events.
  • Experience supporting meetings, trainings, executive visits, and corporate events.
  • Experience managing office inventory and workplace assets.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
  • Experience handling confidential or sensitive information in a professional environment.

lists.content:
• Source and procure mechanical commodities including machined parts, sheet metal, welded assemblies, structural components, fasteners, hardware, castings, forgings, and other fabricated components supporting aerospace and defense programs.
  • Solicit supplier quotations, evaluate pricing and lead times, negotiate routine commercial terms, and execute purchase orders to meet program requirements.
  • Manage supplier relationships to ensure on-time delivery, quality, and responsiveness while escalating performance issues as needed.
  • Partner with Engineering to review drawings, specifications, bills of material (BOMs), and engineering changes to ensure suppliers understand manufacturing requirements.
  • Support new product introduction (NPI) activities by coordinating supplier quotes, prototype builds, and material readiness.
  • Work closely with Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supplier Quality to resolve supply chain issues, expedite critical hardware, and support production schedules.
  • Track supplier commitments, monitor delivery performance, and proactively communicate risks affecting production or program milestones.
  • Support supplier qualification activities, First Article Inspection (FAI), and quality requirements in coordination with Supplier Quality and Engineering.
  • Maintain accurate supplier data, pricing, lead times, and purchasing documentation within the ERP system.
  • Identify opportunities for cost savings, lead time improvements, and process efficiencies while supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain management supporting manufacturing or aerospace/defense environments.
  • Experience sourcing one or more mechanical commodity groups such as:
  • Precision machined components
  • Sheet metal fabrications
  • Welded assemblies
  • Structural components
  • Fasteners and hardware
  • Castings and forgings
  • Composites
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, bills of material (BOMs), and manufacturing specifications.
  • Experience obtaining supplier quotations, negotiating pricing and lead times, and managing purchase orders.
  • Basic understanding of manufacturing processes including CNC machining, welding, fabrication, finishing, and assembly.
  • Familiarity with aerospace quality systems such as AS9100 and First Article Inspection (FAI) processes is preferred.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, and Quality.
  • Experience using ERP/MRP systems and Microsoft Excel for purchasing and supplier management.

• Experience supporting aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
  • Familiarity with FAR, DFARS, ITAR, and export compliance requirements.
  • Experience supporting prototype, development, and production programs.
  • Exposure to supplier performance management and continuous improvement activities.
  • APICS/ASCM or CPSM certification is a plus.

Job Description:

This role is the team's primary interface between perception software and the flight test enterprise. You will work alongside autonomy/perception software developers, flight test engineers, and platform integration teams to mature our capabilities from algorithm to flight-verified system. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience deploying and testing autonomy or perception software on edge hardware, a strong foundation in one or more core perception disciplines (detection, tracking, SLAM, or navigation), and a bias toward field execution over theoretical analysis.

lists.content:
• Integrate perception and state-estimation software with EO/IR cameras, IMU/GNSS/PNT sensors, embedded compute, and target or surrogate platforms.
  • Lead the practical fly-fix-fly loop: prepare software and hardware, verify deployment/configuration, support execution, analyze the data, and drive the next corrective action with the responsible owners.
  • Establish and improve calibration, timing, configuration, data-capture, metadata, and replay practices; define the measurable test objectives and acceptance criteria that make the resulting data usable.
  • Investigate anomalous behavior using logs, recorded data, configuration, and focused source review; partner with software developers on targeted fixes and regression coverage.
  • Support sensor and edge-compute trade studies, bring-up, and operational readiness; drive day-to-day technical triage while escalating safety, airworthiness, and architecture decisions appropriately.

• Hands-on experience integrating and troubleshooting sensor-driven robotics or autonomy systems on physical hardware, including camera, IMU, GNSS/PNT, video, or comparable sensors.
  • Experience with calibration, timestamping, configuration, data quality, or a comparable sensor-integration discipline.
  • Experience defining and executing measurable test objectives, design-of-experiments activities, operational test procedures, or equivalent verification plans.
  • Proficiency in Python/Matlab for analysis, visualization, and investigation of recorded test data.
  • Comfort reading C++ and working with embedded Linux or edge-compute deployments to support focused debugging and integration work.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across hardware, software, test, and operational stakeholders; working knowledge of at least one core perception area such as navigation, tracking, detection, navigation, SLAM, or sensor fusion.

• Direct experience with camera intrinsics/extrinsics, camera-to-IMU calibration, time alignment, VIO/VBN, or other sensor-fusion systems in real-world testing.
  • Familiarity with capture, replay, and analysis workflows, plus EO/IR camera, optics, video-metadata, or image-quality characterization.
  • Experience with NVIDIA Jetson or comparable embedded GPU hardware, camera/video pipelines, and performance profiling.
  • Background supporting aviation, maritime, UAS, automotive, industrial robotics, or another operational autonomy domain; familiarity with modern C++ build, deployment, or CI environments.

This role is hybrid, based at Shield AI's San Diego, CA headquarters (three days per week in office), with periodic travel to flight test sites required.

 

 

Staff: 195,000-$290,000

Senior Staff: $230,000- $350,000

This position is ideal for an individual who thrives on solving complex integration challenges that span hardware, software, and systems engineering. A successful candidate will be skilled at deploying autonomy solutions onto unmanned platforms, preparing systems for flight, and troubleshooting mission-critical issues in both lab and field environments.
 
The role is highly dynamic, requiring hands-on experience, strong systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, real-world test conditions. Our Flight Integration Engineers are essential to bridging the gap between R&D and deployment, ensuring that autonomous systems function reliably and effectively when and where they are needed most.

lists.content:
• System Integration & Deployment — Integrate autonomy software onto unmanned aircraft systems, ensuring seamless operation across onboard compute, sensors, and control interfaces.
  • Pre-flight Preparation — Own the build, configuration, and validation process for flight-ready systems; coordinate hardware/software compatibility and mission readiness.
  • On-site Flight Test Support — Travel to test sites and support live flight operations, including safety checks, system bring-up, and troubleshooting under time-critical constraints.
  • Hardware/Software Debugging — Diagnose and resolve integration issues across complex autonomy software stacks and embedded systems in lab and field environments.
  • Flight Data Capture & Analysis — Manage data collection during missions and post-test analysis, working with autonomy engineers to refine behaviors and identify improvements.
  • Collaboration Across Teams — Work closely with autonomy, GNC, systems, and test teams to ensure mission-critical functionality is delivered on time and validated thoroughly.
  • Continuous Improvement — Build tools and processes to improve integration timelines, flight test reliability, and team efficiency across deployment cycles.
  • Support Certification and Compliance — Assist with documentation and system-level validation required for certification, airworthiness, and compliance in defense-relevant environments. 
  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 30-40% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or 4 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience. 
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and experience working with embedded systems, shell scripting, and system diagnostics. 
  • Knowledge of sensor integration, sensor fusion, and middleware frameworks (e.g., ROS, DDS).
  • Hands-on experience supporting flight demos or live exercises. 
  • Experience with simulation tools and environments for testing and validation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

• Direct experience supporting unmanned aerial systems or similar flight test campaigns.
  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, flight control systems, or GNC pipelines.
  • Competence in sensor integration, electronics debugging, or avionics bring-up.
  • Proficiency in developing automation tools for system testing, logging, and data parsing.

lists.content:
• Own and drive the full sales lifecycle for V-BAT ISR opportunities across assigned accounts and territories, from pipeline generation through close — with particular focus on accelerated and non-standard acquisition pathways
  • Identify, qualify, and prosecute urgent operational requirement (UOR) opportunities by leveraging deep knowledge of how end-user communities generate, validate, and fund time-critical capability needs
  • Develop and execute territory and capture strategies for priority pursuits, aligning with Shield AI's long-term strategic plan and the evolving ISR and mission autonomy requirements of UK and allied special operations forces
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with key decision-makers, capability sponsors, programme offices, and influencers across the special mission and broader defence community
  • Identify and shape requirements at source — engaging with users, capability development functions, and acquisition intermediaries to position V-BAT before formal requirements are crystallised
  • Recognise and surface Hivemind mission autonomy opportunities that emerge through V-BAT customer engagement, and partner with the wider Shield AI BD team to progress them appropriately
  • Lead proposal development in partnership with BD Operations and cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and value propositions
  • Conduct competitive analysis and position Shield AI's capability set effectively in complex, multi-stakeholder environments including those with restricted visibility
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Solutions teams to translate operational customer needs into compelling technical and mission-relevant solutions — spanning both V-BAT and Hivemind where relevant
  • Manage deal progression with rigour — qualification, deal strategy, forecasting accuracy, and CRM hygiene
  • Represent Shield AI at relevant industry events, exercises, and customer engagements to expand market presence and pipeline
  • Communicate clearly with internal stakeholders and leadership on pipeline status, risks, and key milestones

• Credible pipeline generation within the special mission and UOR-adjacent customer set, anchored on V-BAT ISR
  • Successful identification and shaping of at least one urgent or accelerated acquisition opportunity
  • Improved deal velocity and win rates through disciplined qualification and customer positioning
  • Identification of at least one Hivemind-relevant opportunity through V-BAT customer engagement
  • Establishment of trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders, capability development functions, and strategic partners
  • Consistent, accurate forecasting and high-quality CRM and pipeline hygiene
  • Meaningful contribution to Shield AI revenue growth across the UK and European region

• Substantive operational background in the UK special operations, special mission, or high-readiness environment with experience in roles that bridged operational requirement and capability development
  • Direct familiarity with how ISR capabilities are identified, trialled, acquired, and sustained in non-standard or time-sensitive procurement environments
  • Demonstrated experience in capability development, capability acquisition, or working closely with the functions that sponsor and manage them — programme sponsors, requirements owners, or acquisition support roles
  • Proven track record of transitioning from military service into a commercial role selling defence capability back into the special operations or broader MoD customer base
  • Deep understanding of UK defence acquisition processes, including formal procurement and accelerated or urgent pathways
  • Strong experience developing and executing capture strategies for complex, relationship-driven opportunities
  • Technical aptitude and ability to engage credibly with Engineering, Product, and Operational stakeholders on UAS ISR performance, integration, and broader autonomous systems
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills — particularly in environments where discretion and relationship trust are paramount
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment
  • Active SC clearance as a minimum; DV-cleared candidates or those with eligibility strongly preferred

• Prior commercial experience selling UAS, ISR, or autonomous systems — including AI-enabled mission systems — into UK defence or allied special operations customers
  • Established relationships within the special operations or special mission community in a commercial capacity
  • Familiarity with mission autonomy concepts and how AI-enabled systems are being considered within special operations and broader defence capability planning
  • Experience engaging with Large Systems Integrators (LSIs) and strategic partners relevant to the UK UAS and autonomous systems market
  • Familiarity with the broader UAS regulatory and airspace integration landscape in the UK and Europe
  • Ability to travel as required for customer engagements and industry events
  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional development

Shield AI is seeking a high-performing Business Development Lead, to drive defence market growth, customer engagement, and business expansion across assigned markets in Central Europe. As Shield AI’s territory leader, this individual will represent Shield AI’s autonomy and aircraft portfolio, including V-BAT, X-BAT, ViDAR-enabled ISR capabilities, and Hivemind autonomy software across customer engagements, operational demonstrations, strategic partnerships, opportunity development and business growth initiatives.

lists.content:
• Own and execute Shield AI’s go-to-market strategy across assigned markets, aligning territory activities with strategic growth priorities and customer mission requirements. 
  • Build and grow a disciplined pipeline across autonomy, aircraft, ISR, and mission-system opportunities aligned with regional defence priorities. 
  • Lead end-to-end deal closure, including account planning, customer shaping, competitive positioning, proposal leadership, negotiation, and contract close to meet or exceed carried sales quota.
  • Engage directly with senior military leaders, Ministries of Defence, procurement authorities, sovereign stakeholders, and strategic industry partners across the territory. 
  • Represent and differentiate Shield AI’s autonomy and aircraft portfolio by clearly articulating mission outcomes, operational advantages, and integration pathways. 
  • Develop and manage regional partnerships, consultants, industrial participation structures, and offset-aligned strategies that expand market access and accelerate execution. 
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Business Development, Product, Engineering, Government Relations, Legal, Contracts, Export Compliance, Operations, and Customer teams to support successful capture and delivery.  
  • Maintain disciplined forecasting, pipeline management, opportunity tracking, and campaign reporting across the territory.  
  • Provide regional market intelligence on competitor dynamics, customer demand, and political or operational risks.  
  • Support executive customer engagement after award to support customer success, follow-on growth, and long-term account expansion.

• Typically requires 6+ years of experience in business development, capture, sales, strategic engagement, account management, or related customer-facing roles within defence, aerospace, national security, or advanced technology environments.
  • Experience operating across international defence, government, or regulated markets, including navigating complex stakeholder and procurement environments. 
  • Demonstrated success identifying, shaping, and advancing complex opportunities involving long sales cycles, senior stakeholders, and technically differentiated solutions. 
  • Strong executive presence and ability to build credibility with military, government, industry, and strategic partner stakeholders.  
  • Technical aptitude and operational understanding of autonomous systems, ISR, mission systems, AI-enabled capabilities, or related defence technologies. 
  • Strong communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.  
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently throughout the territory and internationally. 
  • Based within the region, or willing to relocate to a strategic location within the assigned territory.
  • Fluency in English and regional languages relevant to the assigned market. 
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional, military, or operational experience preferred.

• Experience with UAS, autonomy, ISR, mission systems, aerospace, or AI-enabled operational capabilities. 
  • Existing relationships across defence ministries, military organizations, procurement authorities, or strategic industry partners within the assigned territory. 
  • Experience supporting direct commercial sales, Foreign Military Sales (FMS), or international government procurement programs.  
  • Prior military, operational defence, government, or national security experience.

• Help build the defining defence technology company of this century. 
  • Work at the forefront of AI, autonomy, and next-generation defence systems. 
  • Operate in a highly entrepreneurial and mission-driven environment.  
  • Make a direct impact on international growth and strategic defence partnerships. 
  • Collaborate with exceptional teams solving some of the world’s most complex operational challenges.

raw.descriptionPlain:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


We’re building intelligent systems that protect service members and civilians. Our autonomy and vision technology is now being adopted across some of the most complex and high-stakes environments in modern defence.  
 
We’ve developed a dedicated software factory for building, optimising, evaluating, and analysing autonomy and vision system solutions - and it’s gaining serious momentum. As demand grows, we’re working closely with partners and customers to solve real warfighting problems and deliver technology that genuinely changes what’s possible.  
 
This role sits at the heart of that mission.  
 
This is a build & release engineering role for teams shipping autonomy software to edge-deployed systems, frequently in isolated / constrained environments. You’ll own the engineering “last mile” between C++ development and dependable delivery: reproducible builds, trustworthy artefacts, promotion across environments, and deployable releases that work where they matter most. 
If you love modern C++ toolchains, dependency hygiene, artefact provenance, and making CI/CD fast and deterministic—this is for you.

If you love modern C++ toolchains, dependency hygiene, artefact provenance, and making CI/CD fast and deterministic—this is for you.

lists.content:
• Own C++ build and release workflows for autonomy and vision products, from source → build → test → package → release. 
  • Support and evolve containerised CI/CD pipelines across multiple isolated environments (speed, determinism, promotion, repeatability).  
  • Build and maintain container images for edge deployment 
  • Manage JFrog/Artifactory repositories for multi-language and generic artefacts; improve versioning, retention, and promotion practices. 
  • Strengthen dependency and build reproducibility for C++, reducing “works on my machine” and pipeline flakiness.  
  • Validate and deploy autonomy and vision-system products, tools, and libraries—focusing on edge delivery and reliability.  
  • Collaborate with engineers and system admins to ensure integration and stability across real deployment environments. 
  • Tackle complex, meaningful problems that directly support mission outcomes.

• Strong, hands-on experience delivering modern C++ software in production (not just “supporting” it). 
  • Demonstrated ownership of build systems / toolchains / dependency management (e.g., Conan, CMake, Nix, Ninja, Artifactory —whatever you’ve used to ship real systems). 
  • Significant recent experience running CI/CD for compiled software and maintaining the surrounding engineering systems (pipelines, runners/agents, artefact stores, promotion gates). 
  • Significant recent experience in Docker / Podman and containerised workflows 
  • Strong understanding of Linux/Unix systems.  
  • Experience debugging and troubleshooting.  
  • Background in air-gapped or isolated DevOps environments (or similarly constrained delivery contexts). 
  • Experience supporting Python deployment/distribution (for tooling around the C++ core).

• Help shape the future of defence and autonomy in Australia and beyond.
  • Be a key voice in a mission-led business redefining what’s possible with emerging technology.
  • Join a growing, values-led team headquartered in Port Melbourne, with strong global partnerships and local autonomy.
  • Competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and long-term growth opportunities.

• Not a “cloud-first” DevOps role focused on standing up cloud infrastructure. 
  • This role is primarily about C++ build & release engineering and edge delivery - making autonomy software shippable, repeatable, and dependable in real environments.

The Finance Transformation Change Lead is a senior individual contributor responsible for driving employee readiness and adoption across major Finance transformations, beginning with Shield AI’s Oracle ERP implementation. The role leads internal communications, stakeholder engagement, change champion activities, and training coordination so employees and leaders are prepared to adopt new Finance systems, processes, and operating models.

For the next 12 months, the role will focus primarily on the Oracle ERP implementation. Over time, it will support other Finance-related transformation initiatives, including acquisition integration, Finance systems modernization, process harmonization, and operating-model changes.

lists.content:
• Partner with the Executive Change Sponsor and implementation vendor’s Change Management Lead to execute Shield AI’s internal change, communications, readiness, and adoption activities.
  • Translate the broader change plan into clear, timely communications across Shield AI channels, including leadership updates, FAQs, employee communications, and program materials.
  • Develop and lead a cross-functional Change Champion Network, equipping champions to reinforce key messages, support adoption, and surface feedback from their teams.
  • Build leadership alignment by preparing talking points, facilitating briefings and employee forums, and ensuring leaders understand their role in supporting change.
  • Identify and help address areas of resistance, confusion, and people-related risk in partnership with program stakeholders.
  • Coordinate training readiness activities, including train-the-trainer sessions, subject-matter-expert participation, end-user training schedules, and delivery through internal learning channels.
  • Maintain the Oracle ERP information hub and ensure program communications, training resources, timelines, and key documents are current and accessible.
  • Coordinate onsite engagement, leadership sessions, champion activities, and readiness events at key program milestones.
  • Track feedback and readiness signals, using insights to improve communications, engagement, and adoption support.
  • Support additional Finance-related transformation initiatives after the Oracle ERP implementation, including acquisition integration and Finance systems or process changes.
  • Help establish repeatable change-management practices, tools, and templates within the Finance Transformation Office and PMO.

•  7+ years of experience in organizational change management, communications, program management, HR, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting complex technology, ERP, Finance transformation, or enterprise process-change initiatives.
  • Strong written communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management, and executive-facing presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and levels while operating as a senior individual contributor.
  • Experience developing communications, leading employee engagement, and coordinating role-based training or train-the-trainer activities.
  • Ability to simplify complex system and process changes into practical, audience-specific information.
  • Strong organization, judgment, and follow-through in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Willingness to travel periodically for implementation milestones, leadership engagement, training, and onsite readiness activities.
  • We are ONLY seeking candidates local to the Bay Area (and willing to commute to San Mateo, CA). At this time, we will not be relocating candidates.

• Experience with Oracle ERP or another large-scale enterprise system implementation.
  • Experience supporting M&A integration, including systems consolidation, process harmonization, or Day 1/Day 100 readiness.
  • Prosci, ACMP, PMP, or comparable change-management or project-management certification.
  • Experience in a high-growth technology or defense-tech env

Job Description:

As a Chief of Staff supporting functional strategy & execution, you will serve as a strategic thought partner and operational leader to an executive, helping translate business strategy into execution while improving organizational effectiveness. You will drive alignment across cross-functional teams, establish operating rhythms, coordinate strategic initiatives, and enable leaders to make faster, better-informed decisions. 
 
Operating at the intersection of strategy, business operations, communications, and program execution, you will partner closely with leaders across Finance, Engineering, Product, Operations, People, Legal, Security, IT, Facilities, and other business functions to deliver organizational priorities and drive business outcomes. 
 
This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, operational excellence, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to influence across the organization without direct authority.

lists.content:
• Partner with executive leadership to translate strategic priorities into operating plans, execution roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.  
  • Lead strategic planning processes, including the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), OKRs, business reviews, and governance rhythms to drive organizational alignment and execution.  
  • Drive complex cross-functional initiatives and day-to-day business operations, ensuring priorities remain on track, removing roadblocks, and delivering results.  
  • Act as the central coordination point across business functions, maintaining visibility into key workstreams, managing dependencies, and ensuring timely execution of strategic and operational priorities.  
  • Develop executive presentations, board materials, business communications, and reporting that support informed decision-making.  
  • Analyze business performance, operational metrics, and organizational data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable recommendations.  
  • Improve organizational effectiveness by designing scalable operating mechanisms, business processes, governance frameworks, and operational workflows.  
  • Represent the executive in leadership meetings, strategic discussions, and cross-functional forums, ensuring decisions are translated into clear actions and follow-through.  
  • Build trusted relationships across the organization while exercising sound judgment, maintaining confidentiality, and acting as a force multiplier by increasing executive capacity and enabling consistent execution.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 10+ years of experience in strategy, business operations, management consulting, program management, product operations, military leadership, or a related field. 
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple executive stakeholders. 
  • Strong strategic thinking combined with excellent operational execution skills. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and build alignment across diverse organizations. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive presentations and strategic communications. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable recommendations. 
  • Experience establishing executive operating rhythms, governance processes, business reviews, and planning mechanisms. 
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
  • High degree of judgment, integrity, professionalism, and discretion when handling confidential information.

• MBA or advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Public Policy, or a related discipline. 
  • Experience supporting senior executives as a Chief of Staff, Strategic Business Partner, or Business Operations Leader. 
  • Experience working in aerospace, defense, AI, robotics, autonomous systems, or other highly technical industries. 
  • Experience in high-growth startup or scale-up environments. 
  • Familiarity with strategic planning, OKRs, portfolio management, and business operations. 
  • Experience preparing materials for executive leadership teams, boards of directors, or investors. 
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional transformation or organizational change initiatives. 
  • Strong financial acumen with experience supporting annual planning, budgeting, and resource allocation.

Job Description:

This role will serve as the owner's representative responsible for leading facility planning, programming, design development, and project delivery for manufacturing, engineering, laboratory, office, and secure facility projects.

This position is heavily focused on design management and will be responsible for directing external architecture and engineering (A&E) firms throughout the entire project lifecycle. The successful candidate will lead stakeholder engagement, requirements development, programming, consultant management, design reviews, constructability reviews, and technical decision-making while ensuring designs align with operational objectives, budget constraints, schedule requirements, security requirements, and long-term facility strategies.

The ideal candidate thrives in environments where requirements are evolving and can effectively guide design teams through ambiguity to produce practical, constructible, and scalable solutions. Construction oversight is expected, but the primary focus of this role is ensuring design quality, design coordination, and successful project definition before construction begins.

The initial assignment will be the planning, design, and delivery of a prototype laboratory facility supporting advanced engineering and development activities.

lists.content:
• Serve as the owner's lead representative for facility planning, programming, and design execution.
  • Manage and direct architecture, engineering, specialty consultant, and design-build teams.
  • Develop project requirements in partnership with engineering, manufacturing, operations, security, and executive stakeholders.
  • Convert high-level business and operational objectives into actionable facility and infrastructure requirements.
  • Lead programming efforts, space planning exercises, feasibility studies, and conceptual design development.
  • Oversee design development from concept through construction documents.
  • Establish and manage design schedules, consultant deliverables, review cycles, and design budgets.
  • Lead design review meetings and drive resolution of technical issues, scope gaps, and coordination conflicts.
  • Review architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and specialty system designs.
  • Evaluate designs for constructability, maintainability, operational efficiency, scalability, safety, and lifecycle performance.
  • Ensure designs support manufacturing operations, engineering workflows, laboratory functions, airfield activities, and secure facility requirements.
  • Coordinate internal stakeholder reviews and ensure project requirements are properly incorporated into design documents.
  • Support permitting, entitlement, and regulatory approval efforts.
  • Provide technical leadership during procurement, contractor selection, and project execution activities.
  • Manage design-related RFIs, submittals, field modifications, and consultant support during construction.
  • Utilize AutoCAD to review, coordinate, and comment on design documentation.
  • Serve as the primary interface between internal stakeholders and external design consultants.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related technical field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in design management, owner's representation, architecture, engineering, facilities development, or capital project delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience managing architecture and engineering firms on complex facility projects.
  • Strong understanding of facility planning, programming, design development, and construction documentation.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary design teams through all phases of project development.
  • Ability to review and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, and technical documentation.
  • Working knowledge of building systems, construction methods, codes, and industry best practices.
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD.
  • Experience supporting projects in active operational environments, including aviation or airfield facilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in situations with incomplete or evolving requirements.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. SECRET Security Clearance.
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds or greater and perform site visits in active construction environments.

• Active U.S. SECRET Security Clearance or higher.
  • Experience supporting advanced manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or technology environments.
  • Experience planning and designing laboratories, prototype development spaces, engineering facilities, or manufacturing operations.
  • Familiarity with ICD 705 requirements and secure facility design.
  • Experience with SCIF planning, design, and accreditation processes.
  • Experience delivering projects using design-build, progressive design-build, or fast-track delivery methods.
  • Professional registration or certification such as PE, RA, PMP, CCM, LEED, or similar.
  • Experience managing mission-critical or highly technical facilities.

  •  Experience with Disclosure Statements (CASB DS-1)
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial analysis tools

Job Description:

We are seeking a Customer Support Systems Platform Manager to own the administration, configuration, roadmap, and continued development of our Salesforce Service Cloud environment and customer community portal.

This role will serve as the primary platform owner for systems supporting customer support, maintenance, sustainment, shipping, asset tracking, support communications, documentation access, reporting, dashboards, and case management. The ideal candidate is a hands-on Salesforce Service Cloud and Experience Cloud professional who can keep the platform running day to day while also designing and delivering new capabilities as additional products, teams, and support workflows are brought into the system.

This role will partner with support, shipping, sustainment, maintenance, product, IT, security, and program stakeholders to design scalable support processes and improve how internal teams and customers engage through Salesforce.

lists.content:
Platform Administration
  • Serve as the primary administrator and platform owner for Salesforce Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
  • Manage users, roles, profiles, permission sets, queues, groups, sharing settings, and access controls.
  • Configure and maintain case record types, case layouts, Lightning pages, fields, validation rules, assignment rules, escalation rules, and support processes.
  • Maintain the health, usability, security model, and data quality of the Salesforce support environment.
  • Manage sandbox environments, configuration changes, release documentation, and user support.
  • Troubleshoot issues, resolve user requests, and provide guidance to internal teams.
    • Service Cloud Design and Development
  • Design, configure, and enhance Service Cloud functionality for support, maintenance, sustainment, shipping, and product-specific workflows.
  • Build custom case management processes for different teams, products, business units, and customer support models.
  • Create and maintain Salesforce Flows, automations, approval processes, notifications, routing logic, and guided support processes.
  • Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Support the onboarding of new products, teams, and operational workflows into Service Cloud.
  • Recommend improvements to case management, support operations, customer communications, and internal workflows.
    • Customer Portal / Experience Cloud Ownership
  • Own the design, administration, and continued evolution of the Salesforce customer community portal.
  • Manage customer-facing portal functionality, access, navigation, content visibility, case submission, documentation access, asset tracking, communications, and support updates.
  • Design new portal features as customer and business needs evolve.
  • Partner with support and customer-facing teams to improve how customers engage with support teams and access relevant information.
  • Ensure portal functionality aligns with internal support workflows, security requirements, and customer experience goals.
    • Reporting, Dashboards, and Data
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards for support operations, case performance, shipping workflows, maintenance activity, sustainment metrics, asset-related support, and executive visibility.
  • Define and maintain key metrics, reporting structures, data standards, and dashboard requirements.
  • Support data quality, data cleanup, imports, exports, and ongoing data governance.
  • Partner with stakeholders to improve visibility into support trends, case volume, response performance, customer engagement, and operational bottlenecks.
  • Roadmap and Stakeholder Management
    Own and maintain the roadmap for Salesforce Service Cloud and Experience Cloud enhancements.
  • Prioritize system requests in partnership with business, IT, support, and operational stakeholders.
  • Document requirements, configuration decisions, process designs, and release notes.
  • Train users and create documentation for new features, workflows, reports, and portal capabilities.
  • Coordinate with external Salesforce consultants, developers, or implementation partners when larger technical projects require additional support.
  • Serve as the bridge between business teams and technical resources for Salesforce-related initiatives.

• 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration, business systems, CRM, or support-platform experience.
  • Strong experience administering and configuring Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Experience with case management, queues, routing, escalation rules, assignment rules, record types, page layouts, and Lightning pages.
  • Experience building Salesforce automation using Flow.
  • Experience creating Salesforce reports and dashboards.
  • Experience managing users, permissions, roles, profiles, permission sets, and sharing settings.
  • Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration best practices.
  • Experience supporting multiple teams, business units, or product lines within a single Salesforce environment.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to independently manage priorities, troubleshoot issues, and drive platform improvements.
  • U.S. citizenship required due to potential access to CUI, ITAR-controlled technical data, export-controlled information, and customer/program-restricted information.

• Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud, Customer Community, or customer portal administration.
  • Experience supporting support operations, maintenance, sustainment, logistics, shipping, asset tracking, field support, or RMA-related workflows.
  • Experience with Salesforce Knowledge, Entitlements, Milestones, SLAs, Macros, Omni-Channel, or Digital Engagement.
  • Experience designing customer-facing portal experiences.
  • Experience with Salesforce data governance and reporting strategy.
  • Experience working with external Salesforce implementation partners or developers.
  • Familiarity with Apex, Lightning Web Components, APIs, integrations, or the ability to manage technical Salesforce development work.
  • Experience in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, hardware, robotics, logistics, or complex technical product environments.

• Salesforce Administrator
  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder
  • Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant
  • Salesforce Experience Cloud Consultant
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I, preferred but not required

Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

The V-BAT Deployed Operations Fleet Manager is responsible for maximizing the Fully Mission Capable (FMC) status of Shield AI’s deployable V-BAT fleet. This role serves as the central authority for internal fleet health, utilization, and documentation, ensuring aircraft and equipment are maintained, properly configured, and consistently available to support global operations.  

The Fleet Manager acts as the primary resource for deployed teams on all aircraft and equipment-related matters, providing oversight, guidance, and coordination to ensure operational readiness. This role requires strong technical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to operate across multiple teams in a dynamic, high-tempo environment.

lists.content:
• Maintain real-time awareness of fleet status, including aircraft availability, maintenance posture, and readiness levels across all deployed and internal assets   
  • Drive maximum FMC rates by ensuring required maintenance, inspections, and corrective actions are completed in a timely manner   
  • Ensure all crews are properly equipped with the necessary aircraft, ground support equipment (GSE), and spare parts to execute operations   
  • Oversee utilization of internally owned aircraft, ensuring assets are flown regularly to maintain operational readiness and system health   
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for deployed personnel regarding aircraft, equipment, and fleet-related issues   
  • Ensure all aircraft logbooks, maintenance records, and supporting documentation are accurate, complete, and current   
  • Enforce proper data entry and integrity within the Fleet IQ database   
  • Identify and brief trends, risks, and gaps in Deployed Operations fleet performance and recommend corrective actions

• Track and manage RFIs (Requests for Information) from forward-deployed personnel   
  • Conduct advanced fleet analysis to support operational decision-making and long-term planning   
  • Assist in developing documentation and best practices   
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to fleet readiness and operational efficiency

• 5+ years of experience in aviation, UAS operations, or fleet management   
  • Strong understanding of aircraft maintenance practices, logbooks, and airworthiness standards   
  • Familiarity with fleet management systems or databases (e.g., Fleet IQ or similar tools)   
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, logistics, and operations teams   
  • Prior experience in a leadership or coordination role within aviation or UAS environments  
  • Experience supporting deployed or expeditionary operations    
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with attention to detail

• Experience with V-BAT or similar UAS platforms   
  • Background in maintenance control, production control, or fleet readiness management   
  • Experience analyzing fleet data and identifying trends to improve reliability and performance   
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments   
  • FAA certifications (A&P, Part 107) or military aviation background (preferred but not required)

lists.content:

Job Description:

Do you thrive at the intersection of high-stakes execution and advanced technology? Shield AI is seeking a Director of Production to lead our U.S.-based manufacturing operations and help scale the future of autonomous defense systems. You’ll drive execution across factory floor operations, partner cross-functionally with quality, engineering and supply chain teams, and ensure our production systems are ready for what’s next. 
 
We're looking for a bold, hands-on leader who can inspire teams, architect production systems, and scale operations with intensity, precision, and a clear mission in mind.

lists.content:
• Architect and execute forward-looking production plans that balance scale, agility, and quality—all while meeting demanding cost and delivery goals.
  • Drive aircraft production capabilities, implementing systems, processes, and staffing to support rapid growth.
  • Lead high-performance teams across production operations, driving excellence through clear expectations, coaching, and accountability.
  • Collaborate deeply with quality, engineering, supply chain, and customer operations to integrate design, sourcing, and production workflows.
  • Champion continuous improvement across every dimension of production: throughput, takt, quality, and cost.
  • Embed data-driven decision-making into daily operations using KPI dashboards, metrics reviews, and operational cadences.
  • Drive the adoption of automation, digitization, and advanced manufacturing methods to future-proof our operations.
  • Serve as a trusted voice to executive leadership—reporting insights, flagging risks, and translating complexity into action.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, or related field; Master’s preferred.
  • 10+ years of production leadership in advanced manufacturing environments (aerospace, automotive, or similar).
  • Proven experience building and scaling a manufacturing operation.
  • 5+ years leading large teams in high-precision, high-throughput settings.
  • Success managing complex outsourced manufacturing or tiered vendor ecosystems.
  • Deep knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies—and a passion for driving results through them.
  • Exceptional communicator, able to navigate executive-level reporting and cross-functional alignment. 
  • A systems thinker with hands-on grit, capable of zooming between strategic planning and operational execution.

jobs.description: Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We are building the world’s best AI pilot and the aircraft that enable autonomy at scale. Our technology operates in complex, contested environments where GPS and communications may be denied, degraded, or unavailable. The technology we build demands cross-functional teaming and collaborative execution to solve the hardest problems in autonomy, aerospace engineering, and robotics. Engineers at Shield AI do not work in silos — they work shoulder-to-shoulder across disciplines to rapidly move from concept to flight-ready systems deployed in the real world. X-BAT represents the next generation of autonomous airpower: a runway-independent, AI-piloted aircraft designed to execute missions in highly contested environments. As Director of Aerostructures for X-BAT, you will lead the strategy, architecture, development, integration, and scaling of advanced aircraft structures across one of the most ambitious autonomous aviation programs in the industry. You will oversee multidisciplinary structural engineering teams responsible for metallic and composite primary structures, subsystem integration, manufacturability, structural analysis, and flight-worthy execution from prototype through production. This role requires a technically elite aerospace leader who thrives in fast-moving environments, can build and scale high-performing engineering organizations, and is energized by solving complex problems that directly impact national security.

Job Description:

Shield AI was founded to protect service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We are building the world’s best AI pilot and the aircraft that enable autonomy at scale. Our technology operates in complex, contested environments where GPS and communications may be denied, degraded, or unavailable.

The technology we build demands cross-functional teaming and collaborative execution to solve the hardest problems in autonomy, aerospace engineering, and robotics. Engineers at Shield AI do not work in silos — they work shoulder-to-shoulder across disciplines to rapidly move from concept to flight-ready systems deployed in the real world.  

X-BAT represents the next generation of autonomous airpower: a runway-independent, AI-piloted aircraft designed to execute missions in highly contested environments. Powered by Hivemind, Shield AI’s combat-proven autonomy stack, X-BAT combines long-range performance, survivability, and autonomous mission execution into a scalable operational platform.  

As Director of Aerostructures for X-BAT, you will lead the strategy, architecture, development, integration, and scaling of advanced aircraft structures across one of the most ambitious autonomous aviation programs in the industry. You will oversee multidisciplinary structural engineering teams responsible for metallic and composite primary structures, subsystem integration, manufacturability, structural analysis, and flight-worthy execution from prototype through production.

This role requires a technically elite aerospace leader who thrives in fast-moving environments, can build and scale high-performing engineering organizations, and is energized by solving complex problems that directly impact national security.

Job Description:

We are seeking a hands-on engineering leader to direct multiple teams spanning electrical design engineering, avionics root cause analysis, and avionics build/test operations. In this role, you will own the technical health and reliability of the avionics systems powering the V-BAT platform — leading the people, processes, and designs that take issues from field observation through root cause resolution and durable design improvement. You will operate at the intersection of design, manufacturing, quality, and fleet support, and you will be measured by the reliability, performance, and manufacturability of what your teams deliver.

lists.content:
• Lead and grow the team. Mentor and develop a multidisciplinary organization of electrical design engineers, root cause analysis engineers, and avionics build/test technicians, building career paths and technical depth across all three disciplines.
  • Set direction and drive execution. Establish team priorities, allocate resources against competing demands, and drive execution while fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Stay technical. Actively contribute to design development and reviews, hands-on root cause analysis, and the definition and validation of corrective actions — leading by technical example, not just management.
  • Own investigations end to end. Lead cross-functional failure investigations, establish and verify corrective and preventive actions, and build tooling and infrastructure that accelerate debugging, test, and issue resolution.
  • Improve system reliability. Drive coordination across Supply Chain, Reliability, Manufacturing, Quality, and Fleet Support to implement the processes and design changes that measurably increase the reliability and availability of the V-BAT system.
  • Build the standard. Establish the standards, review cadences, and metrics (e.g., reliability growth, escape rates, time-to-resolution) that make technical quality repeatable and scalable as the program grows.

• B.S. in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent technical field.
  • 10+ years of experience, including demonstrated success leading and growing teams of electrical engineers.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing technical teams.
  • Experience working cross-functionally across design, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, and fleet/field support.
  • Proven ability to plan and execute complex electronic and electrical designs in a high-consequence industry (defense, aerospace, automotive, or medical device).
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership development environment with rapidly evolving priorities.

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering.
  • Experience with structured problem-solving and failure analysis methods such as fault tree analysis, fishbone/Ishikawa diagrams, FMEA/FMECA, 8D, or similar.
  • Ownership of full product development lifecycles — from concept through release, production ramp, customer sustainment, and product retirement.
  • Experience in UAV/UAS design or other autonomous or unmanned systems.
  • Familiarity with reliability engineering practices (reliability growth modeling, MTBF/MTBUR analysis, accelerated life testing).

Job Description:

Shape Shield AI’s strategy for the international release and deployment of advanced autonomy, aircraft, and AI-enabled technologies. The Director will lead policy engagement with the U.S. Government and allied partners on technology security, foreign disclosure, security cooperation, and security assistance—creating pathways for Shield AI capabilities to support U.S. and allied national security objectives worldwide.

lists.content:
Technology Security & Foreign Disclosure Strategy

  • Develop company strategy for technology security and foreign disclosure across Shield AI products, capabilities, countries, and international programs.
  • Identify technology-release considerations early and develop pathways for the responsible international release of advanced autonomy, aircraft, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Advise leadership and program teams on releasability, partner considerations, geopolitical risks, and U.S. Government policy affecting international opportunities.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to translate complex technical capabilities into clear technology-security and foreign-disclosure strategies.

    • Interagency Engagement & Policy Shaping

  • Build trusted relationships across DoD, State, NSC staff, military departments, combatant commands, and other stakeholders involved in technology security, foreign disclosure, and international defense partnerships.
  • Represent Shield AI in policy discussions concerning the international release of autonomous systems, AI-enabled capabilities, and next-generation aircraft.
  • Develop persuasive policy positions, white papers, and senior-level briefings that demonstrate how Shield AI technologies advance U.S. national security, coalition, and partner objectives.
  • Anticipate emerging policy issues surrounding autonomous and AI-enabled technologies and help shape government approaches to their international release.

    • Security Cooperation & International Strategy

  • Help position Shield AI capabilities within U.S. security cooperation and security assistance frameworks.
  • Advise international campaigns on interagency decision-making, partner requirements, regional considerations, and technology-release strategy.
  • Align international opportunities with U.S. defense and foreign policy priorities and allied capability requirements.
  • Coordinate across Policy, Business Development, Legal, Engineering, Product, and Programs to establish unified strategies for priority international opportunities.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of experience in national security policy, technology security, foreign disclosure, security cooperation, security assistance, international defense policy, or related government engagement.
  • Significant experience working in or with the U.S. national security interagency.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. Government decision-making around international defense partnerships, technology release, security cooperation, and security assistance.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex interagency processes and build trusted relationships with senior government, military, technical, and operational stakeholders.
  • Strong strategic communication skills, including development of persuasive policy narratives, senior-level briefings, and decision materials.
  • Ability to understand sophisticated defense technologies and translate technical capabilities into policy and national security considerations.

• Experience serving in a U.S. Government security cooperation, security assistance, technology security, foreign disclosure, or international defense role.
  • Experience as a Foreign Area Officer (FAO), Security Cooperation Officer, Defense Attaché, Country Director, Foreign Disclosure Officer, or in a comparable regional or international security role.
  • Experience working with DoD, State, DSCA, military departments, combatant commands, NSC staff, or U.S. embassies.
  • Familiarity with Foreign Military Sales, security cooperation, technology security, and foreign disclosure processes.
  • Experience influencing U.S. Government policy concerning the international release of advanced defense technologies.
  • Experience working with allied and partner governments on defense capability development or technology release.
  • Comfort working with engineers, operators, and product teams on advanced autonomy, AI, aircraft, and other emerging technologies.
  • Advanced degree in international affairs, national security, public policy, law, or a related field.
