Our Flight Integration Engineers are essential to bridging the gap between R&D and deployment, ensuring that autonomous systems function reliably and effectively when and where they are needed most.

lists.content:
• System Integration & Deployment — Integrate autonomy software onto unmanned aircraft systems, ensuring seamless operation across onboard compute, sensors, and control interfaces.
  • Pre-flight Preparation — Own the build, configuration, and validation process for flight-ready systems; coordinate hardware/software compatibility and mission readiness.
  • On-site Flight Test Support — Travel to test sites and support live flight operations, including safety checks, system bring-up, and troubleshooting under time-critical constraints.
  • Hardware/Software Debugging — Diagnose and resolve integration issues across complex autonomy software stacks and embedded systems in lab and field environments.
  • Flight Data Capture & Analysis — Manage data collection during missions and post-test analysis, working with autonomy engineers to refine behaviors and identify improvements.
  • Collaboration Across Teams — Work closely with autonomy, GNC, systems, and test teams to ensure mission-critical functionality is delivered on time and validated thoroughly.
  • Continuous Improvement — Build tools and processes to improve integration timelines, flight test reliability, and team efficiency across deployment cycles.
  • Support Certification and Compliance — Assist with documentation and system-level validation required for certification, airworthiness, and compliance in defense-relevant environments.
  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 30-40% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience 
  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 4 years and a Master’s degree; or 2 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and experience working with embedded systems, shell scripting, and system diagnostics.
  • Knowledge of sensor integration, sensor fusion, and middleware frameworks (e.g., ROS, DDS).
  • Hands-on experience supporting flight demos or live exercises.
  • Experience with simulation tools and environments (e.g., AFSIM, NGTS) for testing and validation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance.

• Direct experience supporting unmanned aerial systems or similar flight test campaigns.
  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, flight control systems, or GNC pipelines.
  • Competence in sensor integration, electronics debugging, or avionics bring-up.
  • Proficiency in developing automation tools for system testing, logging, and data parsing.
  • Comfortable interfacing with DoD stakeholders during field events or technical reviews.
  • Experience with UCI and OMS Standards.

Job Description: 

We are seeking for skilled, experienced embedded software engineers with relevant experience in C++ in embedded systems to join our X-BAT Embedded Software Team focused on developing complex avionics software that merges hardware and embedded applications for cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV). 

The Embedded Software Engineer works with in a high pace environment with a cross-functional team of program stakeholders, electrical engineers, Guidance, Navigation and Controls (GNC) engineers, systems engineers, test engineers and the autonomy team, to design and develop software systems which utilize modern aerospace sensors, state-of-the-art UAV avionics.

lists.content:
• Develop high-quality C/C++ code tailored specifically for X-Bat aircraft, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and safety.  
  • Participate in architecture, design, and code reviews  
  • Integrate software from multiple departments to include firmware, software test and verification, Autonomy AI, and Ground Control Stations (GCS)  
  • Develop software systems to implement and integrate interfaces to modern avionics sensors, sub-systems, and payloads  
  • Facilitate the design process for updates to the software system architecture   
  • Use modern software development tools and processes to capture our existing architecture and design future architectures  
  • Collaborating to define and extend systems engineering processes   
  • Report status, risks, accomplishments, expectations to senior leadership     
  • Design and implement systems capable of conducting tests across various environments, including virtualized hardware and hardware-in-the-loop simulations, to facilitate thorough evaluation of software functionality and performance.  
  • Develop innovative tools to enhance the frequency and reliability of software deployment, test execution, and data analysis within a continuous integration and release system, fostering improved efficiency and productivity in software development workflows.  
  • Create prototypes to validate critical design concepts and assess technical limitations, providing tangible evidence of feasibility and informing decision-making processes.

• Strong embedded software development experience in C/C++.  
  • Strong understand of Oriented Object Programming and modern C++ features. 
  • Strong knowledge of embedded software, BSPs or other systems software components. 
  • Good understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, and network protocols fundamentals. 
  • Demonstrated track record of assuming ownership over development processes and features and delivering outstanding outcomes. 
  • Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including architecture, detailed designs, and test plans. 
  • Proven track record of successfully shipping products, showcasing the ability to navigate through development cycles, overcome obstacles, and deliver high-quality solutions to meet project deadlines and exceed client expectations in a fast-paced environment   
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement within software development projects, demonstrating initiative to propose and implement innovative solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and overall project success and X-Bat reliability   
  • B.S., M.S, PhD degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science or STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) discipline, such as Aerospace, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering 
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Proven background in thriving within fast-paced environments, within startup or R&D settings. 
  • Proven experience in development of military aircrafts.  
  • Compliance with DO-178C 
  • Demonstrated adaptability, agility, and the ability to innovate under pressure to meet dynamic project demands and drive successful outcomes. 
  • Familiar with FPGA development using SystemVerilog.  
  • Real Time Operating System (RTOS) experience.

lists.content:
• Lead integration of Hivemind autonomy onto expeditionary and expeditionary operations platforms.  
  • Develop and maintain software interfaces between autonomy, vehicle subsystems, autopilots, payloads, mission computers, and platform services.  
  • Configure Linux mission-computing environments, middleware, containers, and deployment pipelines.  
  • Integrate sensors, payloads, radios, tactical networks, ground control stations, and mission systems.  
  • Develop reusable platform onboarding frameworks, interface adapters, and deployment mechanisms.  
  • Support SIL, HIL, VIL, and representative integration environments to reduce integration risk before flight.
  • Lead debugging across hardware, embedded software, networking, and autonomy interfaces.  
  • Support demonstrations, exercises, surrogate operations, and customer events.  
  • Coordinate integration activities across autonomy, systems engineering, flight test, program leadership, and external partners.  
  • Mentor junior engineers and drive engineering best practices.

• BS in Computer Science, Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical Engineering or related field.  
  • 4–7 years of experience in integration and testing of robotics, autonomy, aerospace, or similar complex systems. 
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS). 
  • Proficiency in Linux-based development. 
  • Experience integrating complex software systems with vehicle platforms, mission computing environments, payloads, sensors, and communications systems. 
  • Experience with sensor integration and middleware framework like ROS. 
  • Hands-on experience supporting field tests, demonstrations, or operational events.  
  • Strong systems engineering and troubleshooting skills.  
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.

• Experience with flight control systems such as ArduPilot or PX4. 
  • Experience with unmanned aerial systems (fixed-wing, quadrotor, or both)  
  • Background in autonomy, robotics, or aerospace systems  
  • Familiarity with flight controllers, radios, and communications systems 
  • CI/CD experience

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Structural Analyst to support the structural analysis and testing of advanced UAVs. In this role, you will work closely with Mechanical, Systems, Propulsion, and Aerospace Engineers to ensure the structural integrity of our lightweight, high-performance aircraft. You will contribute to the design, analysis, testing, and optimization of airframe structures and components, ensuring they meet performance, weight, and safety requirements.
 
This role is ideal for engineers with 5+ years of experience looking to gain expertise in finite element analysis (FEA), composite materials, mechanical testing, and aircraft loads analysis in a fast-paced, high-tech aerospace environment.

lists.content:
• Assist in building and refining finite element models (FEM) to evaluate the structural performance of UAV components.
  • Perform static, modal, fatigue, and vibration analyses to assess stress, deformation, and durability.
  • Conduct hand calculations to validate FEA results, ensuring accuracy and structural reliability.
  • Work with design engineers to optimize airframe structures, balancing weight, strength, and manufacturability.
  • Support the development of test plans for structural validation, including quasi-static, vibration, and shock testing.
  • Analyze flight telemetry and structural test data to improve modeling accuracy and correlate predictions with real-world performance.
  • Assist in defining load cases, material properties, and design margins for UAV airframe and mechanical components.
  • Document and present structural analysis reports and technical recommendations to engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure structural requirements align with system performance goals.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of structural analysis methodologies, tools, and best practices.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in structural analysis, finite element modeling, or aircraft loads analysis.
  • Experience with FEA tools (ANSYS, NASTRAN, HyperWorks, or similar).
  • Strong ability to perform hand calculations for structural strength, stability, and fatigue analysis.
  • Knowledge of composite materials and lightweight aerospace structures.
  • Familiarity with mechanical testing methods (static, vibration, and fatigue).
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools (Excel, MATLAB, Python, or similar).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to get a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Master’s degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.
  • Experience in aircraft structural design, UAV airframe development, or aerospace testing.
  • Hands-on experience with structural testing, modal analysis, or composite modeling.
  • Exposure to CAD software (NX, SolidWorks) and PLM tools (Teamcenter or similar).
  • Understanding of aerospace industry standards, structural certification processes, and material selection.

lists.content:

  • Map the market: Develop comprehensive talent landscapes by company, skillset, geography, and organizational structure; identify hidden talent pools, competitor insights, and emerging talent trends to inform recruiting strategy and workforce planning.
  • Generate and engage: Use advanced Boolean search techniques, sourcing platforms, and creative sourcing channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, HireEZ, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, engineering communities, niche aerospace networks, conferences, referrals, and more) to identify, engage, and attract exceptional technical talent.
  • Build pipelines proactively: Cultivate long-term relationships with passive, cleared, and highly specialized engineering talent to enable just-in-time hiring across strategic programs.
  • Leverage AI to scale sourcing: Design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered sourcing workflows, research agents, and practical automations that increase recruiter productivity, accelerate candidate discovery, enhance market intelligence, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Build repeatable sourcing systems: Use AI tools and workflow automation to create structured market maps, talent intelligence reports, outreach content, sourcing documentation, and scalable recruiting processes that can be leveraged across the Talent Acquisition organization.
  • Be the sourcing SME: Serve as the subject matter expert on technical sourcing by coaching recruiters and hiring managers on market insights, sourcing strategy, talent availability, competitive intelligence, candidate engagement best practices, and emerging recruiting technologies.
  • Partner for impact: Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition Operations, Employer Brand, University Recruiting, and Engineering leaders to optimize recruiting strategies, outbound messaging, candidate experience, and operational excellence.
  • Track and iterate: Use recruiting analytics, experimentation, and storytelling to measure sourcing effectiveness, optimize outreach strategies, improve conversion rates, and continuously evolve sourcing practices.

• 8+ years of technical sourcing experience, ideally in aerospace, defense, autonomy, or other complex hardware/software industries.
  • Proven track record in market mapping, competitive intelligence, and candidate generation for highly specialized technical roles.
  • Deep expertise in advanced Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, HireEZ, SeekOut, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, and other modern sourcing platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a consultative partner to recruiters, hiring managers, and senior engineering leaders, influencing hiring strategy through market insights and talent intelligence.
  • Hands-on experience building or leveraging AI-powered sourcing workflows, agentic AI tools, workflow automations, or practical AI solutions that improve recruiting or business processes.
  • Direct experience using AI development environments or coding assistants (such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar tools) to create repeatable sourcing workflows, structured research outputs, market intelligence, process automation, or operational documentation.
  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with passive, cleared, or niche engineering talent.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills with the ability to engage highly technical candidates and influence stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies to improve recruiting outcomes.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and able to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

• Prior experience supporting aerospace, robotics, autonomy, AI/ML, or advanced vehicle engineering organizations.
  • Experience navigating export control, ITAR, EAR, or security-cleared recruiting environments.
  • Familiarity with Ashby and recruiting analytics, CRM, or talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-growth, venture-backed technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated passion for staying ahead of emerging recruiting technologies, sourcing methodologies, and AI advancements.

lists.content:
Security Operations & Program Execution 

  • Execute daily collateral security operations in a high-growth environment  
  • Maintain daily classified document control, accountability, and safeguarding  
  • Support classified facility operations and Restricted Areas  

    • Personnel Security & Onboarding 

  • Process badge requests and issuance with accuracy and timeliness  
  • Facilitate weekly local new hire orientation and onboarding  
  • Present New Hire Security Training as required  

    • Foreign Visits & External Engagements 

  • Daily processing, disclosure, and hosting of foreign visits in accordance with NISPOM  
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure compliant execution  
  • Support classified meetings hosting  

    • Restricted Area (RA) & Access Control 

  • Perform daily Restricted Area maintenance and access control management  
  • Enforce entry/exit procedures and access requirements  
  • Execute end-of-day Restricted Area security procedures  

    • Technology Control & Compliance 

  • Process Technology Control Plans (TCPs) in support of Corporate FSO  
  • Support ITAR/EAR compliance and controlled technology safeguards  

    • Incident Response & Operations 

  • Respond to local alarms, GSOC alerts, and security incidents  
  • Provide immediate response to outages and emergent issues  
  • Document and report incidents in accordance with policy  

    • Classified Handling & Logistics 

  • Manage classified shipping and receiving  
  • Maintain accountability and proper transfer procedures for classified materials  

    • COMSEC & Security Support 

  • Serve as Alternate Collateral COMSEC Officer  
  • Support COMSEC accountability, handling, and compliance requirements  

    • Cross-Functional Partnership 

  • Act as a trusted security partner to internal teams  
  • Provide guidance on security requirements, reporting obligations, and best practices

  • Working knowledge of NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117)

Job Description:

The Senior Global Shipping & Receiving Specialist is responsible for executing and coordinating domestic and international shipping, receiving, inventory control, export compliance, import operations, and warehouse activities supporting Product Delivery, Manufacturing, Sustainment, and Customer Operations. This position serves as a subject matter expert for global logistics operations and ensures the timely, compliant, and efficient movement of equipment, parts, and customer deliveries worldwide.

lists.content:
• Execute domestic and international shipments via parcel, LTL, FTL, air freight, ocean freight, and hand-carry operations.
  • Coordinate import and export activities with freight forwarders, customs brokers, government agencies, and internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare and review commercial invoices, packing lists, EEI filings, AES filings, export licenses, carnets, certificates of origin, and other shipping documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with ITAR, EAR, DG regulations, customs requirements, and company policies.
  • Support customer deliveries, field deployments, demonstrations, sustainment activities, and international programs.
  • Coordinate Dangerous Goods (DG) shipments, including lithium battery compliance and hazardous material documentation.
  • Receive, inspect, process, and inventory incoming materials and customer returns.
  • Maintain accurate inventory transactions within ERP/WMS systems.
  • Investigate shipment delays, customs holds, inventory discrepancies, and logistics-related issues.
  • Partner with Product Delivery, Manufacturing, Engineering, Procurement, Trade Compliance, and Program Management teams to support operational objectives.
  • Assist with development and implementation of logistics processes, work instructions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Train and mentor junior Shipping & Receiving Specialists and support cross-functional logistics training.
  • Support warehouse organization, inventory accuracy, cycle counts, and material handling operations.
  • Provide shipment status updates and logistics reporting to leadership and program teams.

• 5+ years of experience in shipping, receiving, logistics, supply chain, warehouse operations, or international transportation.
  • Experience supporting international shipments and customs processes.
  • Knowledge of export control regulations, including ITAR and EAR.
  • Experience working with freight carriers, customs brokers, and freight forwarders.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems and inventory management processes.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to lift and move materials up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required security clearances or export authorizations.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or related field.
  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, military, or government programs.
  • Dangerous Goods (IATA/IMDG/49 CFR) certification experience.
  • Experience with ATA Carnets, temporary imports/exports, and international demonstrations.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement experience.
  • Forklift certification or warehouse equipment experience.

• Serve as a logistics subject matter expert.
  • Mentor junior team members and provide day-to-day guidance.
  • Drive process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and customer-focused decision making.
  • Partner across departments to resolve complex logistics and compliance challenges.

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Hardware in the Loop Lab Technician to support the fabrication, instrumentation, and testing of new aerospace products. This role is ideal for a hands-on builder who thrives in dynamic environments, has deep experience working with aircraft systems and fabrication methods, and has a background building and maintaining a Systems Integration Lab.

You will be a key contributor in helping bring cutting-edge designs to life, playing a vital role in everything from early-stage prototype development to detailed testing and validation of final assemblies.

lists.content:
• Construct and assemble air vehicle systems and subsystems such as landing gear, mechanisms, fluid systems, test articles in alignment with engineering drawings, engineering instructions, and CAD models.
  • Support the design, prototyping, and fabrication of new products, R&D initiatives, and flight-ready hardware.
  • Work with aerospace-grade materials and perform component repairs using industry-standard techniques and tools.
  • Fabricate fixtures, machine brackets, and execute rapid modifications on prototype hardware as needed.
  • Install strain gauges, thermocouples and various sensors according to precise instrumentation schematics.
  • Route cabling, integrate data acquisition systems, and verify sensor calibration and operational status.
  • Conduct mechanical testing by applying static and dynamic loads per detailed engineering procedures.
  • Document test outcomes clearly and report anomalies or irregularities in a timely manner.
  • Ensure a clean, organized, and safe workspace across shop, lab, and composite work areas.
  • Contribute to ongoing improvements in instrumentation standards, testing procedures, and fabrication workflows.
  • Source and manage inventory for parts and equipment needed for component repair or replacement.

• 4-6 years of experience in aircraft/Lab maintenance, prototype fabrication, test stand design & fabrication.
  • Proficient in metallic and mechanisms fabrication, installation & removal.
  • Hands-on experience in machine shop operations, including manual and/or CNC tools.
  • Ability to read engineering drawings, schematics, and detailed work instructions.
  • Comfortable working in shop and lab environments with exposure to noise, dust, and chemicals.
  • Ability to lift and move parts and equipment (up to 50 lbs.) and perform physical work for extended periods.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret level security clearance.

• Familiarity with a variety of mechanical systems (e.g., hydraulic actuators, pumps, fluids, load frames, DAQ systems).
  • Familiarity with a variety of electrical systems (e.g., cable harness checkouts, electrical connections, power requirements).
  • Experience in aerospace, automotive, defense, or high-performance prototyping environments.
  • Able to work independently and adapt quickly to changing technical needs.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with evolving priorities 
  • A demonstrated record of working hard, being trustworthy, holding yourself to high standards, and being kind to others

lists.content:
Lead and Scale the Customer Success Function

  • Establish and lead the Aircraft Division Customer Success function supporting V-BAT and X-BAT customers across U.S. government, allied defense, and strategic commercial accounts.
  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers responsible for customer adoption, operational readiness, mission value, and long-term account success.
  • Define team structure, roles, responsibilities, account assignments, performance expectations, and career development plans.
  • Recruit and onboard Customer Success talent as the customer base and Aircraft Division continue to grow.
  • Set team priorities and allocate resources based on customer risk, strategic importance, operational activity, and business needs.
  • Establish measurable team and individual goals and conduct regular performance evaluations, coaching, and development discussions.
  • Build a culture of urgency, accountability, professionalism, transparency, operational excellence, and customer advocacy.

    • Build the Customer Success Operating Model

  • Develop and operate a scalable Customer Success model that includes account segmentation, customer health scoring, success plans, engagement cadence, executive business reviews, and lifecycle governance.
  • Ensure priority customers have documented success plans tied to mission outcomes, readiness objectives, adoption milestones, training requirements, sustainment needs, and executive stakeholder alignment.
  • Establish standards for customer onboarding, operational transition, training coordination, sustainment handoffs, adoption management, and recurring mission-value reviews.
  • Create repeatable processes, templates, playbooks, and governance mechanisms that allow the Customer Success organization to scale.
  • Define clear ownership and operating rhythms across Customer Success, Deployment Operations, Flight Operations, Training, Sustainment, Program Management, Sales, Product, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Mission Operations.
  • Partner with Aircraft Operations leadership to establish organizational priorities, resource requirements, operating plans, and functional performance goals.

    • Lead the Critical Accounts Program

  • Own and operate the Aircraft Division Critical Accounts Program for escalated, at-risk, high-priority, or strategically sensitive customers.
  • Define Critical Accounts Program entry criteria, severity levels, account-health triggers, escalation paths, executive engagement requirements, and exit criteria.
  • Lead cross-functional critical-account reviews with clear owners, recovery plans, decision logs, customer communication strategies, risk-reduction actions, and measurable closure criteria.
  • Assign and hold internal owners accountable for recovery actions, commitments, and due dates.
  • Ensure the appropriate technical, operational, sustainment, supply, quality, program, and executive resources are engaged based on the severity and mission impact of each account.
  • Provide senior leadership with concise, action-oriented visibility into customer risk, mission impact, customer sentiment, commercial exposure, and recovery status.
  • Personally support customer engagements involving significant operational risk, executive attention, or strategic importance.
  • Conduct post-recovery reviews to ensure root causes are addressed and lessons learned are incorporated into products, processes, training, sustainment, and support.

    • Advocate for Customer Mission Success

  • Serve as a senior customer advocate for V-BAT and X-BAT customers and ensure Shield AI understands their missions, operating environments, readiness expectations, adoption barriers, and long-term objectives.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior military, government, operational, and enterprise stakeholders.
  • Translate customer feedback into clear product, support, training, documentation, sustainment, and operational requirements.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Training, Sustainment, and Business Development to resolve customer issues and implement permanent corrective actions.
  • Ensure customer feedback, operational lessons, and recurring issues are incorporated into product and service improvement priorities.
  • Support strategic customer engagements, demonstrations, exercises, operational deployments, executive briefings, and business reviews as needed.
  • Identify risks and opportunities that could affect customer retention, mission success, future adoption, or account growth.

    • Establish Metrics and Executive Visibility

  • Own Customer Success dashboards, account-health assessments, risk registers, success plans, Critical Accounts Program reporting, and executive operating reviews.
  • Define and track indicators including mission readiness, product adoption, training progress, fleet availability, support responsiveness, issue aging, customer sentiment, renewal or expansion risk, and executive engagement.
  • Establish regular reporting cadences that clearly communicate customer outcomes, emerging risks, functional performance, resource constraints, and required leadership decisions.
  • Use customer and operational data to identify trends, recurring problems, systemic risks, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
  • Measure the effectiveness of the Customer Success organization and continuously improve team processes, tools, and operating rhythms.

• 10+ years of experience in customer success, customer operations, account management, program management, field operations, professional services, aviation operations, defense technology, aerospace, or mission-critical enterprise technology.
  • 5+ years of experience leading customer-facing, account management, support, field operations, program management, or Customer Success teams.
  • Demonstrated experience hiring, managing, coaching, and developing high-performing teams.
  • Experience building or scaling a Customer Success, customer operations, account management, or similar customer-facing function.
  • Demonstrated success managing escalated, at-risk, executive-level, or mission-critical customer accounts.
  • Experience operating structured escalation, customer-health, critical-account, executive-governance, or customer-recovery processes.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with senior military, government, enterprise, and internal executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to establish strategy while remaining actively engaged in customer execution and issue resolution.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity, urgency, conflict, and high operational stakes.
  • Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, adoption, operational readiness, sustainment, support, renewals, and expansion.
  • Experience defining performance metrics, operating cadences, team objectives, and executive reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive briefings, account plans, recovery plans, and leadership updates.
  • Ability to travel up to 15% and work effectively with customers and teams in operational, field, and headquarters environments.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

• Experience in defense, aerospace, autonomous systems, aviation, unmanned aircraft systems, software-defined systems, military operations, or operational technology deployed in austere environments.
  • Experience supporting the Department of Defense, U.S. military services, allied defense organizations, or government customers.
  • Experience with vertical takeoff and landing unmanned aircraft systems, aviation operations, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, mission systems, autonomy, deployed operations, aircraft sustainment, or mission-critical field operations.
  • Prior military service or direct experience working with operational military units.
  • Experience designing or operating Critical Accounts Programs, enterprise escalation frameworks, technical account management programs, Customer Success operations, or executive sponsor programs.
  • Experience managing customer-facing organizations supporting both hardware and software products.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Jira, Confluence, Tableau, Power BI, or similar customer success, support, and reporting systems.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager, U.S. Facilities to lead facility operations across a rapidly expanding national portfolio. The role is accountable for the performance of U.S. sites after project turnover, including regional and site operations, maintenance and asset reliability, workplace services, vendor delivery, budgets, customer experience, and operational risk. 

This is a hands-on national leadership role. The successful candidate will establish clear regional accountability, standardize service delivery without losing local responsiveness, develop internal talent, and build strong operating partnerships with Manufacturing, Engineering, Px, IT, EH&S, Security, Real Estate, Capital Delivery, Finance, and Procurement. The leader must be equally comfortable in an executive review, on a manufacturing floor, and in a facility incident response.

lists.content:
NATIONAL AND REGIONAL OPERATIONS LEADERSHIP 

  • Own day-to-day and lifecycle performance across the U.S. facilities portfolio after formal project turnover. 
  • Establish and lead a regional operating model across West, Central, and East locations with clear site accountability and escalation paths. 
  • Develop annual site operating plans, service models, staffing approaches, and priorities based on site tier, mission criticality, hours of operation, and risk. 
  • Serve as the senior U.S. escalation point for facility reliability, workplace service, landlord, vendor, and site-continuity issues. 

    • RELIABILITY, MAINTENANCE, AND ASSET MANAGEMENT 

  • Establish consistent asset registers, preventive-maintenance programs, work-order practices, critical-spares strategies, and lifecycle-risk visibility. 
  • Set and monitor service levels for critical systems, maintenance, employee requests, and workplace services. 
  • Identify infrastructure risks early and develop operating, maintenance, or capital recommendations with the appropriate functional owner. 
  • Drive root-cause analysis and durable corrective action for recurring failures, outages, backlogs, and service issues. 

    • PEOPLE, VENDORS, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE 

  • Lead, coach, and develop regional and site Facilities teammates; establish clear roles, goals, and performance expectations. 
  • Manage IFM and specialist providers through scopes, service levels, scorecards, performance reviews, corrective actions, and renewal recommendations. 
  • Create a consistent workplace and customer-service experience while adapting delivery to manufacturing, engineering, office, hangar, and classified environments. 
  • Build trusted relationships with site leaders and business partners; translate business demand into clear operating plans and service requirements. 

    • FINANCIAL AND OPERATIONAL GOVERNANCE 

  • Own the U.S. Facilities operating plan, budget inputs, forecast, variance explanations, and resource recommendations in partnership with the Global Facilities Leader and Finance. 
  • Maintain a U.S. site risk register, vendor-performance view, critical-action plan, and forward-looking capacity and lifecycle concerns. 
  • Use common KPIs and operating reviews to manage performance, prioritize resources, and escalate material decisions. 
  • Ensure vendors, purchase orders, invoices, contracts, and operating commitments follow Finance, Procurement, and delegation requirements. 

    • LIFECYCLE INTEGRATION AND RISK PARTNERSHIP 

  • Provide operational requirements during site selection, design, and project delivery; participate in design reviews, commissioning, readiness, and move planning. 
  • Formally accept or reject project turnover against documented criteria, then lead post-occupancy stabilization and defect closure. 
  • Partner with EH&S and Security to implement standards, address findings, coordinate incidents, and maintain emergency and continuity readiness. 
  • Coordinate with Real Estate on lease obligations and capacity, while preserving Real Estate ownership of portfolio strategy and transactions.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in facilities management, engineering, operations, construction, business, or a related field. 
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in facilities management, integrated facilities management, corporate real estate operations, engineering operations, or a comparable field. 
  • 5+ years leading complex multi-site or regional operations, including direct people leadership and management of outsourced service providers. 
  • Experience operating facilities that support manufacturing, engineering, laboratories, aviation, critical infrastructure, secure environments, or other technically complex work. 
  • Demonstrated ownership of operating budgets, forecasts, contracts, vendor performance, service levels, and facility risk. 
  • Strong working knowledge of maintenance, building systems, preventive maintenance, work-order management, asset lifecycle, and incident response. 
  • Proven ability to build teams, standardize operations, and drive accountability across geographically dispersed locations. 
  • Executive-level communication and judgment, with the ability to translate technical and operational issues into clear business decisions. 
  • Ability to travel frequently across the United States and respond to time-sensitive facility priorities as required.

• Experience in aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing, autonomous systems, technology, or another high-growth regulated environment. 
  • Experience with SCIFs, classified environments, hangars, high-bay spaces, production facilities, or 24/7 critical operations. 
  • Experience establishing a regional operating model or scaling Facilities operations across a rapidly growing portfolio. 
  • Familiarity with CMMS/EAM, IWMS, service-management, building-automation, business-intelligence, and financial systems. 
  • CFM, FMP, CPMM, IFMA, engineering, project-management, or related professional credential. 
  • Experience leading major vendor transitions, IFM sourcing, commissioning, or project turnover. 
  • Current or prior security clearance, or experience operating in controlled-access environments.

The ideal candidate is a visible, credible operations leader who sets high standards and stays close to the work. This person can build structure at national scale while understanding that each site has different mission, technical, workforce, and risk requirements. 

Success requires calm judgment, customer empathy, technical curiosity, financial discipline, and strong people leadership. The leader should earn trust, put the team first, move with rigor and speed, and make prudent use of internal and external resources.

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


Job Description: 
Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager of Mechanical Engineering to build and lead the team responsible for all mechanical design, thermal, and harnessing in the X-BAT aircraft and ground vehicle. You will establish the technical vision, hire top tier engineers, and partner with all other engineer team leads to execute cross-functionally. Extreme ownership is expected where your team will carry designs from concept through manufacturing. Team leads and managers at Shield are expected to have strong technical fundamentals and a history of experience being hands on.

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager of Mechanical Engineering to build and lead the team responsible for all mechanical design, thermal, and harnessing in the X-BAT aircraft and ground vehicle. You will establish the technical vision, hire top tier engineers, and partner with all other engineer team leads to execute cross-functionally. lists.content:
• Be responsible for the architecture and design for all parts of the mechanical system in the X-BAT aircraft and ground vehicle, as they pertain to avionics
  • A small team exists that you will inherit. From there, you will establish leads and sub-managers while growing the team significantly in the immediate and long term
  • While you will not be expected to design as an individual contributor, you must have this experience in your past to establish what "right" looks like for your organization
  • Partner closely with electrical engineering, RF, PCB design, reliability, supply chain, structures, manufacturing and other disciplines to drive full scope product delivery
  • Your team will output complex electro-mechanical solutions for flight critical avionics systems that withstand harsh environments

• B.S. in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering 
  • 10+ years of experience in mechanical design around electronics and electrical systems
  • Strong experience in CAD software (NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, or similar) for 3D modeling, drawing creation, and system layout
  • Experience working with electrical engineers to develop avionics packaging
  • Experience with finite element analysis (FEA), thermal analysis, and fatigue/lifecycle testing 
  • Experience working directly with fabrication shops, contract manufacturers, and suppliers
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with evolving priorities 
  • A demonstrated record of working hard, being trustworthy, holding yourself to high standards, and being kind to others 
  • Ability to obtain a Secret level security clearance

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager, Mechanisms Engineering to support the development of mechanisms for our next-generation autonomous aircraft program. As a contributor on the Launch and Recovery Vehicle team you will lead the design and development of high-performance mechanisms from concept through production release. In this role, you’ll lead and contribute to the development of complex, mission-critical technologies while guiding a talented team to deliver at a high level. Blending hands-on technical work with leadership, you’ll help drive innovation, solve challenging problems, and bring cutting-edge systems from concept to reality.

lists.content:
Functional Excellence:

  • Directly contribute to the design, analysis, and integration of mechanical systems and subsystems for X-BAT Launch and Recovery Vehicle.
  • Establish and improve pragmatic mechanical engineering standards, templates, specifications, and best practices that increase design quality, reduce rework, and enable faster iteration.
  • Own mechanical engineering deliverables across the product lifecycle—from early concept and prototyping through test, production, and field support—with a bias toward execution and delivery.
  • Own failure mode analysis and reliability modeling for mechanical systems, establish lightweight, repeatable practices (e.g., FMEA, fault trees) that proactively identify risks, reduce field failures, and inform design tradeoffs.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Program Management, and Flight Operations to ensure designs are buildable, testable, and reliable in real-world environments.
  • Provide hands-on technical support during ground and flight testing, demos, and field operations; rapidly troubleshoot and implement design fixes under tight timelines.

    • Team Leadership and Development:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of mechanical engineers, providing technical guidance, regular feedback, and clear expectations for ownership and execution.
  • Recruit and hire experienced mechanical engineers to strengthen team capability, elevate technical standards, and improve mentorship depth.
  • Act as a player-coach: balance meaningful individual technical contribution with team leadership, design reviews, and day-to-day unblock of engineers.
  • Establish team norms around accountability, decision-making speed, and engineering rigor—ensuring high-quality output without slowing momentum.
  • Set clear priorities aligned with program goals; actively manage team bandwidth, identify risks early, and communicate tradeoffs to leadership.
  • Drive clear and concise technical communication, ensuring design decisions, assumptions, and tradeoffs are well-documented and understood across functions.

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in mechanical design for aerospace, ground support equipment, or related ruggedized hardware systems.
  • 3+ years of leadership/manger with demonstrated excellence in building, retaining, and leading a high performing engineering team
  • Proficiency in 3D CAD software (NX preferred) with demonstrated ability to create detailed GD&T-compliant component and assembly 3D models and drawings.
  • Proficiency in developing drawing templates/standards, and design/manufacturing specifications. 
  • Familiarity with industry standards (ASME, ISO, ASTM, or industry-specific regulatory requirements).
  • Experience with engineering analysis methods (FEA, stress, thermal, tolerance stack-up, fatigue, fluid flow as applicable) to validate design integrity.
  • Ownership of 2–3 full product development cycles from concept through release to production to on-going customer sustainment.
  • Cross-functional collaboration experience with other Engineering Functions, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Field Operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-ownership development environment with evolving priorities
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• M.S. degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Experience supporting UAV, DoD, or aerospace full vehicle programs.
  • Familiarity with aerospace standards (MIL-STD, ASME Y14.5, FAA).
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes (machining, sheet metal, injection molding, casting, additive manufacturing) and ability to design for manufacturability (DFM)
  • Knowledge of reliability modeling and analysis methods.
  • Experience using FEA tools (ANSYS, Abaqus, NASTRAN, or similar) for linear structural analysis.

As a member of the HMS Perception team, you will conduct software development at the intersection of classical state estimation techniques, sensor fusion, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and machine perception. You will develop cutting-edge technology onto real hardware that provides robust and accurate estimates of vehicle pose and surroundings for real missions. Shield AI is pushing the envelope by applying advanced AI solutions to real hardware systems. An ideal candidate should aspire to be a part of this industry-changing team developing and deploying advanced technology that can truly make an impact. 
 
We are seeking a skilled and motivated leaders with 10+ years of experience to manage a technical team supporting the development, integration, and testing of perception algorithms for advanced aerospace, defense, and robotics systems. lists.content:
• Lead teams across autonomy, integration, and testing by aligning technical efforts, resolving cross-functional challenges, and driving mission-focused execution. Balance hands-on technical oversight with performance optimization, innovation, and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Write production quality software in C++ 
  • Produce an Assured Position, Navigation, and Timing (A-PNT) system to enable reliable autonomy in GNSS-degraded or denied environments 
  • Extend and specialize Shield AI’s state-of-the-art state estimation framework for new sensors, platforms, and missions 
  • Write test code to validate your software with simulated and real-world data 
  • Collaborate with hardware and test teams to validate algorithms/code on aerial platforms 
  • Write analyzers to ingest data and produce statistics to validate code quality 
  • Enhance sensor models within a high-fidelity simulation environment 
  • Work in a fast-paced, collaborative, continuous development environment, enhancing analysis and benchmarking capabilities

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience 
  • Ability to develop, benchmark, debug, and deploy software-based algorithms 
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills by applying a scientific approach 
  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 8 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience
  • 2+ years managing technical teams.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating and working with sensor payloads in the DoD space
  • Proficient with sensor fusion for noisy high-bandwidth exteroceptive sensors on compute-constrained systems
  • A solid foundation in theory related to state estimation, object detection,  data association, probabilistic robotics, and signal processing.
  • Experience working projects with 10+ contributors 
  • Offers Fast, efficient, effective problem solving approaches 
  • Exceptional collaborator and communicator 
  • Comfortability within Unix environments 
  • Hard-working, trustworthy teammate 
  • Exhibits holding themselves and others to high standards 
  • Being kind to others 
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance

• MS or greater in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience 
  • Understanding of robotics technologies related to autonomous behavior development e.g. task allocation or planning. 
  • Understanding/Experience with unmanned system technologies and accompanying algorithms (specifically air domain) 
  • Familiarity with high-fidelity simulation and sensor modeling
  • Working knowledge of Kalman Filter, Factor Graphs and other modern estimator fundamentals.
  • Strong working knowledge of Computer Vision with hands-on experience with OpenCV or similar CV libraries.
  • Experience developing sensor effects (control) algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience developing or implementing state of the art object detection/recognition pipelines.
  • Active SECRET clearance 
  • Experience with UCI and OMS Standards

Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager of Program Finance to lead financial execution, forecasting, and business partnership across key programs. This role will serve as a strategic finance partner to Program Management, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Development, and Executive Leadership.
The ideal candidate has deep experience in defense program finance, thrives in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, and can balance financial rigor with the speed required in a high-growth company. This individual will be responsible for improving visibility into program performance, strengthening forecasting discipline, driving EAC and risk/opportunity processes, and helping program teams make better business decisions.
This is a hands-on leadership role. The Senior Manager will be expected to both lead and execute: building processes where they do not exist, improving existing reporting and financial cadences, and developing a team capable of supporting Shield AI’s continued growth.

lists.content:

Job Description:

The Senior Manager of Quality is responsible for establishing and leading all quality activities for a complex aerospace development program from prototype through production readiness. This role serves as the primary quality leader embedded within the program team and partners closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Flight Test, and Program Management to ensure products are designed, developed, tested, and transitioned to production with quality, reliability, and mission success as foundational objectives.

The Senior Manager of Quality will build and lead a multidisciplinary quality team while implementing scalable quality systems, risk management processes, problem-solving disciplines, and development quality practices appropriate for a rapidly growing aerospace and defense technology organization.

This position requires balancing speed of development with disciplined engineering rigor to support aggressive program schedules while ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and company requirements.

lists.content:
Development Quality Leadership
  • Serve as the quality leader for XBAT development.
  • Establish quality strategy, objectives, and metrics aligned with program milestones.
  • Integrate quality requirements into the product development lifecycle.
  • Ensure quality considerations are incorporated during system architecture, design reviews, verification, validation, and qualification activities.
  • Partner with Engineering leadership to identify and mitigate technical and programmatic risks.
  • Drive a culture of proactive quality and continuous improvement throughout the program.
    • Design & Configuration Quality
  • Ensure quality requirements are appropriately captured in product definitions, specifications, and design documentation.
  • Participate in design reviews, change control boards, and configuration management activities.
  • Ensure full configuration and traceability for all material installed into prototype aircraft.
  • Evaluate engineering changes for quality and production readiness impacts.
  • Support requirements verification and validation planning.
  • Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-quality, and design-for-reliability initiatives.
    • Risk Management & Reliability
  • Lead quality participation in program risk management activities.
  • Establish and maintain FRACAS processes for development and flight test phases of the program.
  • Facilitate root cause and corrective action investigations for design, manufacturing, supplier, and field failures.
  • Support reliability growth planning and execution.
  • Monitor defect trends, failure modes, and reliability metrics to identify systemic risks.
    • Verification, Validation & Test Quality
  • Develop quality oversight strategies for laboratory, ground, and flight test activities.
  • Ensure test results, anomalies, and nonconformances are appropriately documented and dispositioned.
  • Support qualification and certification efforts.
  • Establish processes for managing test escapes, failures, and corrective actions.
    • Nonconformance & Corrective Action Management
  • Lead Material Review Board activities for development hardware.
  • Establish scalable processes for nonconformance management.
  • Drive root cause analysis using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Ensure timely and effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Track effectiveness of corrective actions through closure.
    • Production Readiness & Industrialization
  • Partner with Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams to transition products from prototype to production.
  • Define quality requirements for production readiness reviews.
  • Support development of inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and control strategies.
  • Ensure lessons learned from development are incorporated into production processes.
  • Lead quality planning activities supporting low-rate initial production and rate increases.
    • Quality Management System
  • Develop and implement quality processes supporting aerospace development programs.
  • Ensure compliance with AS9100, customer requirements, and internal procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvement of development quality processes.
  • Support internal and external audits as required.
  • Establish scalable systems that support future production growth.
    • Leadership & Team Development
  • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing quality organization.
  • Recruit and develop quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians.
  • Establish clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and collaboration.
  • Develop organizational capabilities to support future company growth.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, space, or other highly regulated industries.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical quality organizations.
  • Experience supporting complex product development programs from concept through production transition.
  • Strong knowledge of quality systems, engineering development processes, and aerospace manufacturing.
  • Experience leading root cause investigations and corrective action programs.
  • Experience with risk management, reliability engineering, and failure analysis.
  • Working knowledge of AS9100 quality management systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

• Experience supporting UAV, aerospace, defense, aviation, autonomous systems, or advanced technology programs.
  • Experience leading quality organizations during rapid company growth.
  • Background in systems engineering, reliability engineering, or development engineering.
  • Experience with flight test programs and qualification testing.
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent certification.
  • Familiarity with government defense programs and customer quality requirements.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an ambitious, experienced Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting to join our growing Accounting team at one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Defense & Aerospace. This role will lead the end-to-end revenue accounting process, including technical revenue accounting, operational revenue accounting, contract review, monthly close activities, and order-to-cash process design. The Senior Manager will serve as a key revenue accounting leader and cross-functional partner to Legal, Business Development, Revenue Operations, Program Finance, Billing, Collections, and FP&A to ensure revenue is recognized accurately, timely, and in accordance with ASC 606. This role will also help design and scale revenue accounting processes, controls, systems, and workflows to support Shield AI’s continued international growth.

lists.content:
• Lead the end-to-end revenue accounting process, including customer contract review, revenue recognition conclusions, monthly revenue close activities, and operational execution in accordance with ASC 606.
  • Lead the preparation and review of revenue-related journal entries, ensuring entries are accurate, complete, appropriately supported, and aligned with company accounting policies.
  • Review revenue-related account reconciliations, including deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, contract assets, contract liabilities, accounts receivable, and other order-to-cash related balances.
  • Manage and lead the preparation, review, and approval of customer contracts, ensuring appropriate revenue recognition while partnering with Sales, Legal, Business Development, Revenue Operations, and Program Finance on deal structure, contractual terms, and revenue guidance implementation.
  • Serve as one of the company’s subject matter experts on ASC 606, providing technical accounting guidance on complex revenue arrangements, non-standard contract terms, variable consideration, contract modifications, performance obligations, and other revenue recognition matters.
  • Own and evolve revenue accounting policies, including SSP analyses, allocation methodologies, and revenue recognition positions as new products, pricing models, geographies, and contract structures are introduced.
  • Design, document, and improve order-to-cash processes to ensure accuracy, scalability, operational efficiency, and strong internal controls across contract review, billing, revenue recognition, collections handoffs, and reporting.
  • Identify process gaps, control risks, and system limitations within the revenue accounting and order-to-cash lifecycle, and lead initiatives to improve process quality, automation, scalability, and audit readiness.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing and reviewing audit schedules, responding to technical accounting inquiries, and ensuring revenue accounting documentation is complete, accurate, and well-controlled.
  • Mentor and develop revenue accounting team members, providing coaching, review, prioritization, and guidance to support team growth and operational excellence.

• 8+ years of relevant accounting experience, including significant experience in technical revenue accounting under ASC 606 and/or IFRS 15.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA preferred.
  • Strong revenue recognition experience, including experience reviewing complex customer contracts and assessing accounting conclusions under ASC 606.
  • Experience leading or managing revenue accounting close activities, including review of journal entries, account reconciliations, and revenue-related balance sheet accounts.
  • Deep understanding of order-to-cash processes and how technical accounting decisions impact billing, collections, revenue recognition, reporting, and controls.
  • Experience designing, improving, or scaling revenue accounting and order-to-cash processes in a high-growth or complex business environment.
  • Experience with revenue recognition, ERP, CRM, and/or order-to-cash systems, such as Salesforce or equivalent tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex technical accounting issues into clear, actionable guidance for cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Legal, Sales, Business Development, Revenue Operations, Billing, Collections, Program Finance, FP&A, Systems, and external auditors.
  • Strong understanding of internal controls, audit requirements, and SOX compliance protocols.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance technical accounting rigor with operational practicality and business partnership.
  • Data-driven mindset with a proactive approach to process improvement, automation, and scalable operations.

• Big 4 public accounting experience preferred.
  • Public company experience preferred.
  • Experience with international expansion, including EMEA revenue accounting considerations.
  • Experience in high-growth technology, SaaS, PaaS, Defense, Aerospace, manufacturing, or complex contract environments.
  • Experience with long-term contracts, milestone billing, project-based revenue recognition, government contracts, or complex commercial arrangements.
  • Experience implementing or optimizing revenue recognition, billing, ERP, CRM, or order-to-cash systems.

jobs.description: Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. Job Description: We build advanced autonomous systems for defense markets—complex hardware and software products that demand world-class financial modeling, rigorous strategic analysis, and the ability to turn complexity into clarity. We seek a Senior Strategic Finance Lead with deep Aerospace & Defense (A&D) experience, a strong strategic or corporate finance background in a publicly traded company, and a proven track record architecting and owning long-range financial models. You will serve as the analytical engine of Corporate Finance: designing the company’s fully integrated long-range three‑statement and unit economics model, driving enterprise-level financial strategy, and producing investor-grade outputs that shape decisions at the C-suite, Board, and ultimately public investors. Job Description:

We build advanced autonomous systems for defense markets—complex hardware and software products that demand world-class financial modeling, rigorous strategic analysis, and the ability to turn complexity into clarity.

We seek a Senior Strategic Finance Lead with deep Aerospace & Defense (A&D) experience, a strong strategic or corporate finance background in a publicly traded company, and a proven track record architecting and owning long-range financial models. You will serve as the analytical engine of Corporate Finance: designing the company’s fully integrated long-range three‑statement and unit economics model, driving enterprise-level financial strategy, and producing investor-grade outputs that shape decisions at the C-suite, Board, and ultimately public investors.

Candidates must bring elite modeling expertise (IB/PE/HF/Equity Research), mastery of complex HW/SW unit economics, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high‑growth environment.

lists.content:
Own and Build the Strategic Financial Model

  • Architect and maintain a fully integrated, scalable, three‑statement model grounded in unit economics, operational drivers, and industry benchmarks.
  • Lead the Long Range Plan (LRP), including scenario modeling, sensitivities, and valuation frameworks.
  • Translate production ramps, R&D investments, contract timing, government milestones, and GTM strategy directly into financial outcomes.
  • Deliver investor-grade outputs including valuations, strategic insights, and Board-ready narratives.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of risks, opportunities, capital needs, and strategic inflection points.

    • Digitize & Scale Modeling Infrastructure

  • Partner with data engineering/systems teams to evolve modeling from Excel into modern cloud-based planning tools.
  • Design modular, scalable model architectures; use Excel only where it provides meaningful analytical leverage.
  • Integrate automation and analytics to improve clarity, reduce manual work, and increase decision velocity.

    • Analyze the Business Like an Investor

  • Benchmark peers across defense, autonomy, robotics, aerospace, and industrial tech.
  • Build competitor profiles, KPI benchmarks, and market analyses that inform strategy.
  • Develop a point of view on unit economics, efficiency, scale, profitability, and capital allocation.
  • Support M&A modeling, valuation, synergy analysis, and diligence.
  • Provide strategic insights that go beyond the numbers.

    • Lead Cash Flow & Liquidity Modeling

  • Build rolling cash flow forecasts across working capital, inventory, milestone payments, production cycles, and CapEx.
  • Model government contract payment timing, production curves, and program cash profiles.
  • Identify liquidity risks early and support capital allocation and financing strategies.

    • Partner Across the Company

  • Work closely with the VP FP&A, CFO, CEO, and senior leaders on forward-looking financial strategy.
  • Translate engineering, program, and operations plans into financial impacts.
  • Connect short-term forecasting with the long-range plan.
  • Present insights that accelerate execution and elevate decision quality.
  • Take full accountability for forecast accuracy, improving results with each actualized quarter.

• 8–10 years of experience, including significant time in investment banking, PE, hedge funds, or equity research.
  • Direct strategic finance leadership experience in a publicly traded company.
  • Deep A&D industry exposure (defense, aerospace, autonomy, robotics, industrial tech, or complex HW/SW).
  • Proven ownership of scalable three‑statement models, LRP development, valuations, sensitivities, and unit economics.
  • Exceptional Excel modeling capability; fluent in multi‑scenario three‑statement modeling, beat-and-raise frameworks, and driver-based forecasting.
  • Strong GAAP proficiency and command of financial statement mechanics.
  • Demonstrated ability to distill complex financial and technical information into clear insights for executives, Board, and investors.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments with high accuracy and strong judgment.
  • Systems-oriented mindset; comfortable partnering with data and systems teams.

• Familiarity with government contract economics, milestone‑based revenue, and program accounting.
  • M&A experience including modeling, valuation, and diligence.
  • Exposure to manufacturing scale, supply chain dynamics, and hardware production cycles.

• An analytical athlete with exceptional modeling intuition and attention to detail.
  • A structured, clear thinker who simplifies complexity without losing nuance.
  • Fast, accurate, and calm under pressure.
  • Curious, forward-looking, and driven to understand what truly moves the business.
  • A strong communicator who elevates decision quality across the company.
  • Mission-driven and energized by solving complex, high‑impact problems.

You will build the strategic financial model that defines how the business is understood—internally, at the Board level, and eventually by public investors. Your work will guide product strategy, capital allocation, investments, and long-range ambitions. This is Strategic Finance at its highest level: high complexity, high visibility, high impact.

lists.content:
Leadership and Execution (Individual Contributor):
  • Own the material planning function and ensure day-to-day processes align with company objectives.
  • Develop and execute strategies to optimize material usage and enhance procurement efficiency.
  • Demonstrate subject-matter expertise and provide informal knowledge sharing and best-practice guidance to peers.
    • Materials Analysis and Planning:
  • Analyze material usage and consumption versus planned metrics and deliver actionable insights to stakeholders.
  • Identify trends and recommend improvements to materials planning parameters to generate accurate procurement signals.
  • Ensure materials planning activities align with operational and production requirements.
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Serve as a primary point of contact to facilitate clear communication between engineering and procurement functions.

  • Monitor outcomes and continuously refine system configurations to support sustained performance.

  • Initiate and support process improvement efforts aimed at increasing efficiency and achieving key performance indicators.

• Proven experience in materials planning, procurement, or supply chain management, with leadership experience preferred.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in materials planning, production planning, or supply chain operations within a manufacturing or engineer-to-order environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze demand, inventory, and consumption data to drive accurate planning decisions.
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills with the ability to work effectively with engineering, procurement, and operations teams.

The Senior Production Planner – Development Programs is responsible for developing, maintaining, and executing production plans for prototype and developmental aircraft programs. Unlike traditional production environments, this role must navigate incomplete engineering definition, evolving bills of material, shifting program priorities, and dynamic supply chain conditions while maintaining progress toward key build and flight test milestones.

You will serve as a critical coordination point between Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Program Management to translate rapidly changing program requirements into actionable production plans.

lists.content:
• Develop and maintain detailed production schedules for prototype aircraft builds, major assemblies, and integration activities
  • Translate engineering release plans, build priorities, and program milestones into executable manufacturing schedules
  • Release and manage work orders in support of aircraft builds, including builds with incomplete engineering definition or evolving configurations or bills of material
  • Coordinate schedule adjustments resulting from engineering changes, design revisions, and shifting program priorities
  • Monitor production progress and proactively identify risks to key build, integration, and flight test milestones
  • Coordinate temporary planning structures and workarounds to enable manufacturing progress while maintaining configuration control
  • Facilitate rapid schedule recovery plans when design, material, or technical issues affect build progress
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain to align material availability with build requirements and timelines
  • Support ERP/MRP system accuracy through effective planning and work order management

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in production planning, manufacturing planning, production control, or supply chain operations
  • Experience supporting complex hardware, aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or other highly engineered products
  • Experience working within ERP/MRP systems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Costpoint, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, work order management, bills of material, and production scheduling
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and highly dynamic environment
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

• Experience supporting prototype, NPI (New Product Introduction), or developmental manufacturing programs
  • Experience in UAV, aerospace, defense, or aircraft production environments
  • Familiarity with engineering change management and configuration control processes
  • APICS CPIM certification

At Shield AI, prototype aircraft builds are where innovation becomes reality. Every developmental aircraft completed advances the future of autonomous aviation and accelerates mission capability for our customers.

This role sits at the center of that effort, helping transform evolving designs into flight-ready aircraft while building the production foundation for future scale.

If you are excited about solving complex manufacturing challenges and enabling next-generation autonomous aircraft programs, we want to hear from you.

Join us in building the world's best AI pilot.
