Job Description:

In this role, you will own the flight control system for XBAT, with responsibility for delivering stable, predictable, and operationally robust performance across all phases of flight, including vertical takeoff, hover, transition out-bound, wing-borne flight, transition in-bound, and precision recovery.

lists.content:
• Design and deliver the flight control system across all phases of flight including control allocation strategies that manage actuator redundancy, saturation, and degraded operations.
  • Lead development of high-fidelity 6DOF simulation environments and ensure accurate pre-flight performance predictions
  • Define and execute the verification strategy, including linear analysis, Monte Carlo campaigns, disturbance/sensitivity/degraded operation testing, and HIL validation
  • Diagnose and resolve simulation-to-flight mismatches, including unidentified dynamics and modeling gaps
  • Support flight test operations, making risk-informed decisions and driving rapid iteration between flights
  • Integrate control systems with propulsion, aero, actuation, sensors, state estimation, and autonomy, ensuring the vehicle behaves predictably under real-world disturbances and uncertainties
  • Mentor and guide engineers while setting the technical standard for control system performance and rigor

• 10+ years of experience in flight controls / GNC on real flight vehicles, with demonstrated ownership from design through flight test
  • Demonstrated experience with control allocation design and implementation for over-actuated systems with provisions for saturation and failure accommodation.
  • Strong background in:
  • Flight dynamics and 6DOF simulation
  • Control theory and nonlinear systems
  • Experience executing full V&V cycles, including pre-flight performance prediction, Monte Carlo analysis, flight readiness assessment, and post-flight analysis
  • Proficiency in C++, MATLAB/Simulink, and/or Python, with experience deploying real-time algorithms
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• VTOL or transition aircraft experience where control blending and allocation were critical to success
  • Autonomous systems or missile/UAV GNC background
  • Experience with flight safety, airworthiness, and mission assurance
  • Familiarity with:
  • Sensor and air data systems
  • Fault-tolerant or adaptive control
  • CI/CD pipelines and modern DevSecOps practices
  • Experience with HIL or integrated simulation/test environments and Linux-based development workflows (Git, etc.)
  • Experience operating in rapid development environments with tight iteration loops between simulation and test

lists.content:
• Define GCS and communication system behaviors, operational workflows, and activity diagrams to ensure reliable command, control, telemetry, payload, and mission data exchange

lists.content:
• Develop and execute test plans to validate mechanical performance, structural integrity, and environmental durability from start to finish.
  • Design, build, and operate test fixtures and systems involving hydraulic actuation, mechanical linkages, and sensor instrumentation.
  • Integrate and calibrate a range of sensors (e.g., load cells, pressure transducers, strain gauges, accelerometers) into test setups for accurate data collection.
  • Create and maintain python scripts to provide automation, signal processing, and result visualization.
  • Analyze test data, troubleshoot system behaviors, and generate detailed technical reports with design feedback.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including mechanical design, systems, and electrical engineering to define test requirements, run test campaigns and deliver high quality results.
  • Lead CAD design of custom test equipment, prototypes, fixtures, and components, ensuring manufacturability and safety.
  • Perform Finite Element Analysis to simulate mechanical performance, validate design assumptions, and correlate analytical results with test data.
  • Work with metallic/composite materials in the design, fabrication, and testing of mechanical components, with consideration for their unique properties such as anisotropy, delamination risk, and layup configuration.
  • Support lab safety protocols, equipment maintenance, and continuous improvement of test capabilities.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • 12+ years of experience in mechanical testing or product development environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of hydraulic systems and their control/measurement.
  • Experience with sensor selection, integration, and calibration in test environments.
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting, test automation, and data analysis.
  • Advanced CAD skills in Siemens NX with experience designing test hardware and prototypes.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and in team settings.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Hands-on experience performing MIL-STD testing (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461) including vibration, shock, thermal, and EMI/EMC testing.
  • Subject Matter Expert in aerospace structures and dynamics test environments.

Job Description:

 

Shield AI builds autonomy systems for defense applications, including air, maritime, and space platforms operating in complex and contested environments. 

We are building the AI Factory Reference Architecture, a Kubernetes-native platform for developing, training, evaluating, and deploying next-generation AI systems.

The AI Factory serves two purposes. Internally, it powers autonomy development across Hivemind and other AI programs. Externally, it becomes the reference architecture deployed into customer environments, spanning commercial cloud, on-premise infrastructure, sovereign deployments, and fully air-gapped systems.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to help define and build this platform. You will partner closely with ML researchers, platform engineers, and autonomy teams to deliver an exceptional developer experience for training and deploying modern AI models.

Success in this role requires balancing researcher productivity, platform simplicity, operational excellence, and long-term maintainability. You will work hands-on across the stack, helping shape both the platform architecture and its implementation while staying closely aligned with the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem.

lists.content:
• AI Platform Development: Lead the design and implementation of the AI Factory Reference Architecture, delivering a Kubernetes-native platform for AI development, distributed training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment.
  • AI Research Enablement: Partner directly with ML researchers to understand evolving training workflows and ensure the platform supports state-of-the-art AI frameworks, foundation model development, reinforcement learning, distributed training, and emerging research workflows.
  • Developer Experience: Design self-service AI development workflows that enable engineers to move seamlessly from local experimentation to large-scale distributed execution using familiar open source tools and frameworks.
  • Distributed AI Infrastructure: Build the infrastructure required to support distributed training, simulation, inference, and reinforcement learning workloads. Evaluate and integrate orchestration, scheduling, and resource management technologies to maximize scalability and developer productivity.
  • Compute Platform: Design and optimize shared GPU infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments. Improve resource utilization, scheduling efficiency, storage, networking, observability, and overall platform reliability.
  • Data & Model Lifecycle: Build platform capabilities that enable dataset management, experiment tracking, artifact management, model versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous model improvement.
  • Platform Distribution: Develop repeatable deployment and lifecycle management solutions using Infrastructure as Code and modern platform engineering practices. Support commercial cloud, customer-managed infrastructure, sovereign environments, and fully air-gapped deployments.
  • Technology Leadership: Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies and establish architectural patterns that balance scalability, performance, maintainability, and developer experience.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, autonomy teams, infrastructure engineers, and product teams to ensure the platform evolves alongside customer needs and advances in AI.

• Engineers move from idea to distributed training in hours instead of days.
  • High GPU utilization through efficient scheduling with KAI on Kubernetes.
  • Researchers use modern AI tooling without unnecessary platform friction.
  • AI Workspaces become the standard development environment across autonomy programs.
  • Training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment operate as a unified platform.
  • The AI Factory Reference Architecture can be deployed consistently across cloud, on-premise, and air-gapped environments.
  • Platform capabilities are reusable across multiple autonomy programs and customer deployments.

• Experience building Kubernetes-native AI or MLOps platforms supporting distributed machine learning workloads.
  • Deep understanding of modern AI training frameworks, including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers and distributed training techniques.
  • Experience operating GPU-accelerated infrastructure and distributed training systems.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, networking, security, storage, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with GPU scheduling concepts and large-scale AI workloads.
  • Experience packaging and deploying cloud-native infrastructure using Terraform and Helm.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python and Golang and modern cloud-native technologies.
  • Experience collaborating closely with ML researchers to translate research workflows into scalable platform capabilities.

• Experience with Ray or other distributed AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience with KAI, Slurm or other GPU scheduling technologies.
  • Experience supporting reinforcement learning, simulation-driven training, robotics, or autonomy workloads.
  • Experience deploying and optimizing AI models for edge hardware.
  • Experience designing infrastructure for classified, sovereign, or air-gapped environments.
  • Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure projects.

The AI Factory is the foundation for how Shield AI develops and deploys autonomy.

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will help build the reference architecture used internally by our engineering teams and delivered to customers building their own AI capabilities. Your work will directly impact how quickly researchers can iterate, how efficiently compute resources are utilized, and how AI systems move from experimentation to operational deployment.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of modern AI, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and defense, building a platform that enables the next generation of autonomy systems while leveraging the best of the open-source AI ecosystem.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Lead Operational Analyst to contribute to the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s aircraft systems. In this role, you will perform analysis at the component, system, mission and campaign levels to evaluate the effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our aircraft across multiple domains, missions and applications. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and defense stakeholders to assess system performance, inform design trade-offs, and improve mission outcomes. 

This position requires a strong working knowledge of military operations, modeling & simulation (M&S), data science, and operational analysis techniques. Your analyses will directly support product decisions and customer engagements by helping demonstrate how Shield AI’s AI-powered platforms perform in realistic and contested operational environments.

lists.content:
• Plan, own and execute operational analyses to assess the effectiveness of autonomous systems in representative military scenarios.
  • Develop and run modeling, simulation, and wargaming analyses to evaluate system performance, mission impact, and survivability in contested environments.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams and product managers to translate operational findings into actionable system insights.
  • Perform trade studies and sensitivity analyses to assess system performance across varying operational conditions, assumptions, and threat environments.
  • Build, modify, and analyze mission-level models using tools such as AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python, or similar M&S frameworks.
  • Analyze force-on-force engagements, sensor performance, and autonomy-enabled behaviors to support mission effectiveness assessments.
  • Engage with DoD stakeholders, operators, and analysts to understand mission needs and operational constraints.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of concepts of operations (CONOPS) for AI-enabled aircraft capabilities.
  • Monitor emerging threats and operational challenges relevant to autonomous and air combat systems.
  • Prepare technical documentation, analysis reports, and briefings for internal teams, customers, and government stakeholders. 
  • Apply modern compute and development best practices (e.g., version control, scripting, scalable compute workflows, and reproducible analysis) to build and maintain reliable analysis pipelines.
  • Be a force multiplier by coaching and developing incoming talent.

• Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering or math domain.
  • 9+ years of experience in operational analysis, modeling & simulation, operations research, or related defense or aerospace roles.
  • Active Secret at a minimum.  Preferred Top-Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Prior experience in force-on-force analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling.
  • Experience with evaluating strategic development and analysis goals for multi-mission/multi-domain applicability.
  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition processes, tools (Brawler, ESAMS, etc.), Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System (JCIDS), and military operational testing.
  • Experience leading a product effort from pre-shaping to tactical deployment
  • Prior experience in systems engineering product development lifecycle (SysML or MBSE preferred)
  •  Experience developing technical expertise in a team to execute analyses for system design and analysis.

This position is ideal for an individual who thrives on solving complex integration challenges that span hardware, software, and systems engineering. A successful candidate will be skilled at deploying autonomy solutions onto unmanned platforms, preparing systems for flight, and troubleshooting mission-critical issues in both lab and field environments. The role is highly dynamic, requiring hands-on experience, strong systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, real-world test conditions. 
 
Shield AI is committed to developing cutting-edge autonomy for unmanned aircraft operating across all Department of Defense (DoD) domains, including air, sea, and land. Our Flight Integration Engineers are essential to bridging the gap between R&D and deployment, ensuring that autonomous systems function reliably and effectively when and where they are needed most.

lists.content:
• System Integration & Deployment — Integrate autonomy software onto unmanned aircraft systems, ensuring seamless operation across onboard compute, sensors, and control interfaces.
  • Pre-flight Preparation — Own the build, configuration, and validation process for flight-ready systems; coordinate hardware/software compatibility and mission readiness.
  • On-site Flight Test Support — Travel to test sites and support live flight operations, including safety checks, system bring-up, and troubleshooting under time-critical constraints.
  • Hardware/Software Debugging — Diagnose and resolve integration issues across complex autonomy software stacks and embedded systems in lab and field environments.
  • Flight Data Capture & Analysis — Manage data collection during missions and post-test analysis, working with autonomy engineers to refine behaviors and identify improvements.
  • Collaboration Across Teams — Work closely with autonomy, GNC, systems, and test teams to ensure mission-critical functionality is delivered on time and validated thoroughly.
  • Continuous Improvement — Build tools and processes to improve integration timelines, flight test reliability, and team efficiency across deployment cycles.
  • Support Certification and Compliance — Assist with documentation and system-level validation required for certification, airworthiness, and compliance in defense-relevant environments.
  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 30-40% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

• BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 9 years and a Master’s degree; or 7 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and experience working with embedded systems, shell scripting, and system diagnostics.
  • Knowledge of sensor integration, sensor fusion, and middleware frameworks (e.g., ROS, DDS).
  • Hands-on experience supporting flight demos or live exercises.
  • Experience with simulation tools and environments (e.g., AFSIM, NGTS) for testing and validation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance.

• Direct experience supporting unmanned aerial systems or similar flight test campaigns.
  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, flight control systems, or GNC pipelines.
  • Competence in sensor integration, electronics debugging, or avionics bring-up.
  • Proficiency in developing automation tools for system testing, logging, and data parsing.
  • Comfortable interfacing with DoD stakeholders during field events or technical reviews.
  • Experience with UCI and OMS Standards.

  • Behavior Architecture Implementation – Implement and test behavior architectures that enable multi-agent coordination, target engagement, reconnaissance, and survivability in contested scenarios.
  • Hybrid Autonomy Integration – Work at the intersection of classical autonomy and machine learning, blending rule-based systems with learning-based methods such as reinforcement learning to achieve robust, adaptive behavior.
  • Hardware Software Integration:
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams including perception, planning, simulation, hardware, and flight test to ensure seamless integration of autonomy solutions on real-world platforms.

  • Ability to travel and stay deployed at customer sites across India/Asia.
  • 3+ years of experience hands on writing software for autonomy/robotics applications.
  • 2+ years of experience working in a startup environment. 
  • Strong technical background in software engineering. 
  • Strong proficiency in writing modern C++ code. 
  • Intermediate proficiency in writing Python code. 
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 
  • Ability converse fluently in Hindi and English.

• Experience in the defense aviation or robotics industry.

lists.content:

  • Report status, risks, accomplishments, expectations to senior leadership     
  • Design and implement systems capable of conducting tests across various environments, including virtualized hardware and hardware-in-the-loop simulations, to facilitate thorough evaluation of software functionality and performance.  
  • Develop innovative tools to enhance the frequency and reliability of software deployment, test execution, and data analysis within a continuous integration and release system, fostering improved efficiency and productivity in software development workflows.  
  • Create prototypes to validate critical design concepts and assess technical limitations, providing tangible evidence of feasibility and informing decision-making processes.

• Strong embedded software development (from BSP to complex applications) experience in C/C++.  
  • Strong understanding of Oriented Object Programming and modern C++ features. 
  • Strong knowledge of embedded software, BSPs or other systems software components. 
  • Strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, and network protocols fundamentals. 
  • Demonstrated track record of assuming ownership over development processes and features and delivering outstanding outcomes. 
  • Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including architecture, detailed designs, and test plans. 
  • Proven track record of successfully shipping products, showcasing the ability to navigate through development cycles, overcome obstacles, and deliver high-quality solutions to meet project deadlines and exceed client expectations in a fast-paced environment   
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement within software development projects, demonstrating initiative to propose and implement innovative solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and overall project success and X-Bat reliability   
  • B.S., M.S, PhD degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science or STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) discipline, such as Aerospace, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering 
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Proven background in thriving within fast-paced environments, within startup or R&D settings. 
  • Proven experience in development of military aircrafts.  
  • Compliance with DO-178C 
  • Demonstrated adaptability, agility, and the ability to innovate under pressure to meet dynamic project demands and drive successful outcomes. 
  • Familiar with FPGA development using SystemVerilog.   
  • Real Time Operating System (RTOS) experience.

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a Senior Staff Structural Analyst to provide advanced technical leadership in the structural analysis and validation of next-generation UAV platforms. In this role, you will serve as a senior subject-matter expert for airframe structures, leading complex analysis efforts, supporting test correlation, and ensuring structural integrity across development, flight test, and production.
 
This role is ideal for engineers with 12–15+ years of experience who have led major structural workstreams on aerospace programs and are comfortable owning analysis execution, mentoring engineers, and influencing key design tradeoffs within a program.

lists.content:
• Lead structural analysis efforts for UAV airframes, major substructures, and critical components within a program scope.
  • Define and execute finite element modeling approaches, load cases, assumptions, and margin assessments.
  • Perform and oversee static, modal, fatigue, vibration, and damage-tolerance analyses.
  • Establish sound practices for hand calculations, model validation, and analysis-to-test correlation.
  • Drive structural optimization across performance, weight, cost, and manufacturability targets.
  • Support structural test strategy, including defining requirements, participating in execution, and correlating results to analysis.
  • Review structural analysis deliverables, test reports, and technical documentation for design reviews.
  • Mentor and technically guide structural analysts across varying experience levels.
  • Partner cross-functionally with design, loads, aero, propulsion, and systems teams to balance structural requirements with overall aircraft performance goals.
  • Contribute to evolving analysis methodologies and improving structural standards within the organization.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in structural analysis, aircraft structures, or aerospace systems.
  • Strong expertise with FEA tools (ANSYS, NASTRAN, HyperWorks, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in hand calculations for strength, stability, fatigue, and damage tolerance.
  • Significant experience with composite and lightweight aerospace structures.
  • Experience supporting structural testing, model correlation, and flight test validation.
  • Ability to lead complex technical workstreams and influence design decisions within a program.
  • Strong communication skills and experience presenting analysis findings to engineering leadership.
  • Ability to get a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Master’s or Ph.D. in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.
  • Experience serving as a senior technical lead on aircraft or UAV structural programs.
  • Hands-on involvement in flight test support and certification efforts.
  • Experience contributing to internal analysis standards or best practices.
  • Familiarity with CAD, PLM, and enterprise engineering toolchains.

Job Description:

At Shield AI, we are building intelligent autonomous aircraft designed to operate and survive in highly contested environments. We are seeking a Survivability Materials Engineer to lead the selection, qualification, specification, and production implementation of low-observable and signature-control materials for next-generation autonomous aircraft.


This role is ideal for an engineer with experience in radar-absorbing materials, specialty coatings, electromagnetic material characterization, and aerospace manufacturing processes. You will work across survivability analysis, design engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and sustainment teams to ensure material solutions meet signature-performance requirements while remaining producible, inspectable, durable, and supportable throughout the aircraft lifecycle.

lists.content:
• Conduct material surveys and evaluate radar-absorbing materials, conductive materials, dielectric materials, specialty coatings, adhesives, sealants, and other survivability-related material systems.
  • Develop and maintain a survivability materials database containing performance, cost, supplier, part-number, availability, application, and sustainment information.
  • Partner with survivability analysis, design, manufacturing, and program teams to down-select materials based on signature performance, durability, producibility, weight, cost, and supply-chain risk.
  •  Develop material qualification plans and oversee electromagnetic, electrical, mechanical, thermal, chemical, and environmental testing.
  • Establish and maintain laboratory capabilities for material characterization, process development, receiving inspection, and production verification.
  • Provide hands-on production support for material application, inspection, troubleshooting, repair, supplier coordination, and sustainment.

• B.S. or M.S. in Materials Science and Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in aerospace materials engineering, low-observable materials, electromagnetic materials, specialty coatings, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of radar-absorbing materials, conductive coatings, dielectric materials, adhesives, sealants, or specialty surface treatments.
  • Understanding of how complex permittivity, complex permeability, conductivity, and thickness affect electromagnetic and radar-signature performance.
  • Experience with material characterization, laboratory testing, production inspection, or supplier qualification.
  • U.S. Citizenship and active Secret clearance required.

• Experience developing or qualifying radar-absorbing materials, low-observable coatings, structural RAM, conductive treatments, or signature-control appliqués.
  • Experience measuring electromagnetic material properties using free-space, waveguide, coaxial, resonant-cavity, or reflectivity-based test methods.
  • Familiarity with vector network analyzers, free-space measurement systems, conductivity equipment, coating-thickness instruments, environmental chambers, and mechanical test equipment.
  •  Active Secret, Top Secret, or SCI security clearance.

  • System Design Teams (e.g., Human Factors, UX, Architecture) to decompose solution designs into actionable technical detail.

lists.content:
As a contributor to the Australian Engineering group, you will be responsible for:
  • Capturing end‑to‑end system requirements for Hivemind Vision Systems and integrated autonomy solutions.
  • Supporting the design and development of system architectures spanning perception, autonomy, and mission‑level workflows.
  • Using MBSE tools to document, maintain, and extend existing architecture models supporting new integrations, capabilities, and customer requirements.
  • Developing and maintaining models using UML, SysML, and/or UPDM.
  • creating SysML models with emphasis on system decomposition, functional flows, interfaces, and system behavior.
  • Collaborating with subject‑matter experts to improve tooling, automation, and connections between system models and codebases.
  • Supporting the evolution and execution of the systems engineering process across the Australian engineering organization.
  • Engaging cross‑functionally with product management, program management, engineering, and business development teams.
  • Reporting status, risks, accomplishments, and expectations to senior engineering and program leadership.

• A minimum of 7 years of systems engineering or related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years with a Master’s degree; or 2 years with a PhD; or equivalent practical experience.
  • B.S. degree in a STEM field (e.g., Systems, Software, Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering).
  • Experience with systems engineering practices, including writing, structuring, and verifying requirements.
  • Experience with MBSE and system‑modeling workflows.
  • Experience working on cross‑functional technical teams.
  • Strong communication skills, written and verbal.
  • Highly organized, methodical, and comfortable managing detailed technical information.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply engineering drawings, assembly diagrams, parts lists, wiring diagrams, and schematics.
  • A demonstrated track record of integrity, high standards, teamwork, and professionalism.

• Expertise with MBSE, including use of Cameo Systems Modeler, Cameo APIs, and Velocity Template Language (VTL).
  • Expertise in requirements and design decomposition for complex hardware/software systems.
  • Experience in any of the following domains: autonomy, aircraft systems, perception, unmanned vehicles, or robotic platforms.

• Eligibility to obtain an Australian NV1 (Secret) clearance.
  • Ability to access and handle ITAR‑controlled and Australian export‑controlled technical data.

Job Description:

As a Software Systems Test Engineer, you will be pivotal in driving integration testing of our full aircraft software system, integrating our autonomy, flight controller, and GCS software to qualify an intelligent, robust aircraft system. This role demands an engineer capable of overseeing system-level verification and validation, designing complex test scenarios, and ensuring that subsystem testing meets rigorous standards before proceeding to full system integration. You will marshal our aircraft software through full system verification & validation. Your work will directly impact the reliability and performance of our aircraft, preparing them for operational excellence in the field.

lists.content:
• Generate detailed mission test scenarios that mimic real-world conditions to validate the performance of autonomy and flight control software.
  • Participate in design reviews for new features and design detailed test plans based on their requirements
  • Conduct and manage system verification and validation events, culminating in verified flight readiness.
  • Write test analyzers in Python to report and benchmark performance and qualification metrics of the system
  • Produce test coverage and release-readiness reports by aggregating test cases, results, and quality requirements
  • Recommend improvements to our simulation models and fault injection so that we can keep pushing the capabilities of our test suite before proceeding to flight

• 10+ years of work experience in testing complex integrated software systems
  • Demonstrated expertise & experience in test automation, minimally writing software to automate testing, preferably leveraging simulation for automated integration testing
  • Strong experience with the software product development lifecycle, ideally for autonomy or vehicle systems
  • Great understanding of system architecture, requirement derivation, and test planning across the V-model
  • Experience with automating test cases in an existing test framework
  • Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including test plans, quality-assurance reports, and operational procedures
  • Proven track record of successfully shipping products, showcasing the ability to navigate through development cycles, overcome obstacles, and deliver high-quality solutions to meet project deadlines and exceed expectations in a fast-paced environment
  • B.S., M.S, or PhD degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related field

• Experience with autonomous or robotic systems
  • Experience with simulation software and hardware emulation
  • Background in a fast-paced, R&D or startup environment
  • Proficiency in build test automation
  • Proficiency in Python or C++

In this role, you are the single technical authority for test execution—responsible for determining test readiness, directing test conduct, managing risk, and ensuring data-driven decisions throughout development and flight test operations. You will lead cross-functional teams across engineering, safety, and program management, aligning stakeholders around clear objectives, disciplined execution, and continuous learning.

lists.content:
• Act as Test Director for system-level integration and flight test campaigns of Hivemind Mission Autonomy on small UAS and external platforms 
  • Own test readiness decisions, including entry/exit criteria for lab, simulation, ground, and flight test phases 
  • Plan, direct, and execute fly–fix–fly test campaigns, ensuring rapid iteration while maintaining disciplined configuration control and safety 
  • Define and enforce test strategy, including system-level verification and validation, test phasing, and prioritization of objectives 
  • Direct cross-functional test execution, coordinating across various engineering disciplines and test operators. 
  • Determine test infrastructure requirements, including SIL, HIL, simulation environments, flight test assets, and automated test pipelines 
  • Approve and oversee test procedures, test cards, and execution plans, serving as the final authority during test conduct 
  • Define performance metrics and success criteria, ensuring test data is actionable and traceable to requirements and mission outcomes 
  • Lead flight test risk assessments, hazard analyses, and mitigation planning; enforce safety-of-flight discipline during operations 
  • Serve as primary test interface to internal leadership, customers, and external stakeholders, providing clear reporting on test progress, results, and risks 
  • Establish test standards, SOPs, and best practices aligned with industry and DoD DT&E/OT&E expectations 
  • Document test results, anomalies, corrective actions, and lessons learned, driving continuous improvement across autonomy flight test efforts 
  • Support travel to test sites, customer events, and integration activities as required 
  • Perform other duties as assigned

• B.S. degree in a STEM discipline (Aerospace Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field) 
  • 7+ years of experience in system integration and test, including SIL, HIL, simulation, and flight test environments 
  • Demonstrated experience leading test execution, including authority over test conduct, readiness, and risk decisions 
  • Strong background working cross-functionally with systems engineering, software, hardware, safety, and program management teams 
  • Highly organized and methodical, with the ability to manage complex, fast-paced test campaigns 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including briefing technical status to leadership and customers 
  • Demonstrated integrity, accountability, and commitment to high standards while fostering a collaborative, respectful team environment

• Working knowledge of DoD DT&E and OT&E processes and documentation expectations 
  • Direct experience with small UAS, autonomy, or robotic flight test operations 
  • Prior role as Test Director, Test Conductor, or Lead Flight Test Engineer 
  • Experience operating within DoD software and hardware laboratories or government flight test ranges 
  • Familiarity with safety-of-flight processes, hazard analysis, and configuration control in flight test environments

This role sits at the intersection of autonomy software, unmanned aircraft and robotic systems, onboard compute, networking, radios, sensors, flight controllers, simulation, test operations, and customer-facing demonstrations.

The right candidate can move comfortably from architecture discussions to benchtop integration, from lab troubleshooting to field execution, and from platform evaluation to clear recommendations for engineering, test, product, and operations leaders.

You will help teams select and prepare representative platforms, understand integration tradeoffs, improve test readiness, diagnose cross-disciplinary issues, and translate lessons from real hardware into better engineering, test, and operational practice. The role requires strong judgment, calm execution under pressure, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous technical environments without overfitting to a single platform or workflow.

lists.content:
• Serve as a senior technical focal point for Hivemind integration and test readiness across unmanned aircraft, robotic systems, representative test vehicles, onboard compute, radios, sensors, payloads, and supporting ground equipment. 
  • Lead hands-on integration and troubleshooting efforts that span autonomy software, hardware, flight controllers, communications systems, networking, operator interfaces, and field operations. 
  • Partner with engineering, test, product, operations, field, and customer-facing teams to evaluate new platforms and determine how they can best support Hivemind development, validation, training, demonstrations, and customer objectives. 
  • Help take systems from early concept or benchtop integration through representative test, field execution, and operationally relevant demonstrations. 
  • Provide senior-level technical judgment on platform suitability, integration complexity, test readiness, risk, safety, maintainability, cost, availability, and customer value. 
  • Support test planning and execution across simulated, hardware-in-the-loop, live-vehicle, and flight-test environments while keeping the role focused on practical system readiness and evidence quality. 
  • Help define clear readiness criteria, test expectations, operating assumptions, and handoff points for representative hardware used by Hivemind teams. 
  • Diagnose complex cross-disciplinary issues and help route them effectively across software, autonomy, hardware, flight-test, networking, and operations stakeholders. 
  • Contribute to test methods, metrics, and evidence practices that improve confidence in Hivemind behavior across representative and real-world environments. 
  • Support automation, tooling, and data-review practices that improve repeatability, reduce manual burden, and make hardware-based testing easier to operate at scale. 
  • Capture and share practical knowledge from platform bring-up, test events, flight operations, and customer-facing demonstrations so teams can reuse lessons learned. 
  • Mentor engineers and operators on systems integration, hardware readiness, field troubleshooting, test discipline, and practical autonomy test execution.

• Evaluating a new unmanned aircraft, ground robot, customer-selected platform, or lab setup for suitability as a Hivemind development, test, training, or demonstration asset. 
  • Leading technical preparation for a Hivemind test event or customer demonstration that depends on representative hardware, onboard compute, communications, sensors, and operator workflows. 
  • Advising a program team on the right level of platform fidelity needed for a pilot effort, internal test campaign, or customer-facing technical engagement. 
  • Supporting integration between Hivemind and flight-control systems, onboard compute, sensors, payloads, radios, ground-control equipment, or simulation environments. 
  • Helping a test team define practical readiness criteria, test coverage, data-review expectations, and evidence standards for hardware-based autonomy validation. 
  • Working with engineering and operations leaders to turn lessons from field or lab execution into reusable guidance, training, and better test practices.

• 10+ years of experience in UxS or UAS systems integration, robotics hardware integration, autonomy test operations, flight test, field engineering, embedded systems, or similar hands-on technical roles. 
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex integration efforts across hardware, software, autonomy, networking, communications, sensors, and operational test environments. 
  • Strong practical experience bringing up, configuring, operating, and troubleshooting unmanned systems, onboard compute, flight controllers, radios, sensors, ground stations, and supporting test equipment. 
  • Working knowledge of Linux, embedded systems, networking, system configuration, data collection, logs, services, and field diagnostics. 
  • Experience with unmanned-systems autopilot or flight-control ecosystems such as PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, Pixhawk/Cube-class flight controllers, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, or equivalent systems. 
  • Experience supporting testing across simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, live-vehicle, field, or flight-test environments. 
  • Ability to develop and communicate test plans, readiness criteria, operating assumptions, technical recommendations, and post-test findings for cross-functional audiences. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills across ambiguous, cross-disciplinary technical issues. 
  • Ability to lead through influence across engineering, test, product, operations, field, and customer-facing teams. 
  • Familiarity with scripting, automation, or data-analysis workflows using Python, Bash, MATLAB, or similar tools. 
  • Strong ownership, urgency, and judgment in fast-moving environments where requirements, platforms, and constraints may evolve quickly. 
  • Ability to comply with export-control, safety, security, customer-site, and mission-specific operating requirements. 
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance; U.S. citizenship required.

• Experience with Hivemind, autonomy SDKs, autonomous aircraft systems, robotics middleware, simulation infrastructure, or edge-deployed autonomy software. 
  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson, embedded Linux, systemd services, containerized deployment, device provisioning, and field update workflows. 
  • Experience with RF/radio setup, mesh networking, tactical datalinks, software-defined radios, or communications-degraded test scenarios. 
  • Experience supporting flight test, range operations, customer trials, operational rehearsals, or complex demonstrations. 
  • Experience integrating EO/IR cameras, gimbals, lidar, GPS/GNSS, IMUs, payloads, or perception sensors. 
  • Experience contributing to test automation, regression frameworks, data validation, performance benchmarking, or CI/CD-integrated test workflows. 
  • Familiarity with C++ for debugging, interface review, or collaboration with software engineering teams. 
  • FAA Part 107, private pilot license, military UAS, aviation maintenance, flight-test, or range-safety experience. 
  • Experience defining reference configurations, hardware baselines, supported configurations, or setup guidance for internal and external users. 
  • Active Secret clearance or higher.

lists.content:
• Lead X-BAT technical capture efforts for US Domestic opportunities, ensuring solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with Shield AI’s product roadmap.
  • Capture efforts will focus on Aircraft, but will require familiarity with the entire Shield AI Product suite.
  • Manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, including customer engagements, pre-sales technical support, proposal contributions, and solution development. 
  • Develop and execute technical strategies that result in high-quality, compliant, and compelling proposals to maximize win probability.
  • Serve as the primary technical lead for Go To Market (GTM) engagements, interfacing cross-functionally with BD, BD Operations, Engineering, Operations, Program Management, and Product Management to ensure customer needs are met.
  • Manage technical content for proposals, requests for information (RFIs), white papers, and capability briefs, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and compliance. 
  • Support early-phase acquisition activities (concept notes, requirements drafts, unsolicited proposals).
  • Shape early operational concepts aligned to X-BAT capabilities. 
  • Support BD and Account Executives by becoming a Subject Matter Expert in Shield AI products, providing technical expertise in customer engagements, capability briefings, and solution discussions to drive successful sales outcomes.
  • Act as a liaison between BD and Engineering, ensuring that new customer requests are technically feasible and align with product capabilities, timelines, and roadmaps.
  • Contribute to the technical documentation repository, maintaining capability briefs, specifications, FAQs, and other sales collateral for internal and external use.
  • Provide training and mentorship to BD teams on technical aspects of Shield AI’s solutions, enabling them to articulate our value proposition confidently.
  • Support competitive analysis and market intelligence specific to the US tactical aircraft market, ensuring the BD team remains informed on industry trends and competitor capabilities.
  • Contribute to process improvement efforts, leveraging lessons learned from customer engagements to refine BD workflows and technical capture strategies.
  • Analyze the unique operational and environmental factors of the assigned region, producing high-impact white papers and briefs that inform the product roadmap and drive solutions aligned to customer mission needs.

• 10+ years of experience in technical sales, capture, engineering, or program management within defense or aerospace industries.
  • Demonstrated familiarity with US Department of War procurement processes and military force structures.
  • Prior experience at a major defense prime (US OEM or equivalent) supporting tactical aircraft, CCA/ACA, or Group 4/5 UAS programs. 
  • Experience interfacing with government or military acquisition stakeholders.
  • Strong systems-level understanding of aircraft design tradeoffs, operational CONOPS, and mission-based engineering.
  • Proven ability to translate technical concepts into compelling narratives for senior stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, applied science, or related technical discipline. 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment.

• Experience supporting defense sales or industrial partnerships.
  • Background in maintenance / sustainment on combat aircraft and/or in mission systems integration.
  • Experience contributing to early-phase design or conceptual aircraft programs.
  • Prior military service experience.
  • Advanced degree in engineering, aerospace, systems engineering, or business. 
  • 5+ years of experience in an presales/solutions engineering role.
  • 3+ years of experience working in a startup environment. 
  • Demonstrated understanding of specific DoW operational scenarios and systems.

Job Description:

This is a highly technical leadership role responsible for creating world-class lab environments that enable hardware and software engineering teams to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and validate complex systems.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong operational leadership, driving lab architecture, infrastructure modernization, asset management, and engineering support while leading a team of engineers and technicians.

lists.content:
Lab Strategy & Infrastructure

  • Own the overall vision, architecture, and roadmap for engineering laboratory infrastructure.
  • Design, build, and commission new laboratory spaces to support evolving engineering programs.
  • Define standards for laboratory layout, power distribution, networking, cooling, safety, security, and scalability.
  • Develop long-term modernization plans to ensure laboratory capabilities remain aligned with engineering needs.
  • Evaluate and implement new technologies, tools, and automation to improve laboratory efficiency and reliability.

    • Lab Operations

  • Own day-to-day laboratory operations across multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Develop scheduling processes that maximize lab utilization while minimizing conflicts and downtime.
  • Plan and coordinate preventative maintenance, calibration, repairs, and equipment lifecycle management.
  • Manage laboratory uptime, availability, and operational readiness.
  • Establish operational metrics, KPIs, and reporting for lab performance.

    • Engineering Systems & Integration

  • Support complex hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), software-in-the-loop (SIL), integration, and validation environments.
  • Develop laboratory standards for networking, compute infrastructure, storage, instrumentation, and data acquisition.
  • Partner with engineering teams to architect robust development and test environments.
  • Ensure laboratories support rapid system integration and reproducible testing.

    • Leadership

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of lab engineers, infrastructure engineers, and technicians.
  • Recruit, mentor, and grow high-performing technical staff.
  • Prioritize work across multiple concurrent engineering programs.
  • Establish standard operating procedures, documentation, and best practices.
  • Foster a culture of safety, ownership, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.

    • Collaboration

  • Work closely with Hardware, Electrical, Mechanical, Software, Systems, Manufacturing, and Test Engineering organizations.
  • Partner with IT, Facilities, Security, and EH&S teams to deliver reliable and secure laboratory environments.
  • Manage vendor relationships for laboratory equipment, infrastructure, and service providers.

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience supporting complex engineering laboratories or technical infrastructure.
  • 5+ years of technical leadership or people management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building engineering labs from concept through deployment.
  • Strong understanding of laboratory infrastructure, including:
    • Power distribution
    • Network architecture
    • Server and storage systems
    • Instrumentation
    • Environmental controls
    • Safety systems
    • Experience managing equipment lifecycle, maintenance, calibration, upgrades, and modernization.
    • Experience supporting multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
    • Laboratory infrastructure design and architecture
    • System-level engineering and integration
    • Networking (Ethernet, VLANs, managed switches, routing)
    • Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-loop (SIL) systems
    • Asset management and inventory systems
    • US Citizenship required due to security clearance requirements.
      Active Secret clearance.

• Experience supporting robotics, aerospace, defense, automotive, or autonomous systems development.
  • Experience with secure laboratory environments and classified or regulated development environments.
  • Knowledge of systems engineering processes and system architecture.
  • Experience implementing laboratory automation and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud-connected engineering workflows and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Programming and scripting experience:    
    • Python, MATLAB, C/C++, etc.
    • Active Top Secret clearance or eligible to achieve

Job Description:
We are seeking a Propulsion Engineer to serve as the Responsible Engineer (RE) for the Thrust Vector Control (TVC) system on X-BAT. This role demands full lifecycle ownership of the TVC system, from concept and architecture through design, integration, test, flight, and operational support.
 
You will serve as the focal point for all technical matters related to thrust vectoring, ensuring the system enables precise flight control authority, integrates cleanly with the engine and airframe, and performs reliably across the full range of operational conditions. This role is hands-on, data-driven, and highly cross-functional, requiring collaboration with controls, airframe, flight test, and mission teams.

lists.content:
• Act as the single-threaded owner for the TVC system, accountable for all technical decisions from concept to flight.
  • Define and manage system requirements, performance goals, and mechanical/electrical interfaces.
  • Design and integrate vectoring mechanisms with the engine and surrounding structure.
  • Lead ground and flight testing of the TVC system, including instrumentation planning, data collection, and performance evaluation.
  • Analyze control authority, vectoring bandwidth, and dynamic response across the flight envelope.
  • Collaborate with the controls team to shape vectoring logic and ensure closed-loop system performance meets CONOPS requirements.
  • Own fault management, failure investigations, and system reliability strategies.
  • Represent the TVC system in design reviews, technical checkpoints, customer briefings, and leadership updates.

• Bachelor’s degree in aerospace engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience in aerospace propulsion or flight control systems, with relevant experience owning subsystem development.
  • Deep understanding of nozzle dynamics, actuation systems, mechanical integration, and structural/thermal constraints.
  • Demonstrated experience in hardware development, test planning, and flight test support.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for performance analysis, data processing, and model correlation.
  • Familiarity with tools such as ANSYS, FEA, or thermal/fluid modeling for mechanism and system validation.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• Experience with TVC or control effector systems on UAVs, tactical aircraft, or rocket platforms.
  • Familiarity with low-bypass turbofan engines and integration constraints near hot-end propulsion hardware.
  • Experience collaborating on control logic development, transient response shaping, and actuator tuning.
  • Proficiency with Siemens NX and Teamcenter for CAD and configuration control.
  • Background in failure modes analysis, margin modeling, and system validation strategies.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline.

lists.content:

  • Develop leadership and senior technical talent to strengthen organizational capability and succession.

  • Shape workforce composition, location strategy, and talent approaches to build and retain critical capabilities. 

    • Data & Organizational Insights 

  • Use people and business data to assess organizational health, talent trends, leadership effectiveness, and workforce risks.
  • Translate insights into clear recommendations that influence leadership decisions and improve organizational performance. 

    • Change, Transformation & M&A 

  • Partner with key stakeholders on the people strategy for complex transformations, restructures, M&A, and organizational integrations.
  • Collaborate on M&A due diligence and integration planning, including talent assessment, organizational design, retention, leadership alignment, and cultural integration.
  • Advise leaders through change to maintain business continuity, organizational effectiveness, and employee engagement.

  • Lead and contribute to cross-functional initiatives that strengthen scalable people practices and organizational effectiveness.

  • Data-driven problem solver. You use analytics and insight to identify patterns, simplify complexity, and influence decisions. 
  • Operationally strong and adaptable. You translate strategy into action and thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments with evolving priorities. 
  • Systems thinker and collaborator. You connect business needs with the right partners and solutions while balancing immediate priorities with long-term organizational capability.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field. 
  • 12+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience, including experience supporting Engineering, Product, AI/ML, Platform, or other highly technical organizations. 
  • Demonstrated success partnering with VP and Director-level leaders to develop and execute people strategies aligned with business priorities. 
  • Deep experience in organizational design, workforce planning, talent management, change management, and leadership coaching within scaling technology organizations. 
  • Experience supporting the people aspects of M&A, including due diligence, integration planning, talent assessment, retention, organizational alignment, and cultural integration.

  • Experience operating within a global People organization and leveraging Centers of Excellence (COEs) and Shared Services to deliver scalable solutions. 
  • Strong understanding of technical talent markets, job architecture, leveling frameworks, and compensation principles. 
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage workforce analytics and people data to diagnose challenges and influence decisions. 
  • Exceptional consulting, coaching, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and build alignment across senior leaders.

• Experience supporting high-growth, complex, or rapidly scaling technology-based organizations. 
  • Experience partnering with Software, Product, AI/ML, Platform, or Services organizations. 
  • M&A experience, including pre-close diligence and post-close integration. 
  • Experience supporting global or geographically distributed teams and navigating complex matrixed organizations. 
  • Demonstrated expertise in organizational effectiveness, including operating model design, team effectiveness, and organizational diagnostics. 
  • Experience using people analytics, workforce insights, and business metrics to inform talent and organizational decisions. 
  • Familiarity with emerging technologies, including AI, and their implications for workforce strategy, skills, and organizational design. 
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments requiring strong judgment, adaptability, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

jobs.description: Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. The Autonomous Pilot Integration team for launched effects builds autonomy solutions for small, often air- or ground-launched platforms that operate in multi-agent fleets and frequently in disconnected or air-gapped environments. We combine capabilities from the Autonomy Capabilities team (motion planning, tactics), the Perception team (e.g., track fusion), and the HivemindSDK to develop the autonomy software that runs on launched effects platforms, then integrate, validate, and field it on the real hardware—for U.S. and international defense customers. Our engineers write new autonomy code—such as mission behaviors, platform-specific control, multi-agent coordination, contingencies, and executive autonomy—and own it end-to-end from software-in-the-loop, to hardware-in-the-loop, to vehicle-in-the-loop, to live test exercise. In this role, you'll lead the technical delivery of complex autonomy capabilities spanning platform integration, fleet operations, and operational deployment. You'll own some of the team's most challenging technical problems while driving technical direction across multiple subsystems and collaborating closely with the Autonomy Capabilities team, Perception, feature crews, autopilot vendors, C2 providers, and customer partners. You'll combine deep technical expertise with systems thinking to deliver scalable autonomy solutions for fleet-scale operations.

raw.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

The Autonomous Pilot Integration team for Emerging Domains builds autonomy solutions for new platforms and mission profiles outside Shield AI's established portfolios—including space (satellites, missile defense), maritime (USV and UUV integration), and contested logistics (unmanned helicopters and related autonomous resupply platforms). The team takes on short-term R&D and integration efforts—often standing up the first autonomy on a brand-new platform or mission—with the intent that successful efforts grow into larger, multi-year programs. We combine capabilities from the Autonomy Capabilities team (motion planning, tactics), the Perception team (e.g., ViDAR, ATR), and the HivemindSDK—selectively leveraging existing Shield AI autonomy solutions where they apply—to develop autonomy that runs on these new platforms. Our engineers write new autonomy code—such as mission behaviors, platform-specific control, multi-agent coordination, contingencies, and executive autonomy—and own it end-to-end from software-in-the-loop, to hardware-in-the-loop, to vehicle-in-the-loop, to live test exercise. 

In this role, you'll define the technical direction for Emerging Domains, guiding autonomy strategy across multiple new platforms and mission areas while helping transform early-stage R&D efforts into scalable, long-term programs. You'll solve the organization's most complex technical challenges, influence engineering strategy across organizations, and partner with engineering leadership, platform teams, and customer stakeholders to shape the future of Shield AI's next generation of autonomy portfolios.

lists.content:
Stand Up New Programs – Define the technical strategy for establishing autonomy on entirely new platforms and mission areas, determining what should be built, reused, or extended from existing Shield AI capabilities. 

Navigate Ambiguity & Shifting Priorities – Lead engineering through evolving customer needs, changing priorities, and uncertain technical landscapes while maintaining execution and long-term technical vision. 

Technical Strategy & Portfolio Leadership – Define long-term technical direction across Emerging Domains, establishing architecture, integration strategies, and engineering patterns that enable successful transition from R&D to operational programs. 

Develop & Field Autonomy – Guide development and deployment of autonomy capabilities across space, maritime, contested logistics, and future emerging platforms while ensuring successful operational delivery. 

Platform Team Partnerships – Build deep technical partnerships with platform organizations and influence interface evolution, integration strategy, and long-term platform architecture. 

Collaboration Across Teams & Partners – Influence architecture across Autonomy Capabilities, Perception, GCS, platform teams, engineering leadership, customer organizations, and external partners. 

Design & Documentation – Lead architecture reviews, engineering standards, ICDs, and technical best practices across multiple organizations. 

Pre-deployment Preparation – Guide release strategy, mission validation, and operational readiness across multiple emerging programs. 

On-site Test & Mission Support – Provide senior technical leadership during critical demonstrations, operational exercises, and customer events where deep systems expertise is required. 

Hardware/Software Debugging – Lead resolution of the organization's most challenging autonomy integration problems spanning software, hardware, embedded systems, and platform interfaces. 

Mission Data & Debrief Support – Drive organizational learning from operational testing and shape future technical investments based on mission outcomes. 

Continuous Improvement – Drive long-term improvements to engineering processes, developer experience, testing infrastructure, and integration workflows across the Emerging Domains portfolio. 

C2 Interoperability & Standards – Define technical strategy for command-and-control interoperability and guide adoption of platform-appropriate open-systems standards across emerging programs. 

Grow R&D into Programs – Partner with engineering leadership and customers to evolve successful R&D efforts into scalable, long-term programs while helping shape technical strategy for future portfolios. 

Hiring & Developing Technical Talent – Help define the technical hiring bar for senior engineering roles, mentor future technical leaders, and partner with managers to grow organizational capability. 

Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 10–20% of the year to different office locations, customer sites, operator training events, flight tests, and integration exercises.

• BS/MS in a relevant engineering discipline or equivalent practical experience. Typically requires 10+ years of relevant experience.  

  • Expert-level C++ and Linux systems development experience.  

  • Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy across multiple programs or engineering organizations.  

  • Proven track record solving highly complex systems integration challenges in ambiguous environments.  

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering direction without formal authority.  

  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance.

• Experience leading first-of-kind autonomy or advanced R&D efforts.  

  • Experience across multiple autonomy domains (air, maritime, space, ground, or robotics).  

  • Experience transitioning prototypes into operational systems.  

  • Experience with government R&D programs and defense customers.  

  • Experience shaping engineering practices across an organization.  

  • Experience with UCI, OMS, STANAG 4586, or other defense interoperability standards.

lists.content:
Technical Strategy & Portfolio Leadership – Define the long-term technical direction for the Launched Effects portfolio; drive common integration patterns, architecture, and engineering strategy that enable scalable fleet operations across current and future programs. 

Develop & Field Autonomy – Guide the development and integration of mission autonomy, platform interfaces, executive autonomy, multi-agent coordination, and fleet-scale deployment capabilities while ensuring successful operational delivery across launched effects programs. 

Collaboration Across Teams & Partners – Build strong technical partnerships across the Autonomy Capabilities team, Perception team, feature crews, autopilot vendors, C2 providers, customer organizations, and engineering leadership; influence architecture and technical direction beyond the portfolio. 

Design & Documentation – Lead cross-functional architecture reviews, interface standards, ICDs, and post-mortems while raising engineering rigor and technical consistency across multiple organizations. 

Mentorship & Organizational Growth – Mentor Staff and Senior engineers, develop future technical leaders, contribute to engineering standards and leveling, and partner with managers on senior hiring. 

Pre-deployment Preparation – Guide Capability Release planning, fleet-scale deployment strategies, mission validation, and operational readiness across multiple programs. 

On-site Test & Mission Support – Provide senior technical leadership during critical flight tests, customer demonstrations, and operational exercises where deep systems integration expertise is required. 

Hardware/Software Debugging – Lead resolution of the organization's most complex autonomy integration challenges spanning software, embedded systems, networking, platform interfaces, and operational environments. 

Mission Data & Debrief Support – Drive post-mission analysis, identify systemic improvements, and influence long-term technical investments based on operational learnings. 

Continuous Improvement – Drive organization-wide improvements to engineering processes, testing infrastructure, integration workflows, developer experience, and mission reliability. 

C2 Interoperability & Standards – Define technical strategy for command-and-control interoperability; shape interface evolution with internal and external stakeholders while driving adoption of common message and open-systems standards (e.g., UCI, OMS, MOSA, WOSA, TAK/CoT). 

Hiring & Developing Technical Talent – Define the technical hiring bar for senior engineering roles, partner with engineering managers on long-term staffing strategy, and help grow the organization's technical capabilities. 

Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 10–20% of the year to different office locations, customer sites, operator training events, flight tests, and integration exercises.

• BS/MS in a relevant engineering discipline or equivalent practical experience.  

  • Typically requires 10+ years of relevant experience.  

  • Expert-level C++ and Linux systems development experience.  

  • Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or programs.  

  • Proven track record influencing architecture and solving highly complex autonomy integration challenges.  

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and driving engineering excellence across an organization.  

  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance.

• Extensive experience with launched effects, autonomous systems, or distributed robotic platforms.  

  • Experience defining autopilot integration strategies and multi-agent autonomy architectures.  

  • Experience leading fleet-scale or disconnected operational deployments.  

  • Experience with military operational testing and international defense customers.  

  • Experience with UCI, OMS, MOSA, WOSA, TAK/CoT, or similar open architectures.  

  • Experience shaping engineering practices across multiple teams or organizations.

The Hivemind Solutions Perception team develops the next generation of perception capabilities for autonomous systems by combining state-of-the-art machine learning with the proven foundations of computer vision. The team advances how autonomous platforms understand and interpret the world by developing vision, vision-language (VLM), and vision-language-action (VLA) models that tackle core perception challenges such as object understanding, scene interpretation, and mission-relevant environmental awareness. Working at the intersection of research and production, our engineers build the data pipelines, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) workflows, evaluation frameworks, and deployment infrastructure needed to transform cutting-edge AI research into reliable, mission-ready perception capabilities.
 
In this role, you'll develop and deploy advanced machine learning models that enable autonomous systems to better understand, reason about, and interact with their environment. You'll partner closely with machine learning researchers, autonomy engineers, perception engineers, and platform teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into reliable, production-ready systems for U.S. and international defense customers. This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who enjoy building state-of-the-art AI systems while solving the practical challenges of deploying them on operational autonomous platforms.

  • Generate and engage: Use advanced Boolean search techniques, sourcing platforms, and creative sourcing channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, HireEZ, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, engineering communities, niche aerospace networks, conferences, referrals, and more) to identify, engage, and attract exceptional technical talent.

  • Leverage AI to scale sourcing: Design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered sourcing workflows, research agents, and practical automations that increase recruiter productivity, accelerate candidate discovery, enhance market intelligence, and improve operational efficiency.

  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with passive, cleared, or niche engineering talent.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills with the ability to engage highly technical candidates and influence stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies to improve recruiting outcomes.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and able to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

• Prior experience supporting Finance, Accounting, Legal, People, Operations, Strategy, IT, Procurement, or other G&A and corporate functions.
  • Experience navigating export control, ITAR, EAR, or security-cleared recruiting environments.
  • Familiarity with Ashby and recruiting analytics, CRM, or talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-growth, venture-backed technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated passion for staying ahead of emerging recruiting technologies, sourcing methodologies, and AI advancements.

lists.content:
Program Leadership and Execution

  • Develop technical execution plans that drive technology maturation and successful customer outcomes.
  • Establish clear milestones, entry criteria, exit criteria, and measurable success metrics across programs.
  • Manage program cost, schedule, scope, risk, dependencies, and resource allocation.
  • Track customer spending against contractual budgets and program commitments.
  • Identify risks early and drive mitigation strategies that reduce technical, schedule, and business uncertainty.

  • Drive closed-loop communication between customers, engineering teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Support software release planning, roadmap development, prioritization, and resource allocation decisions.

  • Advocate for the capabilities that create the greatest impact for customers and the business.

    • Strategic Initiatives

We are growing the Avionics Engineering team to support the development, integration, test, production, and field support of flight-critical aircraft systems. Our team is responsible for avionics hardware and electrical systems that support communications, compute, autonomy, power, telemetry, sensors, and other mission-critical aircraft functions.

You will directly supervise a team of professional and skilled engineering technicians supporting integration, testing, debugging. This role is both a hands-on technical leadership position and a people leadership position. You will execute assignments based on defined objectives and established processes while providing guidance, mentorship, and daily direction to the technician team.

You will work closely with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, production, quality, supply chain, maintenance technicians, flight support team members, subordinate supervisors, and cross-functional peers to ensure avionics hardware is built, tested, debugged, documented, and supported safely and effectively.
