lists.content:
• Directly supervise professional and skilled engineering technicians supporting avionics system testing, integration, debugging, production support, maintenance support, and flight support activities.
  • Execute team assignments based on defined objectives, approved processes, engineering direction, production priorities, and program schedules.
  • Read, interpret, and apply harness schematics, PCBA schematics, wiring diagrams, interface control documents, engineering drawings, test procedures, work instructions, and production documentation.
  • Support avionics integration and test activities from bench-level checkout through subsystem, aircraft, production, maintenance, and flight-support environments.
  • Work closely with engineers to support hardware bring-up, design verification, test execution, root-cause investigations, corrective actions, and design or process improvements.
  • Partner with production teams to resolve build issues, installation problems, test failures, rework needs, hardware readiness concerns, and schedule constraints.
  • Collaborate with quality teams to ensure work complies with inspection requirements, workmanship standards, configuration control expectations, nonconformance processes, and approved procedures.
  • Coordinate with supply chain teams to communicate material shortages, suspect hardware, part replacement needs, supplier issues, and impacts to build, test, or flight-readiness schedules.
  • Support maintenance technicians and flight support team members during aircraft checkout, avionics troubleshooting, system modification, ground test, and flight readiness activities.
  • Administer company policies and procedures directly affecting employees, including expectations related to safety, quality, attendance, work assignments, training, performance, compliance, and conduct.
  • Interpret policies, procedures, and work instructions to determine appropriate action when resolving routine employee, operational, quality, or technical execution issues.
  • Analyze data and relevant factors, including test results, failure trends, technician workload, schedule performance, hardware status, quality findings, material availability, and operational risks.
  • Develop, manage, and adjust routine operational plans to support daily priorities, weekly execution, production needs, integration milestones, maintenance activities, flight support, and monthly targets.
  • Use and oversee use of electrical and avionics test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, breakout boxes, bus analyzers, automated test equipment, and related lab or production tools.
  • Drive continuous improvement in technician training, troubleshooting methods, test procedures, documentation quality, tooling, workflow, and operational execution.

• 6+ years of hands-on experience with avionics systems, aircraft electrical systems, electronics, harnesses, PCBAs, integrated test environments, or complex hardware systems.
  • 2+ years of experience directly supervising, leading, training, or coordinating skilled technicians in an engineering, production, test, aerospace, aviation, maintenance, or advanced manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret harness schematics, PCBA schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings, test procedures, and work instructions.
  • Experience performing avionics or electrical troubleshooting across wiring, connectors, PCBAs, power systems, sensors, communication interfaces, test equipment, and integrated systems.
  • Experience using electrical and avionics test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, analyzers, breakout boxes, and automated test systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide guidance and training to technicians during hands-on technical work.
  • Demonstrated ability to execute assignments based on defined objectives, established processes, schedule priorities, and operational targets.
  • Experience administering workplace policies, reinforcing safety and quality standards, and supporting employee performance expectations.
  • Ability to analyze technical data, test results, operational constraints, schedule risks, quality findings, and resource availability to determine appropriate next steps.
  • Sound judgment in prioritizing work, assigning resources, escalating risks, and making decisions within defined objectives and processes.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering, production, quality, supply chain, maintenance technicians, flight support team members, subordinate supervisors, and functional peers.

We are growing the Avionics Engineering team to support the development, integration, test, production, and field support of flight-critical aircraft systems. Our team is responsible for avionics hardware and electrical systems that support communications, compute, autonomy, power, telemetry, sensors, and other mission-critical aircraft functions.

You will directly supervise a team of professional and skilled engineering technicians supporting integration, testing, debugging. This role is both a hands-on technical leadership position and a people leadership position. You will execute assignments based on defined objectives and established processes while providing guidance, mentorship, and daily direction to the technician team.

You will work closely with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, production, quality, supply chain, maintenance technicians, flight support team members, subordinate supervisors, and cross-functional peers to ensure avionics hardware is built, tested, debugged, documented, and supported safely and effectively. This role requires the ability to read and interpret harness schematics, PCBA schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings, test procedures, and work instructions.

The ideal candidate is a technically credible leader who can guide a team through complex, high-consequence avionics work; embed training into daily execution; analyze data and relevant factors; exercise sound judgment; interpret policies and procedures.

lists.content:

  • Advanced JQL expertise and dashboard/report development.
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Experience writing scripts (Python, Groovy, or similar).
  • Experience managing enterprise-scale environments (1,000+ users).
  • Familiarity with ITIL, governance, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience with advanced reporting and analytics tools such as:
  • Power BI integrations
  • Tableau integrations
  • Experience integrating Atlassian products with Microsoft Azure services (Azure DevOps, Entra ID, and CI/CD pipelines).

Job Description:

The Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, support, optimization, and continuous improvement of the enterprise IT infrastructure supporting Shield AI's business operations. This role designs, implements, maintains, and troubleshoots enterprise systems across cloud, endpoint, identity, server, and collaboration platforms while ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable services.

The Senior Systems Administrator partners with Infrastructure, Networking, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver operational excellence, improve system reliability, automate administrative processes, and support strategic IT initiatives. This position serves as a technical lead for enterprise infrastructure projects and provides advanced troubleshooting for complex operational issues.

lists.content:
• Administer, maintain, and optimize enterprise Windows, Linux, and macOS systems supporting corporate business operations.
  • Design, implement, configure, and support enterprise infrastructure including cloud services, identity management, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, and core IT systems.
  • Analyze system performance, availability, and operational metrics to proactively improve reliability, scalability, and security.
  • Administer Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Group Policy, authentication services, and role-based access controls.
  • Deploy, maintain, and support endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune, JAMF, and related management technologies.
  • Plan and execute infrastructure upgrades, migrations, patch management, and lifecycle replacement initiatives.
  • Lead technical implementation of enterprise IT projects while coordinating with Infrastructure, Security, Networking, and business stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, operating system, cloud, and application issues using root cause analysis methodologies.
  • Support LAN/WAN connectivity, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and network-related troubleshooting in partnership with networking teams.
  • Develop automation using PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual administration.
  • Maintain accurate system documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Manage enterprise hardware and software assets throughout their lifecycle including procurement, deployment, maintenance, and decommissioning.
  • Participate in incident response, change management, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity activities.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and perform scheduled maintenance outside normal business hours as required.
  • Mentor junior administrators and provide technical guidance across the Enterprise IT organization.

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of progressively responsible experience administering enterprise IT infrastructure and systems.
  • Strong experience supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems within enterprise environments.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and identity management.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and Intune.
  • Experience managing endpoint platforms such as JAMF, Intune, or Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing, VPN, DNS, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting enterprise cloud infrastructure and SaaS platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root cause analysis skills across operating systems, infrastructure, and enterprise applications.
  • Experience implementing system upgrades, migrations, and enterprise infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, or similar tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high operational standards.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and support planned maintenance activities.

Job Description:

As we scale rapidly across EMEA and APJ regions, we’re looking for a highly driven Senior Talent Sourcer who lives and breathes talent discovery - someone who can take a complex, highly specialized needs and translate it into a precision sourcing strategy. You’ll be the go-to expert for market mapping, proactive candidate generation, and pipeline cultivation across our Go-to-Market and Engineering groups.

This isn’t just a "find resumes" role - it’s about building intelligence, relationships, and repeatable systems that fuel our engineering hiring engine. As a Senior Talent Sourcer, you'll serve as a strategic partner to recruiters and hiring leaders while leveraging modern AI tools, market intelligence, and scalable sourcing practices to help us identify and hire world-class engineering talent.

lists.content:
• Own the top of funnel: Partner closely with recruiters and hiring leaders to define target profiles and build deep, data-informed sourcing strategies across Go-To-Market, G&A, Electrical, Mechanical, Software, Embedded, AI/ML, Systems, Manufacturing, and other disciplines across the organization.
  • Map the market: Develop comprehensive talent landscapes by company, skillset, geography, and organizational structure; identify hidden talent pools, competitor insights, and emerging talent trends to inform recruiting strategy and workforce planning.
  • Generate and engage: Use advanced Boolean search techniques, sourcing platforms, and creative sourcing channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, HireEZ, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, engineering communities, niche aerospace networks, conferences, referrals, and more) to identify, engage, and attract exceptional technical talent.
  • Build pipelines proactively: Cultivate long-term relationships with passive, cleared, and highly specialized engineering talent to enable just-in-time hiring across strategic programs.
  • Leverage AI to scale sourcing: Design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered sourcing workflows, research agents, and practical automations that increase recruiter productivity, accelerate candidate discovery, enhance market intelligence, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Build repeatable sourcing systems: Use AI tools and workflow automation to create structured market maps, talent intelligence reports, outreach content, sourcing documentation, and scalable recruiting processes that can be leveraged across the Talent Acquisition organization.
  • Be the sourcing SME: Serve as the subject matter expert on technical sourcing by coaching recruiters and hiring managers on market insights, sourcing strategy, talent availability, competitive intelligence, candidate engagement best practices, and emerging recruiting technologies.
  • Partner for impact: Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition Operations, Employer Brand, University Recruiting, and Engineering leaders to optimize recruiting strategies, outbound messaging, candidate experience, and operational excellence.

• 5+ years of talent sourcing experience, ideally in aerospace, defense, autonomy, or other complex hardware/software industries.

  • Deep expertise in advanced Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, HireEZ, SeekOut, ClearanceJobs, GitHub, and other modern sourcing platforms.

  • Hands-on experience building or leveraging AI-powered sourcing workflows, agentic AI tools, workflow automations, or practical AI solutions that improve recruiting or business processes.
  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with passive, cleared, or niche engineering talent.

  • Highly organized, data-driven, and able to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

• Prior experience supporting aerospace, robotics, autonomy, AI/ML, or advanced vehicle engineering organizations.
  • Experience navigating export control, ITAR, EAR, or security-cleared recruiting environments.
  • Familiarity with Ashby and recruiting analytics, CRM, or talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-growth, venture-backed technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated passion for staying ahead of emerging recruiting technologies, sourcing methodologies, and AI advancements.

Job Description:

Do you enjoy working in a dynamic lab environment and contributing to hardware that can directly impact the safety of service members and civilians? Shield AI is looking for a hands-on Vibration Test Engineer to help validate the next generation of intelligent autonomous systems through rigorous dynamic testing.

The Mechanical Test team's mission is to inform and improve Shield AI hardware design by quantifying product performance through custom measurement systems, specialized testing, and rigorous analysis. As a Vibration Test Engineer, you will serve as the team's subject matter expert in vibration and structural dynamics, leading efforts to characterize hardware response, validate analytical models, and ensure products can withstand demanding operational environments.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about structural dynamics, curious about how complex systems behave under dynamic loading, and excited to solve challenging engineering problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You will partner closely with Mechanical Design, Analysis, Flight Test, Manufacturing, and Reliability teams to develop test strategies, investigate failures, and improve hardware performance throughout the product lifecycle.

Success in this role requires deep technical expertise in vibration testing, strong analytical thinking, exceptional organization, and the ability to communicate complex technical findings to cross-functional engineering teams.

lists.content:
• Lead the planning, execution, and analysis of vibration test programs supporting product development, qualification, and flight readiness.
  • Design, build, and deploy instrumented test setups for vibration, modal, structural, and environmental testing using industry-standard measurement equipment.
  • Execute shaker table testing including sine sweep, random vibration, sine-on-random, resonance search, dwell, and shock testing.
  • Perform experimental modal analysis to characterize structural dynamics and validate finite element models.
  • Develop fixture designs and test methodologies that accurately replicate operational loading conditions while minimizing fixture influence.
  • Instrument hardware using accelerometers, strain gauges, force sensors, displacement sensors, and other dynamic measurement systems.
  • Analyze vibration response data using frequency-domain and time-domain techniques to identify resonances, mode shapes, damping characteristics, and potential failure mechanisms.
  • Partner closely with Mechanical Design and Structural Analysis engineers to correlate test results with analytical models and improve future designs.
  • Investigate vibration-related hardware issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend design improvements.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, procedures, reports, and technical presentations that clearly communicate results and engineering recommendations.
  • Maintain vibration testing equipment, data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and calibration records.
  • Support environmental qualification testing and other mechanical test activities as needed.

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience performing vibration testing of mechanical or aerospace systems through industry, research, internships, or competitive engineering projects.
  • Experience operating electrodynamic shaker systems and associated vibration control software.
  • Experience with accelerometers, signal conditioning, data acquisition systems, and dynamic instrumentation.
  • Working knowledge of structural dynamics, vibration theory, modal analysis, and frequency response functions.
  • Experience performing or supporting experimental modal testing and finite element model correlation.
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-810 vibration and shock testing or equivalent aerospace qualification standards.
  • Experience interpreting vibration data and identifying resonances, structural response characteristics, and failure modes.
  • Working knowledge of CAD software (NX preferred).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of technical work, drive projects independently, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret//Special Access Required (S//SAR) security clearance is desired.

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical field with an emphasis in structural dynamics or vibration.
  • Experience designing vibration test fixtures and specialized dynamic test equipment.
  • Experience using vibration control and data acquisition platforms such as Data Physics, Brüel & Kjær (HBK), Crystal Instruments, m+p International, LMS/Simcenter Testlab, or similar systems.
  • Experience with finite element analysis software (ANSYS, Abaqus, Nastran, or equivalent) and test-analysis correlation.
  • Experience with strain gauge testing, digital image correlation (DIC), or other advanced structural measurement techniques.
  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, robotics, UAV, or other high-reliability hardware development programs.
  • Experience with Design of Experiments (DOE), root cause analysis, and failure investigation.

lists.content:
Technical Leadership

  • Lead the technical direction of significant edge software capabilities spanning edge compute, imaging, sensor integration, and mission systems. 

  • Influence software architecture across multiple projects and engineering teams. 

  • Drive engineering excellence through design reviews, technical standards, and pragmatic engineering practices. 

  • Mentor and coach engineers, helping raise the technical capability of the wider organisation. 

  • Partner with systems, autonomy, AI, and product teams to translate long-term capability into engineering roadmaps. 

  • Identify technical risks early and guide teams toward robust, maintainable solutions. 

  • Balance long-term architectural investment with practical product delivery. 

    • Software Engineering

    • Design, develop, test, and maintain production C++ software for edge systems, imaging systems, mission applications, developer tooling, and automated test infrastructure. 

    • Build user-space Windows and Linux applications for NVIDIA Jetson, ARM64, and other edge compute platforms connected to cameras, sensors, and mission systems. 

    • Integrate RGB, NIR, and thermal cameras alongside GPS, IMU, and other sensors using interfaces such as MIPI CSI, GMSL, Ethernet, serial, or comparable hardware-facing protocols. 

    • Develop calibration, synchronisation, data capture, diagnostics, inspection, and configuration tools for complex sensor systems. 

    • Optimise software for latency, throughput, reliability, power consumption, and thermal performance on constrained edge compute platforms. 

    • Debug challenging issues spanning application software, Linux, networking, hardware interfaces, timing, deployment, and system integration. 

    • Own technical outcomes from ambiguous requirements through design, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery. 

    • Collaborate across systems, hardware, AI, autonomy, product, and test teams to deliver integrated capability.

• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience. 

  • Strong commercial experience developing modern C++ software for Linux. 

  • Demonstrated experience developing user-space applications that interface with cameras, sensors, networking, GPUs, storage, or other hardware through operating system APIs, middleware, or vendor SDKs. 

  • Practical experience developing and debugging software on Linux. 

  • Experience developing complex C++ applications on Linux, Windows, or both. Experience deploying software to Linux-based edge compute platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson or comparable ARM64 systems is highly regarded. 

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals including concurrency, interfaces, memory management, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control. 

  • Proven ability to diagnose complex issues across software, Linux, networking, timing, hardware integration, and deployment boundaries. 

  • Experience owning technical work from incomplete requirements through design, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery. 

  • Excellent collaboration skills across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

We do not expect candidates to have all of the following. Experience in any of these areas will help you stand out. 

  • Runtime-critical, multi-threaded, or performance-sensitive C++ software. 

  • High-throughput imaging or sensor processing pipelines, including camera integration, ISP tuning, GStreamer, FFmpeg, OpenCV, or similar technologies. 

  • Hardware-accelerated processing on edge compute platforms including NVIDIA Jetson, Qualcomm Snapdragon, CUDA, GPU compute, embedded AI accelerators, or accelerated video processing. 

  • Integration of RGB, NIR, and thermal cameras, GPS, IMU, GPUs, or comparable peripheral hardware. 

  • Robotics, aerospace, defence, autonomy, unmanned systems, automotive, or other mission-critical domains. 

  • Systems architecture, interface design, software decomposition, reliability, maintainability, and testability. 

  • Low-level Linux, vendor SDKs, driver-adjacent debugging, NixOS, edge AI inference, containerisation, or deployment tooling. 

  • Automated testing, simulation, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, CI/CD, or deployment infrastructure.

lists.text: Additional Experience for Staff Level Engineers:
lists.content:
While we hire across multiple experience levels, successful Staff Engineer candidates will typically demonstrate several of the following: 

  • Experience defining architecture for large or technically complex software systems. 

  • A track record of influencing technical direction across multiple teams or products. 

  • Proven technical leadership through influence rather than organisational authority. 

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and helping grow engineering capability across an organisation. 

  • Ownership of long-term technical strategy alongside day-to-day software delivery. 

  • Strong judgement when balancing performance, reliability, maintainability, scalability, and delivery. 

  • Experience establishing engineering standards, reusable frameworks, or software platforms adopted by multiple teams.

lists.content:
Specialist Sales Support 

  • Serve as the specialist sales resource for the Aechelon simulation portfolio across priority international markets. 
  • Partner with regional sales leaders, account owners, and business development teams to identify, qualify, and advance simulation opportunities. 
  • Support account strategy, opportunity planning, and customer engagement efforts related to the Aechelon portfolio. 
  • Help drive pipeline development for simulation opportunities and maintain visibility into key pursuits, risks, and next steps. 

    • Customer and Partner Engagement 

  • Participate in customer meetings, capability discussions, demonstrations, and follow-up actions to help progress opportunities. 
  • Articulate the value of Aechelon’s simulation offerings in a clear, mission-relevant, and customer-oriented way. 
  • Support relationship development with international defense, government, and partner stakeholders. 
  • Help connect customer requirements to product capabilities in coordination with sales, product, and technical teams. 

    • Pursuit and Deal Support 

  • Support the development of customer-facing materials, presentations, proposals, and competitive positioning for simulation opportunities. 
  • Coordinate with internal teams to support demos, strategic pursuits, bids, and executive engagements. 
  • Contribute market, customer, and competitive insight to improve positioning and increase win probability. 
  • Help drive disciplined follow-up and execution across active opportunities. 

    • Cross-Functional Alignment 

  • Partner closely with GTM, International, Product, Marketing, and Operations to support simulation growth initiatives. 
  • Provide field feedback to improve messaging, enablement, campaign focus, and product positioning. 
  • Contribute to business reporting, opportunity updates, and operating cadence as needed. 
  • Help ensure internal alignment on priorities, customer engagement plans, and support needs.

• International simulation opportunities are identified early, well supported, and advanced with clear coordination and momentum. 
  • Regional sales teams have strong specialist support for Aechelon-related customer discussions, positioning, and pursuits. 
  • Customer interactions clearly connect simulation capabilities to training, rehearsal, readiness, and mission outcomes. 
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned in support of international simulation growth priorities.

• 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, overlay sales, capture support, account management, or related customer-facing roles. 
  • Demonstrated ability to support or drive complex technology sales in international, enterprise, government, or defense environments. 
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. 
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to position technical solutions in terms of customer value and mission relevance. 
  • Strong organizational skills and follow-through, including the ability to manage multiple active opportunities and stakeholder needs. 
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

• Experience in simulation, training, mission systems, enterprise software, autonomy, aerospace, or defense technology. 
  • Familiarity with international sales motions, government or defense procurement, and partner-driven growth models. 
  • Experience working in a specialist seller or overlay role in support of regional sales teams. 
  • Background supporting multi-region customers, channel partners, or strategic international pursuits. 
  • Fluency in an additional language relevant to priority markets is a plus.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded specialist seller who is comfortable operating in a matrixed and fast-moving environment. This person should be able to build credibility with customers, support regional sales teams, and help move complex opportunities forward with consistency and professionalism. 

This role offers broad exposure across GTM, product, and international business and is a strong opportunity to help scale Shield AI’s simulation business globally while supporting customer missions and advancing a strategically important portfolio.

About The Team
The Autonomy Capabilities team at Shield AI has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, control systems, optimization, and data analysis to create software solutions that greatly evolve the capabilities of our customers. The team is responsible for developing autonomous behaviors within Shield AI’s industry-leading mission autonomy software stack and deploying them across a breadth of platforms, including the Anduril Fury, Northrup Grumman Talon, Shield AI V-Bat, and other first and third-party autonomous vehicles. We work in close coordination with specialist teams in software integration, hardware, and test engineering to solve some of the hardest problems facing our customers.

lists.content: As an Engineer II, you’ll help build and test the autonomy behaviors that power our unmanned systems, working closely with experienced engineers to bring new capabilities to life. You’ll focus on implementing and validating well-defined features while developing your skills in autonomy, robotics, and large-scale software systems. In this role, you’ll gain exposure to how autonomy software moves from concept to real-world deployment, contributing to systems that operate in complex, high-stakes environments.

• Implement tactical autonomy software features that enable unmanned platforms to perform complex missions across air, land, sea, and space domains
  • Develop and test behaviors supporting coordination, target engagement, reconnaissance, and survivability in contested scenarios
  • Participate in the software development lifecycle, including implementation, testing, debugging, and supporting verification and validation efforts
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to integrate software components with broader system elements (e.g., sensor processing, communications, and actuation)
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and team practices
  • Support integration and testing across simulation and real-world environments
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and support successful feature delivery
  • Continue building expertise in software engineering, autonomy, and robotics systems
  • Travel up to 20% to support testing, integration, and collaboration with partner teams

• BS in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in production-level C++ software development
  • 2-3 years of experience in one or more of the following: software sub-system scheduling and integration, behavior planning, task and resource allocation, motion planning, optimization, or flight controls
  • Experience with collaborative software development tools for version control, issue tracking, code reviews, release management
  • Ability to contribute to the design, development, and integration of complex software systems as part of a multi-disciplinary team
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to learn new technologies in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to collaborate closely with teammates and support team objectives
  • Interest in growing technical skills and, over time, providing guidance to more junior engineers
  • Desire to work in a highly collaborative, fast paced, and mission-driven environment
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

• Exposure to systems operating at different technology readiness levels (TRLs) through academic, research, or internship experience
  • Experience in the delivery of a military mission system
  • Familiarity with mission systems integration concepts, testing, or demonstrations
  • Experience (academic or project-based) in one or more of the following areas:
  • Motion planning, behavior planning, or multi-agent coordination
  • Expose to autonomy, control, or decision-making systems
  • Safety mechanisms such as collision avoidance or constraint enforcement
  • Familiarity with robotic software tools (e.g., ROS, OMPL, or similar frameworks)
  • Experience using simulation environments for development or testing
  • Basic understanding of navigation and/or communications systems
  • Awareness of the software or systems development lifecycle
  • Familiarity with systems engineering fundamentals
  • Exposure to high-assurance or safety-critical software concepts (e.g., DO-178C or similar)

Job Description:

We are seeking a Sr Director Engineering to lead all engineering efforts for V-BAT, an established Group 3 VTOL UAS program. This individual will be responsible for directing and sustaining a high-performing, multidisciplinary team that delivers flight software, autonomy, ground control systems, aircraft, and payloads for a vertical takeoff and landing autonomous aircraft that is currently deployed worldwide. 

This is a foundational leadership role for an existing product line that is growing in system maturity and mission capability. The ideal candidate combines deep technical experience across complex aerospace and UAS systems (with the ability to dive deep across a broad spectrum of engineering disciplines), a background in innovative and disruptive companies, and a proven ability to build and scale organizations and collaborate across disciplines in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

lists.content:
Leadership & Strategy 
  • Build and lead the engineering and software team for the Group 3 UAS program, spanning flight software, autonomy, flight controls/GNC, ground systems, flight systems, flight sciences, avionics, payloads, and propulsion. 
  • Define the engineering vision, technical strategy, and system architecture in alignment with the program roadmap, product line strategy, and long-term technology investments. 
  • Serve as the senior technical leader for engineering within the program, making architectural decisions, managing technical and program risk, and driving execution across subsystems and suppliers. 
  • Lead organizational planning, workforce strategy, and capability roadmap to support multiple concurrent development, test, and sustainment efforts. 
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across engineering, flight test, operations, program management, supply chain, quality, and production to enable predictable, high-quality product delivery. 
    • Technical Governance & Engineering Excellence 
  • Establish and continuously improve engineering standards, technical governance, configuration management, documentation practices, and development processes (including CI/CD, automated testing, and modern DevOps practices). 
  • Drive engineering rigor through disciplined technical reviews, root cause analysis, lessons learned, and continuous improvement while maintaining the execution speed required in a fast-paced development environment. 
  • Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace standards, certification or airworthiness expectations, regulatory requirements, and company engineering policies. 
    • Team Building 
  • Attract, hire, and retain top-tier talent across engineering disciplines, building scalable organizations capable of supporting current and future platforms. 
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, accountability, and high ownership. 
  • Mentor and grow Directors, engineering managers, and technical leads to support scaling and program longevity. 
    • Stakeholder & Executive Engagement 
  • Report regularly on progress, risks, and technical decisions to senior leadership, clearly articulating tradeoffs and investment recommendations. 
  • Interface with external partners, customers, and government stakeholders as needed to represent the engineering roadmap, technical strategy, and program status. 
  • Support business development and capture activities by defining technical approaches, architectures, and execution plans for new opportunities.

• Typically requires a minimum of 15 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. 
  • Strong technical background in one or more of: aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering and avionics, propulsion, or closely related disciplines. 
  • Experience building and leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and organizations (including direct managers and technical leaders) across hardware, software, and systems. 
  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage and inspire cross-functional teams; excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Proven track record of successfully shipping products, showcasing the ability to navigate development cycles, overcome obstacles, and deliver high-quality solutions to meet project deadlines and customer expectations in a fast-paced environment.

Job Description:

Shield AI is hiring a Lead Financial Analyst, Aircraft Business Unit to support financial planning, forecasting, and decision support for the Aircraft Business Unit. This role emphasizes business partnering, forecasting, variance analysis, and translating operational drivers into actionable insights.

lists.content:
Support forecasting and planning for the Aircraft Business

  • Lead monthly forecasting, quarterly outlooks, and annual planning for assigned Aircraft Business departments and programs.
  • Build and maintain financial models that connect headcount, labor, material, overhead, and operating initiatives to business performance.
  • Analyze actuals versus plan, identify risks and opportunities, and provide clear recommendations to business leaders.
  • Translate production, engineering, and program assumptions into financial impacts for spend, margins, and resource needs.
  • Prepare reporting packages and presentations for finance leadership and Aircraft Business reviews.

    • Partner with Aircraft Business leaders

  • Serve as the Finance Business Partner to leaders across engineering, operations, supply chain, manufacturing, and program management within the Aircraft Business.
  • Support decision-making on hiring, labor planning, vendor spend, capital investments, and operating tradeoffs.
  • Partner with program and functional leaders to improve forecast accuracy, cost visibility, and accountability.
  • Provide ad hoc analysis on key business questions, including rate, volume, mix, productivity, and cost reduction opportunities.

    • Improve reporting and planning processes

  • Build repeatable reporting, dashboards, and planning templates that reduce manual work and improve insight quality.
  • Partner with Corporate FP&A, Accounting, HR, and business systems teams to improve data quality and planning inputs.
  • Support enhancements to planning tools and financial systems, including Anaplan models, reporting workflows, and source-system integration needs.
  • Document business requirements clearly and translate finance needs for technical teams.

• 7+ years of experience in FP&A, program finance, operations finance, or business finance.
  • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis skills.
  • Experience partnering with operational or technical teams to support planning and decision-making.
  • Ability to connect operational drivers to financial outcomes in a complex, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to present insights clearly to cross-functional leaders.
  • Advanced Excel and proficiency with planning or ERP systems; experience with Anaplan is a plus.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and managing multiple priorities at once.

• Experience in aerospace, defense, or other complex manufacturing environments.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing finance, program finance, inventory or cost accounting, and capital planning.
  • Experience supporting engineering, operations, supply chain, or production organizations.
  • Exposure to government contract structures, program reviews, or defense-related reporting rhythms.
  • Strong data fluency, including dashboards, data models, and system-driven planning processes.

lists.content:
• Lead the aerostructures design organization for the X-BAT program.

  • Build and mentor a world-class aerostructures engineering team capable of rapid execution and technical excellence
  • Support transition from development programs into scalable production environments

  • Present technical reviews, program risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and external stakeholders

  • Deep expertise in aircraft primary structures, composites, metallic design, structural analysis, and integration
  • Experience leading teams through full aircraft development cycles from conceptual design through flight test and production
  • Strong understanding of aircraft loads, stress analysis, fatigue, durability, and structural substantiation methodologies
  • Experience collaborating across highly integrated aerospace development organizations
  • Proven ability to recruit, develop, and scale high-performing engineering teams
  • Experience operating in fast-paced development environments with aggressive technical schedules
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

• Advanced degree in Aerospace Engineering or related discipline
  • Experience with autonomous aircraft, tactical aviation, unmanned systems, or defense aerospace platforms
  • Expertise in composite airframe manufacturing and high-rate production methodologies
  • Background supporting low observable, survivability, or expeditionary aircraft design considerations
  • Familiarity with military airworthiness standards and defense acquisition environments
  • Experience supporting prototype-to-production transitions in venture-backed or high-growth aerospace organizationsDirector, Aerostructures – X-BAT

lists.content:
• Develop and execute dimensional inspection strategies for complex mechanical assemblies and precision components
  • Perform dimensional analysis and measurement studies to validate design intent, manufacturing capability, and assembly fit
  • Define metrology processes, tooling, and inspection methods using CMMs, laser trackers, scanners, and other precision measurement systems
  • Partner with design and manufacturing teams to improve tolerance schemes, GD&T application, and inspection efficiency
  • Support root cause investigations related to dimensional nonconformance, assembly variation, and manufacturing defects
  • Analyze measurement and process capability data to improve repeatability, product quality, and production readiness

• 5+ years of experience in metrology, dimensional engineering, manufacturing quality, or precision inspection environments
  • Strong understanding of GD&T, tolerance analysis, datum structures, and dimensional validation methods
  • Experience programming or operating metrology equipment such as CMMs, laser trackers, structured light scanners, or portable measurement systems
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and manufacturing documentation for complex assemblies
  • Experience developing inspection plans, measurement strategies, and process capability studies in production environments
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate technical findings across cross-functional teams

• Experience supporting aerospace, defense, robotics, or autonomous systems programs
  • Familiarity with AS9100, ISO 9001, and regulated manufacturing environments
  • Experience with NX, PolyWorks, PC-DMIS, SpatialAnalyzer, or similar metrology and dimensional analysis software
  • Experience supporting first article inspections (FAI), production qualification, or supplier quality initiatives

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an International Aechelon / Simulation Sales Specialist to help drive growth of the Aechelon simulation portfolio across international markets. This role will serve as a specialist seller within GTM, partnering with regional sales leaders and account teams to identify, shape, and advance simulation opportunities with customers and partners. 

The International Aechelon / Simulation Sales Specialist will combine product and market knowledge with strong commercial execution. This person will help position the Aechelon portfolio, support customer engagement, and drive opportunity development across priority international regions. The role is designed for a mission-focused, customer-facing professional who can work across functions, support complex pursuits, and help translate simulation capabilities into customer value. 

Why This Role Matters:

Simulation is a key growth lever for Shield AI and an important part of how customers train, rehearse, and prepare for mission success. As Shield AI integrates Aechelon and scales its simulation go-to-market efforts, this role will provide dedicated specialist sales support to regional teams and help accelerate growth in international markets. 

This is an overlay-style role for someone who can combine solution selling, customer engagement, pursuit support, and strong internal collaboration. Success in this position requires ownership, responsiveness, commercial judgment, and the ability to operate effectively across teams, regions, and time zones. 

Role Profile:

The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded specialist seller who is comfortable operating in a matrixed and fast-moving environment. This person should be able to build credibility with customers, support regional sales teams, and help move complex opportunities forward with consistency and professionalism. 

This role offers broad exposure across GTM, product, and international business and is a strong opportunity to help scale Shield AI’s simulation business globally while supporting customer missions and advancing a strategically important portfolio.

lists.content:
Specialist Sales Support 

  • Serve as the specialist sales resource for the Aechelon simulation portfolio across priority international markets. 

    • Partner with regional sales leaders, account owners, and business development teams to identify, qualify, and advance simulation opportunities. 

      • Support account strategy, opportunity planning, and customer engagement efforts related to the Aechelon portfolio. 

        • Help drive pipeline development for simulation opportunities and maintain visibility into key pursuits, risks, and next steps. 

          • Customer and Partner Engagement 

          • Participate in customer meetings, capability discussions, demonstrations, and follow-up actions to help progress opportunities. 

            • Articulate the value of Aechelon’s simulation offerings in a clear, mission-relevant, and customer-oriented way. 

              • Support relationship development with international defense, government, and partner stakeholders. 

                • Help connect customer requirements to product capabilities in coordination with sales, product, and technical teams. 

                  • Pursuit and Deal Support 

                  • Support the development of customer-facing materials, presentations, proposals, and competitive positioning for simulation opportunities. 

                    • Coordinate with internal teams to support demos, strategic pursuits, bids, and executive engagements. 

                      • Contribute market, customer, and competitive insight to improve positioning and increase win probability. 

                        • Help drive disciplined follow-up and execution across active opportunities. 

                          • Cross-Functional Alignment 

                          • Partner closely with GTM, International, Product, Marketing, and Operations to support simulation growth initiatives. 

                            • Provide field feedback to improve messaging, enablement, campaign focus, and product positioning. 

                              • Contribute to business reporting, opportunity updates, and operating cadence as needed. 

                                • Help ensure internal alignment on priorities, customer engagement plans, and support needs. 

                                  • What Success Looks Like 

                                  • International simulation opportunities are identified early, well supported, and advanced with clear coordination and momentum. 

                                    • Regional sales teams have strong specialist support for Aechelon-related customer discussions, positioning, and pursuits. 

                                      • Customer interactions clearly connect simulation capabilities to training, rehearsal, readiness, and mission outcomes. 

                                        • Cross-functional teams are aligned in support of international simulation growth priorities.

• 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, overlay sales, capture support, account management, or related customer-facing roles. 

    • Demonstrated ability to support or drive complex technology sales in international, enterprise, government, or defense environments. 

      • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. 

        • Commercial acumen and the ability to position technical solutions in terms of customer value and mission relevance. 

          • Strong organizational skills and follow-through, including the ability to manage multiple active opportunities and stakeholder needs. 

            • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

• Experience in simulation, training, mission systems, enterprise software, autonomy, aerospace, or defense technology. 

    • Familiarity with international sales motions, government or defense procurement, and partner-driven growth models. 

      • Experience working in a specialist seller or overlay role in support of regional sales teams. 

        • Background supporting multi-region customers, channel partners, or strategic international pursuits. 

          • Fluency in an additional language relevant to priority markets is a plus.

Job Description:

We are currently seeking highly skilled Production Technicians to work on composite aircraft, avionics and all systems associated.
This role is for a hands-on person with excellent interpersonal skills and experience in a quality-focused production environment.
The ideal candidate will work with engineering drawings and detailed instructions to acquire the desired finish of each production component as well as assist with fabrication and assembly tasks.

lists.content:
• Support and perform assembly, testing and configuration of aircraft systems such as: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV), Avionics, Ground Control Stations (GCS), Ground Support Equipment (GSE), Ground Data Terminals (GDT), and electronics.
  • Assist in troubleshooting, component removal/replacement and testing and documentation while utilizing approved technical publications, maintenance standards and approved procedures.
  • Trim, Paint, and Bodywork UAV Components.
  • Assemble, Test, and Support engine ground runs and break-ins.
  • Modifications or repairs to composite components if needed.
  • Coordinate with and assist other team members to ensure on-time delivery of aircraft.
  • Interpret engineering drawings, diagrams as well as work instructions and manuals related to all part fabrication.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

• Minimally 6 months-1 year of relevant experience in a combination of Aircraft Production/Manufacturing including but not limited to Composite Layup, Avionics fabrication, Avionics Installation, Aircraft Final Assembly, Ground Support ETC.
  • Minimally 6 months-1 year of experience with Material Requirements Planning. (MRP)
  • Must have good interpersonal skills with the ability to interface cooperatively with departmental personnel and customers.

• Possess time management, organizational and communication skills.
  • Strong safety work ethic - recognizes the importance of properly handling hazardous materials, chemicals, tools, etc.
  • Computer skills; knowledgeable in MS software programs, and other relevant computer applications involving production.
  • Analytical and problem-solving approach with the continual pursuit of perfection.
  • Must be able to work in a continually changing environment with the ability to change direction quickly to support departmental needs.

The Sr. Recruiting Coordinator – EMEA is an individual contributor responsible for providing high-level operational and administrative support to the Talent Acquisition function, with primary ownership of complex interview scheduling, candidate travel coordination, and recruiting operations across EMEA.

This role independently manages high-volume and complex interview logistics across multiple countries, time zones, and stakeholder groups while delivering a seamless and high-touch candidate experience. The Recruiting Coordinator partners closely with recruiters, hiring managers, executives, and cross-functional teams to anticipate and resolve coordination challenges and support the successful execution of global hiring initiatives.

As an experienced member of the Talent Acquisition team, this role also serves as a resource for recruiting coordination best practices, identifies opportunities to improve operational processes, and helps establish scalable and consistent ways of working as the organization grows.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Interview Coordination

  • Independently manage high-volume and complex interview scheduling across multiple countries and global time zones
  • Coordinate complex calendars involving candidates, interview panels, hiring managers, executives, and other key stakeholders
  • Arrange virtual and in-person interviews, including multi-stage and multi-day interview processes
  • Anticipate scheduling constraints and proactively identify solutions to minimize delays and ensure an efficient hiring process
  • Prepare and distribute accurate interview confirmations, calendar invitations, interview schedules, and relevant materials
  • Manage last-minute scheduling changes and competing priorities with professionalism, urgency, and sound judgment
  • Ensure interview details and candidate activity are accurately maintained within Talent Acquisition systems
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to determine effective scheduling approaches for complex or business-critical searches
  • Serve as a resource to the Talent Acquisition team on interview coordination practices and processes

Candidate Travel & Logistics

  • Independently coordinate domestic and international candidate travel, including flights and accommodations
  • Prepare and distribute detailed candidate itineraries and ensure candidates have the information necessary for a seamless interview experience
  • Coordinate complex or time-sensitive travel arrangements across multiple EMEA locations
  • Manage travel changes, cancellations, disruptions, and other unexpected issues while minimizing impact to candidates and interview teams
  • Ensure candidate travel arrangements comply with applicable company travel policies and budget guidelines
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors, as appropriate, to resolve travel and logistical issues
  • Identify opportunities to improve candidate travel processes, documentation, and operational consistency

Candidate Experience

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, providing timely, professional, and high-touch support
  • Deliver clear and proactive communication to candidates across multiple countries and time zones
  • Anticipate candidate questions and logistical needs and proactively address issues that could affect the interview experience
  • Ensure a consistent, organized, and positive candidate experience throughout all stages of interview coordination
  • Exercise discretion and professionalism when supporting sensitive, confidential, executive, or business-critical searches
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to continuously improve the candidate experience

Recruiting Operations Support

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely candidate and interview data within Applicant Tracking Systems and other Talent Acquisition tools
  • Support recruiting metrics, reporting, audits, and operational tracking as needed
  • Monitor coordination workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and stakeholder experience
  • Recommend and support implementation of improvements to scheduling, candidate travel, documentation, and recruiting coordination processes
  • Develop and maintain recruiting coordination resources, documentation, templates, and standard operating procedures
  • Support adoption of recruiting tools, processes, and operational best practices across the Talent Acquisition organization
  • Serve as a knowledgeable resource for recruiting coordination processes and provide guidance to recruiters, coordinators, and hiring teams as needed
  • Support onboarding and mentoring of recruiting coordinators or other Talent Acquisition team members, as appropriate
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition, PX, Finance, hiring teams, and other business partners to support hiring initiatives
  • Support special projects and evolving Talent Acquisition priorities as the organization scales

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, Talent Acquisition operations, HR/PX operations, or a related role, including experience independently managing complex recruiting logistics
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating high-volume and complex interview schedules across multiple countries, time zones, and seniority levels
  • Experience managing complex calendars and interview logistics involving candidates, hiring managers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Experience coordinating domestic and international candidate travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, itinerary changes, and travel disruptions
  • Strong working knowledge of Applicant Tracking Systems, scheduling tools, and standard workplace productivity and collaboration platforms
  • Demonstrated ability to independently prioritize competing requests, anticipate issues, and resolve complex scheduling and logistical challenges
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills with exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with candidates and stakeholders at all levels
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with changing priorities and deadlines
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and support recruiting activities across EMEA business hours, as required

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, Talent Acquisition operations, or a related recruiting operations function
  • Experience supporting Talent Acquisition within a high-growth technology, aerospace, defense, engineering, or similarly complex organization
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a subject matter expert or senior resource for interview coordination, candidate logistics, or recruiting operations
  • Experience supporting executive, highly specialized, high-volume, or business-critical hiring
  • Experience identifying, developing, and implementing improvements to recruiting coordination processes and workflows
  • Experience developing standard operating procedures, process documentation, templates, or other scalable recruiting resources
  • Experience supporting recruiting activities across multiple EMEA countries and navigating regional differences in candidate logistics and hiring processes
  • Familiarity with international travel requirements, visa documentation, and corporate travel policies
  • Experience supporting recruiting metrics, reporting, data integrity, and operational tracking
  • Experience onboarding, mentoring, or providing guidance to recruiting coordinators or other Talent Acquisition team members
  • Experience working with modern Applicant Tracking Systems and recruiting technology ecosystems
  • European languages proficiency is a plus

lists.content:

  • Technical aptitude and ability to engage credibly with Engineering, Product, and Operational stakeholders

  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of operating in a fast-paced environment

  • Fluent in: English, Japanese

  • Prior military experience
  • Established relationships within defense, government, or aerospace customer sets
  • Experience working with Large Systems Integrators (LSIs) and strategic partners
  • Ability to travel as needed for customer engagements and industry events
  • Active or eligibility for security clearance
  • MBA or equivalent graduate degree

Job Description:

The Sr. Staff Platform / Data Reliability Engineer is responsible for making Databricks a reliable, secure, scalable, and operationally mature platform for enterprise use. This role focuses on the platform itself rather than domain-specific business modeling, ensuring the lakehouse can support multiple domains, regulated data handling, and a growing set of production workloads without becoming fragile, expensive, or hard to govern. 

This role partners closely with the Senior Staff Data Engineer, who focuses more heavily on ingestion and medallion implementation patterns, and with the existing Cloud & Infrastructure team, which owns cloud accounts, networking, and foundational infrastructure. The Platform / Data Reliability Engineer owns the Databricks operational layer that sits above that foundation: reliability, observability, deployment standards, compute and job policies, and platform enablement patterns for internal users.

lists.content:
• Own operational excellence for the Databricks platform, including monitoring, alerting, observability, incident response support, and production runbook patterns for data jobs and platform services. 
  • Define and maintain CI/CD and promotion standards for Databricks assets, including workflows, jobs, notebooks, code packages, infrastructure configuration, and environment promotion from dev to prod. 
  • Design and maintain platform standards for job orchestration, cluster and compute policies, service principal usage, environment isolation, and production execution reliability.  
  • Establish reusable operational templates and enablement patterns for new domains onboarding to Databricks, including logging conventions, job tagging, metadata capture, and support handoff expectations.  
  • Partner with the Senior Data Engineer to ensure ingestion and medallion patterns are implemented in a way that is observable, recoverable, cost-aware, and secure in production. 
  • Work with the cloud/infrastructure team to align Databricks configuration and usage patterns with broader enterprise cloud standards, especially where commercial and future government-hosted environments are involved.  
  • Help enforce technical controls for data segregation, access boundaries, and operational compliance in a highly regulated environment.  
  • Track and improve platform health metrics such as job success rates, incident trends, data pipeline reliability, cost efficiency, and environment drift. 
  • Document platform standards, operational expectations, and support models so the Databricks platform can scale beyond a small founding team.  
  • Mentor internal engineers who are growing into platform responsibilities, helping expand Databricks operational knowledge within the team.

lists.content:

In this role, you will lead factory and production system design, including facility layouts, material flow, line balancing, capacity planning, and production readiness. You will also play a critical role in planning and executing greenfield manufacturing facilities, developing factory concepts from the ground up, including production layouts, infrastructure requirements, equipment planning, material flow strategies, and manufacturing standards. 

Partnering with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Facilities, Quality, EHS, and Program Management, you will develop efficient, scalable, and data-driven manufacturing solutions that enable rapid production growth. This is a high-impact role responsible for transforming manufacturing concepts into production-ready factories while driving safety, quality, throughput, and operational excellence.

lists.content:
• Lead factory layout development, production line design, and manufacturing system optimization for new and existing production programs.  

  • Support the planning and execution of greenfield manufacturing facilities, including factory master planning, space allocation, utility requirements, equipment placement, production flow, and long-term capacity planning.  

  • Develop manufacturing concepts from initial factory planning through production launch, ensuring scalability, flexibility, and operational efficiency.  

  • Design and optimize material flow, point-of-use storage, supermarkets, kitting strategies, replenishment systems, tugger routes, and warehouse logistics.  

  • Develop detailed 2D factory layouts and 3D manufacturing models, including equipment placement, utilities, workstations, safety zones, production support infrastructure, and future expansion plans.  

  • Perform capacity planning, line balancing, takt time analysis, labor planning, buffer sizing, and bottleneck analysis to achieve production targets.  

  • Conduct time studies, ergonomic assessments, spaghetti diagrams, and workflow analyses to improve productivity and eliminate waste.  

  • Develop manufacturing standards for material presentation, packaging, FIFO management, visual controls, workstation design, and factory operating standards.  

  • Lead cross-functional factory design reviews with Manufacturing Engineering, Production, Facilities, Supply Chain, Quality, EHS, and Program Management.  

  • Utilize discrete-event simulation tools to model production throughput, identify constraints, validate factory designs, and optimize manufacturing strategies before implementation.  

  • Support facility construction, equipment installation, tape-outs, utility coordination, commissioning, and production readiness activities during factory launches.  

  • Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives including 5S, visual management, standardized work, continuous improvement, and value stream optimization.  

  • Develop and maintain factory design standards, launch playbooks, production system guidelines, and manufacturing best practices to support future factory expansions and replication.  

 

Tools & Skills 

  • AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Revit, Visio, or equivalent CAD/layout software  

  • Siemens Plant Simulation, FlexSim, AnyLogic, or equivalent discrete-event simulation software  

  • Time studies, MTM/MOST, work measurement, and labor analysis  

  • Capacity modeling, line balancing, takt planning, and production system design  

  • Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), 5S, Kanban, and Visual Management  

  • Material flow analysis, warehouse and logistics design  

  • Factory master planning and facility layout development  

  • Strong analytical, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.  

  • 8+ years of experience in industrial engineering, factory design, manufacturing systems, production planning, advanced manufacturing engineering, or greenfield facility development.  

  • Experience designing factory layouts, production lines, and scalable manufacturing systems for complex products.  

  • Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing projects, facility expansions, or major production line launches.  

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes including machining, composites, electrical assemblies, precision mechanical assemblies, and final integration.  

  • Experience supporting production ramp-up, new product introduction (NPI), and manufacturing process development.  

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, high-growth manufacturing environment.  

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Aerospace, defense, automotive, or advanced manufacturing industry experience.  

  • Experience leading greenfield factory development, factory relocation, or major manufacturing expansion projects.  

  • Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments.  

  • Experience with automated material handling systems, robotics, AGVs/AMRs, automated storage systems, or Industry 4.0 technologies.  

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent continuous improvement certification.  

  • Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), ERP systems, digital factory technologies, and production simulation software.

lists.content:
• Design and develop structural components and assemblies for Shield AI’s next-generation UAV platform, supporting both primary and secondary aircraft structures.
  • Execute all stages of the design lifecycle including conceptual development, initial CAD modeling, detailed design, and drawing release.
  • Perform hand calculations for stress or strain with limited basic FEA analysis, with guidance from senior engineers as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with aerodynamics, propulsion, avionics, payload, and manufacturing teams to support system integration across airframe interfaces.
  • Support structural validation efforts including coupon testing, subcomponent testing, and system-level verification.
  • Generate high-quality design documentation, drawings, interface definitions, and analysis reports in compliance with aerospace standards.
  • Partner with manufacturing and flight test teams to resolve build issues and support hardware through test and deployment.
  • Participate in design reviews and technical discussions, presenting work clearly and incorporating feedback effectively.
  • Continuously improve personal technical depth in structural layout, joints, fasteners, tolerancing, and structural optimization.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 8+ years of experience in aircraft structural design or closely related aerospace structures.
  • Experience designing and releasing structural components in development or production environments.
  • Working knowledge of composite and metallic structures, including fasteners, bonded joints, and load paths.
  • Proficiency in CAD tools (NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, or similar).

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Staff Aerostructures Design Engineer to support the development of structural components for our next-generation autonomous aircraft. As a key contributor on the Mechanical Engineering team, you will design and develop high-performance structural components from concept through production release.

You’ll work cross-functionally to ensure structural integrity, manufacturability, and system integration across one of the most advanced autonomous aircraft platforms being built today. This role is ideal for an aerospace mechanical engineer who thrives in hands-on design environments and is eager to take increasing ownership of flight-critical designs.

lists.content:
• Design and develop structural components and assemblies for Shield AI’s next-generation UAV platform, supporting both primary and secondary aircraft structures.
  • Execute all stages of the design lifecycle including conceptual development, initial CAD modeling, detailed design, and drawing release.
  • Perform hand calculations for stress or strain with limited basic FEA analysis, with guidance from senior engineers as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with aerodynamics, propulsion, avionics, payload, and manufacturing teams to support system integration across airframe interfaces.
  • Support structural validation efforts including coupon testing, subcomponent testing, and system-level verification.
  • Generate high-quality design documentation, drawings, interface definitions, and analysis reports in compliance with aerospace standards.
  • Partner with manufacturing and flight test teams to resolve build issues and support hardware through test and deployment.
  • Participate in design reviews and technical discussions, presenting work clearly and incorporating feedback effectively.
  • Continuously improve personal technical depth in structural layout, joints, fasteners, tolerancing, and structural optimization.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 8+ years of experience in aircraft structural design or closely related aerospace structures.
  • Experience designing and releasing structural components in development or production environments.
  • Working knowledge of composite and metallic structures, including fasteners, bonded joints, and load paths.
  • Proficiency in CAD tools (NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, or similar).
  • Understanding of GD&T, tolerance stackups, and DFMA principles.
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in fast-paced, high-ownership engineering environments
  • Ability to get a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

• M.S. degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Experience supporting UAV, DoD, or aerospace vehicle programs.
  • Familiarity with aerospace standards (MIL-STD, ASME Y14.5, FAA).
  • Experience supporting hardware through test, failure analysis, and design iteration.
  • Exposure to composite design and manufacturing methods.
  • Experience using FEA tools (ANSYS, Abaqus, NASTRAN, or similar) for linear structural analysis

lists.content:
COMSEC Management:

  • Perform program security administrative tasks, including filing, updating logs/lists, coordinating with internal and external customers, and managing supplies.
  • Maintain COMSEC administrative records.
  • Develop COMSEC training and maintain personnel COMSEC briefings.
  • Conduct internal self-inspections and assist with Staff Assistance Visits and Customer Security Assessments.
  • Maintain classified material accountability records, including inventory lists, receipt and transmittal records, and final disposition documentation.
  • Perform Cryptonet management activities.
  • Maintain up to date software, keys, and hardware for classified systems.
  • Review operational requirements and system specification documents to address and incorporate applicable security requirements into security processes.
  • Manage all logistics of managing, deploying, and transporting requirements of COMSEC material.
  • Investigate and document security violations/incidents, providing recommendations for corrective actions to program personnel/management.
  • Attend, support, and participate in program meetings, staff meetings, teleconferences, etc.
  • Respond to walk-in customers and provide ad hoc security services as required
  • Maintain formal initial and recurring security education and training materials/events.
  • Manage all trouble shooting aspects of COMSEC material

    • Physical Security:

  • Ensure networking rooms have the appropriate infrastructure to handle COMSEC
  • Provide input to Fixed Facility Checklist, TEMPEST checklists when related to COMSEC connections.
  • Strong physical security experience with network rooms red/black separation requirements.

    • Cybersecurity / Assessment & Authorization (A&A):

  • Provide necessary support to the Information Assurance team in the implementation and maintenance of classified information systems accredited under the Assessment & Authorization (A&A) process.
  • Participate in the planning for new classified information systems and support the Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) in developing System Security Plans.
  • Manage all COMSEC related tasks for classified systems.

• DoD Special Access Programs experience required.
  • 8 years' security administration experience required.
  • Candidate must have demonstrated customer support, interpersonal skills and excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Previous experience as a COMSEC account manager, Alternate Custodian, or in an Information Assurance role. Familiarity with Key Management Infrastructure (KMI) or Electronic Key Management System (EKMS).
  • Security Clearance: DOD Top Secret / with SCI eligibility required.

• Education: Bachelor’s college degree and/or military experience preferred but not required. A combination of education, training, certification and/or experience that provides the requisite knowledge, skills and abilities may be substituted for the degree.
